ascendancy_flavour.Druid1: There are many paths to achieve your goals... and you see them all.
ascendancy_flavour.Druid2:
Wraeclast has suffered for too long.
You are vengeance incarnate.
ascendancy_flavour.Huntress1: You became a weapon of war so that others could live in peace.
ascendancy_flavour.Huntress2: You were chosen by the Sacred Wisps to enact the Spirit's will.
ascendancy_flavour.Huntress3: Corruption cost you your home, but taught you so much more...
ascendancy_flavour.Mercenary1: Countless wars have left you with skills somewhat resembling a decent officer...
ascendancy_flavour.Mercenary2: There's something very wrong with this world... and you're going to fix it.
ascendancy_flavour.Mercenary3: The more you embrace virtue gems, the more power they offer...
ascendancy_flavour.Monk1: They made you a human weapon... but that strength has set you free.
ascendancy_flavour.Monk2: True strength lies within. One must only focus... and believe.
ascendancy_flavour.Monk3: The truth of your faith threatens to break your very soul... but in that struggle lies power beyond belief.
ascendancy_flavour.Ranger1: A woman can change the world with a single well-placed arrow.
ascendancy_flavour.Ranger3: There are venoms and virtues aplenty in the wilds, if you know where to look.
ascendancy_flavour.Sorceress1: The rumble of thunder heralds your approach. Woe to those that draw your ire.
ascendancy_flavour.Sorceress2: The tapestry of time is yours to weave; an element you alone may master.
ascendancy_flavour.Sorceress3: By your command, they will earn redemption...one duty at a time.
ascendancy_flavour.Warrior1: Incredible might has always laid buried within you. Now is the time to rise.
ascendancy_flavour.Warrior2: Your home has been threatened. A good man must be roused to war.
ascendancy_flavour.Warrior3: You hunger for power, and by force of arms, you will take it.
ascendancy_flavour.Witch1: You seek power at any cost... and there is no price too high to pay.
ascendancy_flavour.Witch2: Your search for power took you on a journey inwards.
ascendancy_flavour.Witch3: Death is your domain, your flesh merely a material to be mastered.
ascendancy_flavour.Witch3b: The Well of Souls is yours to command.

flavour.AMothersPartingGift:
Nature was her domain,
Love was her song,
Family was her devotion,
Knowledge was her gift.
flavour.AbandonedWealth: When the world burned, the greedy burned with it, while the clever left as paupers.
flavour.AbyssEyeSocketableAmanamu: The Liege of the Lightless seeks dominion for the authority it brings.
flavour.AbyssEyeSocketableKurgal: The Blackblooded seeks dominion for its own sake.
flavour.AbyssEyeSocketableTecrod: The Hated Slave seeks dominion for the revenge it enables.
flavour.AbyssEyeSocketableUlaman: The Sovereign of the Well seeks dominion to banish the Light.
flavour.AbyssPinnacleKeyQuest: Something awaits you in the Well.
flavour.AdditionalCraftedModRuneFlavourT:
To become a Runefather - an Artificer of standing - one
must create something truly new. Astrid was the youngest
smith to ever succeed. Hers was not a work of supreme
power or strength, but simple flexibility and control.
flavour.AdditionalModPoolChronomancyFlav:
Time was not night and day to the Order of the Chalice.
It was the motions of the stars, the celestial patterns.
To understand Time was to comprehend existence itself.
flavour.AfflictionFragment: How do you defeat that which dwells within you?
flavour.AhnLineageSupport:
As possessed golems ravaged the land, Aul - crowned Ahn
by blood and tyranny - began the last ritual, causing azurite
crystals to rupture and grow throughout his doomed citadel.
flavour.AmanamuLineageSupport:
Those that serve the Liege of the Lightless are his, utterly.
Blood, flesh, and soul are fodder to bend to his will.
Under a Lich Lord, not even death is an escape.
flavour.Amulet13:
"A bit short in the arm, are you?
Then you'll be short of a head soon enough."
- Daresso the Daring
flavour.Amulet14:
"We are the soldiers of Faith, armoured in devotion.
Let the sinners come, for we - the Pure - shall endure!"
- Voll of Thebrus, at the Battle of the Bridge
flavour.Amulet15:
"Grind your words into sharp thoughts.
Grind your thoughts into the sharpest of deeds."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.AnarchysPrice: Born of relentless fury and abhorrence, warped by turmoil and anguish, tainted through desire and carnality, I thirst for bloodshed once more.
flavour.ArbiterLineageSupport:
"This carving seems to depict curled bodies floating in vats...
the next shows all but one of them dying. What were they
trying to do? It seems they kept trying... kept experimenting..."
flavour.ArbitersReachLineageSupport:
"They designed our salvation. No longer shall
our people's grief be in vain. From their hands,
perfection is wrought. Within His reach, we are safe."
flavour.ArchivesResearch:
First and foremost, a Sekhema
must possess strength.
flavour.AssassinsFavor:
By the time their eyes meet, 
the dark deal has long since been made, 
and his fate long since sealed.
flavour.AtziriAllureLineageSupport:
Such was her seductive power, every noble in the court fell
over themselves to do her bidding. Winning a single glance
away from her mirror meant more than their lives.
flavour.AtziriCommunionLineageSupport:
The Red Communion was meant to transcend the limits
of the soul, to transfigure the flesh, to bestow immortality.
It accomplished all of these things... most horribly.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_1: Look to our Queen, for she will lead us into the light.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_2: Only those who aspire can dare to hope.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_3: The light without pales in comparison to the light within.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_4: The Vaal shall never fear the setting of our sun.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_1: We are but dogs, howling at an uncaring moon.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_2: Look to our Queen, for she will lead us from the darkness.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_3: It is only the blind who can live in darkness.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_4: When we prostrate ourselves to the night, we worship mortality.
flavour.AtziriImpatienceLineageSupport:
"Those who bored the Queen suffered an excessive punishment:
everyone they had ever known would be killed, effectively
erasing their life. So, no matter the cost... none kept her waiting."
flavour.AtzirisArsenal: In the prison of all sins, will you grasp godhood or sorrow? Only hope lies under the shadows.
flavour.AtzirisVessel: Eternal life is within our grasp. Do not let it go.
flavour.Audacity:
A jolt, and it moves. Or smolders.
A current, and it lives. Or dies.
A surge, and it transcends.
Or... not.
Only one way to find out.
flavour.AzadiLineageSupport:
"No plan. No stealth. I want shock. Awe. I want them to
know who did it, and I want them telling tales. That's the
only way for us to earn their respect... and their fear."
flavour.BardiyaLineageSupport:
Confident their enemy was defenseless, the Keitans brazenly
charged the walls - but Arjun's ammunition supply reports
had been... 'inaccurate'... just like everything else Bardiyan.
flavour.BeautyThroughDeath:
Her beauty did not fade 
her humanity did not survive.
flavour.Belt5: As long as the soul is unfettered, so is the body.
flavour.BhatairLineageSupport:
It is said that the Steward of Tales roams Wraeclast still,
lost in the form of a Wyvern, full of sorrow and fury at
the loss of his beloved pupils to the King in the Mists...
flavour.BirthOfTheThree: A small token of Her affliction.
flavour.BlessingofGod: When the darkness weighs upon you, grow light from within.
flavour.BlindVenture:
"It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian
flavour.BloodCrucibleFlavourText:
The gateway of flesh, horror unbound,
requires a key of madness and pain.
flavour.BloodTwinLineageSupport:
Atazek and Atalui rose, battered and dark, bleeding from a hundred
different wounds. She gave her brother a sinister grin. "Shall we
show them what happens to those who challenge the Vaal?"
flavour.BoonOfTheFirstOnes:
Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew, 
her gift came from what she lost: 
her humanity.
flavour.BoundlessRealms: Boundless is the distance between where we start and where we start again.
flavour.BowyersDream: If this is my dream, I don't wish to wake.
flavour.BreachlordsAmalgamSupport:
The flesh rejoiced. The melding began.
Then, fear. Something foreign within.
It was cast out too late. The unity was broken.
flavour.BreachlordsRiftSupport:
Our Broken Sun... it is no mere allegory. It is
the consequence of insolent disharmony.
For now, it is contained, but time is against us.
flavour.BreachstoneBossFlavour_:
The Twisted Breachlord reaches out from his
Domain with maddened agony and anger.
flavour.BrutusLineageSupport:
Shavronne gleefully raised her arms to the sky as lightning
flashed. She'd done it! Her creation was perfect! Invincible.
Immortal! But she soon realized there was one piece missing...
flavour.CallToTheFirstOnes: The Ezomyte, desperate for aid, cried out to the gods.
flavour.CartographersDelight:
A map is similar
to a pair of eyes,
without one you stumble
around, unable to find your way.
flavour.CarvedCunning:
"Remember this tale, lest you hear the Bodach. If you
listen to its words, you'll never listen again."
- Chronicler of Fables
flavour.CarvedMajesty:
"Carry this carving, lest the Bodach find you. If you've
no idol to offer, it carves your bones instead."
- Chronicler of Fables
flavour.CarvedMischief:
"Wander not, lest the Bodach walk with you. You'll walk 'til
your feet open the earth, where its Darkness awaits."
- Chronicler of Fables
flavour.CarvedTenacity:
"Stay in the light, lest the Bodach take you. You'll disappear
so completely none will know you existed."
- Chronicler of Fables
flavour.CastawayExplosive:
A decayed blackmarket explosive. It's waterlogged, 
covered in barnacles and ready to explode.
flavour.CathasBrillianceSupport:
"The yellow sap... the Vivid flow... it is the energy of
harmony between disparate forces. They call it the
Catha, an aspect of the Goddess. It is so much more."
flavour.CathedralResearch:
Strength can be outmatched by move and countermove.
A Sekhema must be perceptive and cunning.
flavour.CelestialVaultKey:
An heirloom of the champions of Wraeclast
Lies forgotten in an abandoned reliquary
Born of a starry void from which time cannot escape
flavour.ChaoticDisposition: Life isn't what you make of it, it's already been made for you.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquary:
The craftsman rots.
His tools rust.
But his legacy cuts through the ages.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquary2:
The words of a man, delicate like life, pass on feebly into forgotten verse,
but his creations... his craft shall be championed agelessly.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryCosmic: Time stands still, and a new champion ascends.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryMaven:
You are not the first champion to receive this gift,
and you will likely not be the last.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquarySearingEx:
To a being of the stars, Time is irrelevant,
and memories are but a collection of present moments.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquarySirus:
Though you might not see it, a sliver of my soul remains,
and I am trying with all my strength to get back to you.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryTwilightO:
We cannot fight the gods today, nor tomorrow
Take this, our children of Time, and free mankind
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryUberShape:
You did not slay me.
You saved me.
I forgive you.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryUberUberE: There are holes in the sky...
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryVaal:
Time is a river, forking forever into infinite unknowns.
Nothing is ever truly gone.
It is merely taking a different route to the sea.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryVenarius:
It is not regret that stalks me now...
merely the child of my sins.
flavour.CirelLineageSupport:
The oldest and greatest fortress on Wraeclast was grown, not built.
She Who Waited planted their seeds in a time of ash and snow.
Now, the gate of the Taisce is unassailable, yet open to all.
flavour.CleansingFireBossKeyFlavourText:
From the corona of an ancient star,
the Searing Exarch seeks to master the Atlas.
flavour.CleansingFireKeyFlavourText:
Once within the grasp of the Black Star,
there can be no escape.
flavour.CovetedPossession: A taste of power brings a hunger for more.
flavour.CurrencyHarvestBossKey:
It isn't the twisted transformative power of corruption that makes it so dangerous.
It is its ability to hide in plain sight.
flavour.DaressoLineageSupport:
"I raised my eyes to look upon my death. Instead, I saw her.
Merveil. Fighting had always been about survival. Now the
fight became about something much greater... love."
flavour.Death:
The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.
flavour.DestinedToCrumble:
"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar
flavour.DiallaLineageSupport:
"I will become your Gemling Queen, my love, but not
with such dull stones. I want to give myself to you
for eternity. Surely we can seek perfection together?"
flavour.DiallasSubjugation:
A symbol of beauty and innocence
The gems corrupted her mind
Malachai corrupted her gems
All but a glimmer of
greatness lost in madness
flavour.DivinationCardAChillingWind:
All things slow under winter's 
onslaught - even life itself.
flavour.DivinationCardADabOfInk: The Poet's blood is the Empire's ink.
flavour.DivinationCardADustyMemory: In the oldest halls of my mind, at the end of a rarely used passage, lies my greatest treasure: one moment of happiness and innocence, pure and untouchable.
flavour.DivinationCardAFamiliarCall_:
The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.
flavour.DivinationCardAFateWorseThanDeat: "It was as though my very thoughts were breaking... fracturing into tiny motes to be lost on the wind."
flavour.DivinationCardAModestRequest:
Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.
A minor inconvenience I assure you.
flavour.DivinationCardANoteInTheWind:
The artist is long dead,
the lyrics are long forgotten,
yet the Song of War longs to be sung again
flavour.DivinationCardASeaOfBlue: The harvest ended, the floods began.

The mud is cracked and dry. The fields now burn beneath the blistering sun.
Even our children are dying in the streets! We've angered Solaris and so
we pay tribute to appease her fiery heart...
flavour.DivineVesselSolaris2:
When Solaris is angered, there must always be sacrifice. Our women
have taken to mourning, they drag themselves through ash and glass,
not wanting to give up our youth to the all-consuming flame.
flavour.DivineVesselSolaris3:
To take from the sun is to invite her wrath, and we've more than warranted her curse.
The granaries were vacant, so we lessened our tribute to the sun thinking it would
save our children, but they will die now regardless.
flavour.DivineVesselTukohama:
Tukohama stood in the door, blocking the sunlight
from Hikatomanga and his family. The Father of War's
retribution was inevitable, for it is known - man
cannot cheat the gods without consequence...
flavour.DivineVesselYugul:
In nature, there are many feelings exclusive only to man. But terror is not one.
Terror flourishes in our world, transcending all things. It is the bedrock on
which our great cosmos is formed. I am Yugul and I deign to understand this
mystery, to explore its depths and unlock its secrets...
flavour.DjinnLineageSupport_:
"These traditions we shall set forth, so that we may remain
strong, so that we may endure throughout the ages. Not to
bind, not to dominate, but to protect... and guide."
flavour.DoedreLineageSupport:
Doedre's depravity knew no limits. She stretched and
broke and rebuilt herself until she forgot her own shape.
She reverted to a familiar form, and began anew.
flavour.DoedresMadness: "Hold your tongue before I claim it." - Doedre Darktongue
flavour.DreamFurnaceFlavourText:
The minds of men are but motes
on a sea of infinite madness.
flavour.DreamerLineageSupport:
Each initiate hears a bell tolling in their dreams. It is the
clarion call of the Benevolent Dreamer. From then on,
they dedicate their lives to a singular purpose.
flavour.DyingAnguish: Moribund, he gazed upon the journey taken as blood trickled down his chin. His eye closed on the city ahead that he would never call home.
flavour.EarthDrinker: Taste and grow strong. Drink too much and be buried.
flavour.EinharLineageSupport:
"You must cut the beast, like this," he told the wide-eyed
and forgetful woman. "The juiciest parts are in the middle!"
She nodded, and began relearning the way of the wilds.
flavour.EmergentInstinct:
Awareness shot through its Verisium 
consciousness. It cursed the sky, and its rage
reverberated throughout its earthen cradle.
flavour.EmergentPossibility:
The once infinitesimal creature erupted.
It was not torn apart, but expanded, filled
with the matter and will of the stars.
flavour.EmergentProtection:
It flexed its molten limbs and caressed its 
metal bones. It meticulously rearranged
itself until it was complete.
flavour.EmergentVigour:
The creature languished in Corruption, driven 
by hunger alone. The sky opened, and
crushed the creature beneath its gift.
flavour.EmperorOfPurity:
True to his title,
Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.
flavour.EonyrsThunderSupport:
"How? Well, the Great Wyvern granted her passage, of course.
Eonyr and his flock soar the winds between us and the Moon.
The roar of the storm... that's them, as they hunt and call."
flavour.EshsProwessSupport:
Knowledge unending had transcended physical form.
Her minds raced through metal latticework as the
flesh of the melding reached up to contain her.
flavour.FatedUnique1:
Kaom guided his Karui across the sea
and spilled their blood on foreign soil.
flavour.FatedUnique10:
Giant's blood you cannot tame,
as wild as an unwatched flame.
flavour.FatedUnique11:
Let it pierce you, let blood flow.
Make more room for the soul to grow.
flavour.FatedUnique12: A moment of victory may last an eternity in memory.
flavour.FatedUnique13: May it echo through the halls.
flavour.FatedUnique14: What goes out must come in.
flavour.FatedUnique15: Even the mightiest tree was once just a sapling.
flavour.FatedUnique16:
Flesh may freeze and rot,
but the soul remains unbroken.
flavour.FatedUnique17: The gryphon knows only the hunt and the flight.
flavour.FatedUnique18: A burned branch leaks sap no more.
flavour.FatedUnique19_:
"The Vaal, a thousand years ago, 
came up with more delightful methods of murder
than I could ever wish for." 
- Koralus Doomfletch
flavour.FatedUnique2: For dead men require no answer.
flavour.FatedUnique21:
Where steel-grey clouds gather and crash together,
a storm is sure to follow.
flavour.FatedUnique22:
The last sweet music to touch Hrimnor's ears
passed right beneath his chin.
flavour.FatedUnique23: No one likes a quiet encore.
flavour.FatedUnique24:
"The flames are surely coming.
I just pray I am long dead before they arrive."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavour.FatedUnique25:
The soldiers stormed her throne room.
The guards held them at bay.
The peasants overwhelmed the guards.
The nobles paid for their lives.
The nobles took her throne,
and so she fled to the woods.
flavour.FatedUnique26:
"A taste of Midnight, and you may never see the dawn."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.FatedUnique27:
"At last, my beauty is beyond reproach."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FatedUnique28:
It was Doedre who learned that pain is just
as much about fear as it is about injury.
flavour.FatedUnique29_:
You cannot control the storm,
but you can utilise it.
flavour.FatedUnique3: There is no wall thicker or stronger than fear.
flavour.FatedUnique31:
"Laws are for city folk.
Can't try a man for murder if you can't find him."
- Taruk, Last of the Wildmen
flavour.FatedUnique32:
Beneath the frozen eye of Lunaris
a new world will be born.
A crystalline, perfectly still utopia.
flavour.FatedUnique33: A single taste leaves you wanting more.
flavour.FatedUnique34:
Burning goddess, shine so bright.
Set the world 'fore you alight.
flavour.FatedUnique35:
An open mouth, a blinding shriek,
Your mind goes dark, your body weak.
flavour.FatedUnique36:
Embrace your burning ambition.
Embrace your frozen heart.
You will be transformed.
flavour.FatedUnique37:
"Even for the great Magi,
time passes without relent."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavour.FatedUnique38:
"The most dizzying heights are surrounded by precipitous falls.
Progress cannot be eternal."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavour.FatedUnique39:
"Cut down the tallest tree,
and another becomes the tallest."
- Old Ezomyte saying
flavour.FatedUnique4:
The Karui boats were closing the gap,
but Shavronne had laid for them one final trap.
flavour.FatedUnique40:
Follow your most basic instincts.
The rest will come naturally.
flavour.FatedUnique41:
Asenath loosed arrows with almost musical rhythm,
a rhythm matched by her nearly inaudible whispers,
and the crunch of the dead hitting the dust.
flavour.FatedUnique42:
"Make a man believe he is doing the world a good deed,
and there is nothing you can't make him do."
- Malachai, the Soulless
flavour.FatedUnique43:
There is no cost too great to pay for power.
Merely men who lack the conviction to pay it.
flavour.FatedUnique44: The breath of life is theirs to take.
flavour.FatedUnique45:
By light we are shadowed,
in darkness we are bound.
flavour.FatedUnique46:
Few men command an army better
than the Great Meginord of the North
flavour.FatedUnique47:
Few men can guide their people
like the Great Meginord of the North
flavour.FatedUnique49:
Hyrri's quick thinking led to victory,
but it came at the cost of respect.
flavour.FatedUnique5:
The overture stretches thin,
The chorus gathers to begin.
Stacatto, drone, a rest drawn long,
Another hears Death's final song.
flavour.FatedUnique50:
Make a man hot, and his heart will skip a beat.
Set a man on fire, and his heart will skip all beats.
flavour.FatedUnique51:
The night dances on
Wine continues to flow
Your skin looking pale
Your soul letting go
flavour.FatedUnique52:
"Confess your sins to me. My god will not be nearly so forgiving."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
flavour.FatedUnique53:
"Please, take whatever you want. Just don't kill me"
"But then I wouldn't have everything I want, would I?"
flavour.FatedUnique54: As death arrives, so too does instinct.
flavour.FatedUnique55:
Legend tells of a time when Solaris will
burst forth from Lunaris,
and night will be eternally banished.
flavour.FatedUnique56:
One more partner by the hand,
Let your steps entwine.
Spin together, swing as one,
And dance with death in trine.
flavour.FatedUnique57:
"Stand steadfast in the face of destruction.
The Council cannot afford to falter."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
flavour.FatedUnique58:
The weight of faith is great
Yet it is never borne alone.
flavour.FatedUnique59_:
Even the dead dare not
trespass into Ullr's dominion.
flavour.FatedUnique6: Nothing spreads fear faster than the unknown.
flavour.FatedUnique60:
"Though Geofri's beacon was extinguished,
his embers may yet light our way."
- Victario, The People's Poet
flavour.FatedUnique61: As you guided me, now I guide others.
flavour.FatedUnique7: The largest rock leaves the deepest mark.
flavour.FatedUnique8:
Fire spreads thick and fast.
The first spark is never the last.
flavour.FatedUnique9:
Flames to guide the Great Spirit to the site of the dead,
and smoke to carry them into the sky.
flavour.Faustus1:
"Darnaw is stupid and confident.
I am certain he will have recorded his misdeeds."
flavour.Faustus2:
"Fidium's fealty to fairness 
makes him the perfect pawn in my plan.
Our plan. Perfect pawn in OUR plan."
flavour.ForbiddenPower: Some things should not be used. Some power is too great a risk.
flavour.FourAmuletB1a: We search for the memories missing...
flavour.FourAmuletB1b: We reach for the promises lost...
flavour.FourAmuletB2: We yield our mind to save the body...
flavour.FourBeltB1: It is our steps that stir.
flavour.FourBeltB2: It is our hands that join.
flavour.FourBeltB3: It is our flesh that binds.
flavour.FourBeltB4: It is our mind that splits.
flavour.FourDemigodBody1:
Pierced, slashed, battered, and bludgeoned,
the champion rises with a bloodied grin.
flavour.FourDemigodBoots1:
Victory finds those who make
a stand when all others fall.
flavour.FourDemigodGloves1:
A champion is a tower of deeds,
each stacked upon the last,
each carved by hand.
flavour.FourDemigodHelmet1:
Those qualities possessed by the victor
are proven inherently right and true.
flavour.FourDemigodShield1:
The victor holds back the tide,
never faltering, never failing.
flavour.FourDemigodSword1:
The price of failure comes due
at the end of the victor's blade.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet1:
A hearth unyielding, ever warm,
A light unbroken, endlessly reborn.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet12:
Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy,
for they care not for their own survival.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet13: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet14: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet15_:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet16:
He knew not why he was changing, only
that he wanted to hold his family close...
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet17:
The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack,
but it was not their dekharas that responded.
It was Solerai herself.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet18:
Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit.
Fire, they learn, springs from agony.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet2:
Worship of house gods was tolerated
in Oriath, so long as it remained private.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet20:
When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banished from Keth,
the Sekhemas took a single hostage as punishment.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet21: Remember the past, anticipate the future.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet22:
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the
night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks,
which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet23: To stray is to condemn this world to sin.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet3:
What they saw was what they believed, and
they believed Lunaris had not abandoned them.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet5: The sacred sap flows slowly, but surely.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet6:
Forged from the blood of countless wars, 
its thirst has only begun.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet7: Natural grace is born, not earned.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet8:
The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.
flavour.FourUniqueAmulet9:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt1:
Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt10: Bleeding just means you're still alive.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt11: Poison the land and they'll have nothing to defend.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt12: All creatures have the potential for greatness or unequivocal failure.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt13:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt15: Trifle not with the trinket mage.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt16_:
Asinia promised vengeance beyond death,
and she found a way to keep that promise.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt17: Clever artifice is not always complex.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt18_:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavour.FourUniqueBelt19:
A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging
himself once for every ten lashings he gives.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt2:
Adversity is the soil in
which persistence grows.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt20:
The sun's fury, trapped
in pillars of blazing light,
Explodes from its cage.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt21: Bring mystery to life. Again and again.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt23:
Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown.
Darkness coiled the world in eternal night.
Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down.
No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt24:
Rivers of power coursed through their veins.
Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt3:
Below all living things,
there exists a flow...
flavour.FourUniqueBelt4:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
flavour.FourUniqueBelt6: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.
flavour.FourUniqueBelt8:
Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record.
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would
desperately cling to any other source of life.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex1: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex10:
Shedding away her regal past,
she forged a new destiny.
Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,
she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.
Seizing her one true wish,
she found peace at last.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex11:
Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex15:
Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,
tipped with a poisoned hatred
only oppression can ferment.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex16:
"The boy is a bad omen," he cried. "Ravens gather
before him!" That night, a new raven appeared, and
shadowed the Auspex for the rest of his days.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex2: To catch an animal, think like an animal.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex5:
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex6:
Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters,
but life always springs back anew.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDex7:
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. 
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt1:
"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!"
- the Master Torturer's last words
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt10: Thin is the line between mechanical genius and magic.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt11:
"...The discomfort shown by the others is amusing, but none
can deny that my work has made quite the splash..."
- Maligaro's Journal
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt13:
Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt14:
A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkness.
The bronze hums. The cloth sighs.
Living pieces of her, yearning to exist.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt2:
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery,
that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt3:
Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind
live their entire lives in snow and ice.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyDexInt6:
Mortality is a curse.
The cure is simple.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt1: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt12:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt13:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt14:
Hallowed Dordalus was cast into the pit as a heretic,
but his piety was so great, he would not burn.
He rose again, lauded, his faith forever changed...
but not the way the Templar believed.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt15:
Shavronne's apparel became ever more extravagant
as her body and soul became ever more corrupted.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt2: The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt3: Suspicion is a sinister shadow slithering in the soul.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt4:
Fueled by the blackness in the hearts of men,
the armies of Saresh were just as relentless.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt5: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt6:
In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with
anything and everything that could hold water...
should the opportunity arise.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt8:
My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood
flavour.FourUniqueBodyInt9: The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr1: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr12_: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr14: The warrior who fears will fall.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr15:
Tears of blood, aching heart,
My dear Isildria must depart.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr3:
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned
to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr4:
That most legendary caravan bandit had
one rule: never let them see you flinch.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr5:
Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the
rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr6:
Knowing she could outlast any opponent,
Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr7: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStr8:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex1:
For those noble families obsessed
with keeping their bloodline pure,
there was a price to pay...
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex11:
Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex14:
"What are you lot looking at? We're
under fire! Get to your stations!"
- Captain Sventura, the Unlucky
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex2:
In the mists they dwell,
forever hungry,
forever cold.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex3: A power unknown aids your own.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex4:
His isolation caused him to treasure
their companionship all the more.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex5:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex6:
"This was the first step in some grand design,
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher."
- Dominus, High Templar
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex7:
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and
their enemies stood in silence. That day,
the sky was clear, but it was raining.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex8:
The world churned during the Great Wasting.
Tawhoa may have stilled the rioting earth,
but it was Valako that tamed the broken sky.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDex9:
"I will never forget. I will carry your memory
forward, all of you, from this ghastly Vale."
- Artair, last survivor of the Ogham rebellion
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrDexInt2:
"When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt11:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt12:
The Twilight Order rejected the gods, choosing
instead to put their faith in each other.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt14:
The collector need not even speak. Each ring
regaled them with tales of his conquest.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt15:
His latent potential unleashed itself, a beast
bursting from its shackles. Each strike of Farrow's
hammer rang out a song for the First Ones.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt16:
"Hold firm. Let no word but the Mothers' turn your head.
Through your unfaltering fealty, you achieve perfection."
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt1_: The gleam of the night and howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt3:
When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt4:
"Do not despair! Give yourself to the woods!
Become empty, and the Goddess will find you.
From within her roots... you shall be restored."
- Cirel of Caer Tarth
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt5:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt6:
The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt7:
Through every great purge, and every fiery inquisition,
the Twilight Order endured in secret.
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt8:
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect.
Confuse them with elegance and grace.
They'll never see the axe coming."
- Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
flavour.FourUniqueBodyStrInt9:
It is often said of nobles that they live off their
peasants... sometimes, it's truer than any suspect.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex2: The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex3:
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you,
unknown and snarled to the very last.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex4:
Where legends tread,
the world hearkens.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex5:
Banished for his tragic failure,
Erian learned to hunt to survive.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex6: The wyrm draws warmth from the fires of desire.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDex9:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDexInt2:
The cursed ones march forever,
On their hopeless, last endeavour.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsDexInt3:
The combat stance used by Vaal nobles
was as elegant as it was deadly.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsInt1: Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsInt2: All the world is my home.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsInt3:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsInt5:
The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr1: A wall of steel and muscle.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr2: Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr3: We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr4: The truly mighty are never outnumbered.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr5:
As the sun rises and the light approaches,
so too shall your enemies fear you.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStr6:
Centuries ago, there existed a unique grove imbued with ancestral fire.
As with all things, the Karui used its wood for war.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrDex1: Some search forever for their path.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrDex2:
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrDex3: The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrDex4:
"Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot
could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times
meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrInt2:
Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrInt3:
For the immortal, what is the difference
between an age and an instant?
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrInt4:
To extend your life as long as possible
is to extend all the maladies that come with it.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrInt5:
Where he tread, disintegrating storms of lightning
and death laid waste to all around him.
flavour.FourUniqueBootsStrInt9:
"Soar. Be swift. Let none trespass here, from
above or below, lest your purpose be forfeit."
flavour.FourUniqueBow1:
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."
flavour.FourUniqueBow13_:
"Kinslayer, you dishonour your own traditions to turn the tide of battle! 
Let us see which is stronger... Karui savagery or the might of the Empire!"
- General Marceus Lioneye
flavour.FourUniqueBow14:
As the Maji approached the edge of Nothingness, she strung 
fragments of the Wildwood's carcass together. When she 
nocked her arrow, she pulled upon the elements of life itself.
flavour.FourUniqueBow2:
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes
flavour.FourUniqueBow3:
Each crest was a Thane's word, bolted to Ivor's bow.
They would join the Count's side, or die by his hands.
flavour.FourUniqueBow4:
The forests of the Vastiri held many secrets
mystical and dark. Men learned not to wander,
lest they return with a strange new purpose.
flavour.FourUniqueBow5:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch
flavour.FourUniqueBow6:
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
flavour.FourUniqueBow7:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.
flavour.FourUniqueBow8: A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.
flavour.FourUniqueBow9:
The power of the Allflame rends
souls just as easily as flesh.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach1_:
We happily give our limbs.
A net woven to keep safe the bones of the Lords.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach2:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach3:
The limit of our knowledge is a barrier
that protects us from ourselves.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach4a:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach4b:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach4c:
A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.
flavour.FourUniqueBreach5:
Seeking to add their distinctiveness to his own, He
Who Dreamt acquired the essence of each of the races
of Wraeclast. His success slowly became his doom.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm1:
"Even in the face of the Winter of the World,
life found a way. The Spirit always provides."
flavour.FourUniqueCharm10:
The sea swells, the sky thunders; two ships tilt at odds.
Flashes of light show only swinging axes... and a grin.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm11:
Among the Templars, a secret few ate the sins of others.
They bore this burden to empower their hidden Order.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm2:
Wraeclast has known too few true heroes.
It remembers those that stood in defiance.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm3:
Devotees of the Goddess of Lust
needed never fear her sting.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm4:
They found a crying child tied to a frozen pyre.
She was clad in ice, but the village was ash.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm5:
The most beloved member of every Brinerot crew
is the one that refuses to do any actual work.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm6:
"It may be centuries hence, but I still hold utmost faith.
The Saviour will rise, and mankind will be free."
flavour.FourUniqueCharm7:
"When the headsman's blade swings,
your last moments stretch to eternity."
- Vorm, the Twice-Pardoned
flavour.FourUniqueCharm8: Kaom was not known for his restraint.
flavour.FourUniqueCharm9:
"To scrape the sky,
to touch the clouds themselves,
is to know true freedom."
- Mutewind saying
flavour.FourUniqueCorruption1:
"Ghorr knows only hunger, only ravenous feasting.
It will consume all that lives, and more!"
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page fourteen
flavour.FourUniqueCorruption2:
"All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh,
on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty
flavour.FourUniqueCorruption3:
"The mind at the center of the swarm... K'Tash does
the thinking... but it has only one thought... hate."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page ninety-four
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow1:
Sibilant promises surrounded them in the night.
All the travelers had to give him was their devotion...
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow13:
"And here we shall remain... 
trapped in our symphony of eternal anguish.
Artist and Composer, their fates entwined for all of time."
- Adamantia Brektov, the Composer
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow14:
"The time has passed for diplomacy!
If they will not respect House Azadi, 
then let them die gloriously... and loudly.
We are the masters of the Death Trades!"
- Ratha Azadi
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow2:
"His approach to the gate was met with sounding trumpets
and an unfurling of banners. He never saw it coming."
- anonymous Brotherhood of Silence report
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow3:
The rebelling Trarthans thought they were secure behind
the walls of the cities they'd captured. Emperor Tyndarus
Phrecius made it clear that nowhere would ever be safe.
flavour.FourUniqueCrossbow5:
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the
hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.
flavour.FourUniqueDagger1: Nothing stabs colder than pure hatred.
flavour.FourUniqueDelirium1: A moment of calm before the battle can end the war.
flavour.FourUniqueDelirium2:
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?
flavour.FourUniqueDelirium3: What is life, but a dreamlike spiral of panic?
flavour.FourUniqueDelirium4: The edges bend, the world flexes, the infinite spills into view.
flavour.FourUniqueDelirium5:
There is no light at the end of this inner strife,
but the shadows eventually become home.
flavour.FourUniqueExpedition1:
The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard,
but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.
flavour.FourUniqueExpedition2:
The priests of the Kalguur keep faith through numbers
and calculation, not unprovable promises.
flavour.FourUniqueExpedition3_:
Olroth the Gallant,
tireless and true,
he fights for me,
he fights for you!
flavour.FourUniqueExpedition4:
"True heroes grow stronger in the face of adversity."
- Fourth Tenet of the Knights of the Sun
flavour.FourUniqueFocus1: The cry of death whispers in the wind.
flavour.FourUniqueFocus2:
A gift, a braid, of golden hair.
The war, forgotten.
The reason, remembered.
flavour.FourUniqueFocus3:
The horrors we imagined as children
still exist somewhere in the dark...
flavour.FourUniqueFocus6:
A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss,
her motionless dance the pulse of bliss
flavour.FourUniqueFocus7: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
flavour.FourUniqueFocus8:
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.
flavour.FourUniqueFocus9:
You carried me through life,
The least I can do is carry you through death.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex1_: Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex2:
After the eruption, the skies turned grey,
ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex3: The forest is a stronghold mightier than any other.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex4: The devil finds work for idle hands.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex5:
As the serpent shuns thought,
It shuns fear.
It strikes with the speed of wrath
And the skill of compulsion.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex6:
Maligaro operated effortlessly,
with great speed and terrible consequences.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex8:
"We have methods of interrogation the Inquisitors only dream of."
- Marcus, Brotherhood Liaison
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDex9: If fear doesn't kill you, I will.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt1: Ulcers, scabs, and pocks, the third army makes its claim.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt2:
"Stitches? Wouldn't that defeat the purpose?" 
- Jeffry, Torturer's Apprentice
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt3: A plan without a deadline stays a plan.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt4:
"You think you have Coralito chained. You don't.
You think you're torturing him. You're not.
He needed to get close to you... and you let him."
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt5:
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesDexInt6:
The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt1:
Bloodshed on the crimson shores,
longing for the endless sea.
Treasures, life, I'd give it all
just to capture thee.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt2: You can be the wick or the wax. Either way, your light goes out and mine goes on.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt3:
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt4: Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt5:
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt6: Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesInt7: "Keep smiling. The deepest cut comes not from insults, but from false praise."
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr1:
"You think us savages?" mused the Red Wolf, as
he pulled teeth from the Eternal's skull. "I will
show your kind the way of tooth and claw."
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr2:
The largest beings on Wraeclast
are not flesh and blood.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr3:
Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing.
Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr4: What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr5:
"The heart is the herald. 
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr7:
"I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStr8: Forged from the heart of the densest star, your courage will fail long before it does.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrDex1: The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrDex2: Wealth is not to be borne lightly.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrDex4:
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano,
Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrDex5: The strongest souls are forged through struggle and defeat.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt1:
Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt3: The secret was lost with its maker.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt4:
Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far.
His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt5: The laws of the faith do not apply to its leader.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt6:
By my hand, the inert is given life.
By my hand, that which rots is reborn.
There is nothing that cannot be changed.
Nothing.
flavour.FourUniqueGlovesStrInt7:
The Master's tether wraps itself around the soul.
Should he be denied, he will unmercifully set it free.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex10: The end always comes sooner than we think.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex11:
Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex2: No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex5:
Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken
by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex6:
"Be vigilant, Nezahul! When the serpent is cornered, does it give up?
No... It waits. Then it bites the first hand it finds. 
The danger of numbers is all in your mind!"
- Viper Napuatzi, instructing Royal Commander Nezahul
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex7:
Brinerot pirates live in a perpetual blaze of glory,
pushing their luck right to the end.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex8:
There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death,
but merely a long sleep made eternal.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDex9:
Give of your heated passions.
Give of your cold resolve.
You will be repaid.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt1: The roots burrow deeper, unveiling the wood's bounty...
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt2:
A terror of ancient times, his identity
remains lost... but his power does not.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt3: For none of us are as cruel as all of us.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt4:
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck
only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt5:
"A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt6:
"The ice seared his naked feet
As the lightning stilled his heart,
But it was the flames upon his lover's face
That roused him to vengeance."
- From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetDexInt8:
The sky tore asunder, black cleaving upon blue
The end of life, of Time, with no escape
But they found a fragment, a void, a haven
And there they waited, as it all began again
Dark will, dark knowledge, enemies of Fate
They know your mind, because they remember
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt1:
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt10:
Branded a heretic for your beliefs,
You stand alone against many.
May the truth that fuels their anger,
Carry your blade into their hearts.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt11:
Where the body's limits begin,
the mind's limits end.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt2: The spirit hungers for the flesh.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt3:
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas.
They command a power all their own.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt4:
Keep your heart as ice,
lest your passions stir.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt5:
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt6:
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave
their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt7:
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetInt8:
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind.
A curious paradox."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr10:
When you have slain all of your enemies,
what is left to fear?
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr1a: The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr1b: The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr2:
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr3:
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr4:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr5: May you never hear it toll.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr6:
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices,
but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr7: The Emperor's trusted surgeons are not the only ones who practice the dark arts. Some of us are just more discreet."
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStr8: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex1: In the end, even heroes fade away.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex2:
Sometimes patching up your
equipment gets out of hand.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex3: Let the rider's aim be true.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex4:
He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined
their own personal mockeries, most cruel.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex6:
Swift as thought are the actions of Man 
when borne on wings of divine providence.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex7:
"What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex8:
A cacophony of battle cries
Reverberate through time and space
Inflicting pain beyond measure
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrDex9_:
"Focus. Hone your mind. Your lessers rely on the tangible.
Shed your senses, and raze them from this physical realm."
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt1: An endless river of bodies lie in the wake of ambition.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt3:
A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt4:
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt6: Death crawls in darkness, closer than we think.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt8:
There is power in hunger, though it will
consume all that you have... and more.
flavour.FourUniqueHelmetStrInt9:
"Your covetous hands bring the Unlight
ever closer to consuming your realm."
flavour.FourUniqueJewel1: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel10: After the fires, in the depths of the Winter of the World, all life in the Vastiri banded together. Whether serpent, hyena, human, or golem, hated enemies clasped hand to claw, built refuge, and fought side by side against the Abyssals. Thus, the Third Pact was born.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel11:
They believed themselves driven by necessity,
but that desperation made them monstrous.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel12:
Countless souls scream in agonising harmony,
forever sinking under the weight of the newly dead.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel13:
"Never mind the pain, it's only... making room. Unrelated fact,
a person can live a normal life with just one kidney. Or just one
lung. You never know what Vaal technology will cost you..."
flavour.FourUniqueJewel14_:
"Try on another life. See how it fits. You'll
find that your one life is utterly inadequate."
- He of Many Names and Many Faces
flavour.FourUniqueJewel15: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel3: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel4:
If you're going to act like you're better
than everyone else, make sure you are.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel5:
They believed themselves courageous and selfless,
but that bravery became the doom at their door.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel6:
They clawed their way up from the agonising depths of nonexistence,
breathing deep with joy the exquisite light of meaning.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel7:
Our world was dying, but we chose to survive.
We broke free from the chains within.
flavour.FourUniqueJewel9:
At their height, the Vaal glittered under the sun.
A decade, a century, an aeon of prosperity...
now nothing more than a passing wonder.
flavour.FourUniqueLifeFlask1:
"Tukohama may be asleep, but he still gives us his strength. A small
needle, an offering, and a vial... drink deeply, my son, and you
will more than survive the coming battle... you will thrive."
flavour.FourUniqueLifeFlask2:
"Calculations complete, and He is assembled.
Our immaculate tactics are set in motion."
flavour.FourUniqueManaFlask1:
"How do I cope with what I witnessed on Wraeclast?
Thank the Ancestors! My cup, it overflows."
- Lavianga, former advisor to Kaom
flavour.FourUniqueManaFlask2:
Uhtred drank. Verisium burned through his veins.
He gazed at death's face. With all his strength,
he turned instead to the stars, and witnessed Truth.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace1: The mark of the smith was widely known.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace13: Look the storm in the eye and you will have its respect.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace14:
"You mortals are insidious. You repress your
evil, or deny it exists. Liars! When I open
your heads, that violence floods out."
- The Raven Trickster
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace15:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace2: Shaped metal never forgets the forge.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace3:
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace4:
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders.
It was earned by comrades in arms.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace5:
The Abyssals were created, not born,
and every moment in the light was agony.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace7:
They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandMace9:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often
required to garnish the perfect confession."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandSword1a: As battle calms, blood turns to rust.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandSword1b: War inevitably takes an untold toll on the soul.
flavour.FourUniqueOneHandSword4:
Take your partners by the hand,
Keep your steps in time.
Swing together, spin apart,
And dance with death sublime.
flavour.FourUniquePinnacle1:
The Unblinking Eye did not cower and wail.
They stood against the end.
flavour.FourUniquePinnacle2: One warrior alone survived to face the Arbiter.
flavour.FourUniquePinnacle3: The greatest warrior of his era fought with honour.
flavour.FourUniquePinnacle4: His enemy was for endurance forged. His own waned.
flavour.FourUniquePinnacle5:
Fire destroys, but fire also purifies.
Life always springs anew.
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff1: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff14:
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of
extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished.
Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff2:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff3:
The night Draven attacked,
Erian was asleep at his post.
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff5: In our tales, and in our hearts, the rivers still flow.
flavour.FourUniqueQuarterstaff6:
The first witch hunter knew one critical tactic:
never let your enemy have a clear moment.
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver1:
Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver10:
In this chaotic world
The rewards of the Soul
Outlast the rewards of the Flesh.
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver12:
"Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver2_:
Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver3: Life and death ooze from the same sap.
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver5:
"It's a rare man that has eyes in the back of his head."
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver6:
"Boiling frogs isn't for spells, dear. That's a disgusting
rumour. They're actually for brewing poisons."
- Selassie of the Black Fen
flavour.FourUniqueQuiver8:
"One can never fully eliminate Chance, but with the right
machinations, all the outcomes may be turned in your favour..."
- Cadiro Perandus
flavour.FourUniqueRing1:
If evil must always exist, so be it.
Embrace it. Become its master.
flavour.FourUniqueRing10:
I rule the north
A legacy earned
Time and time again
Sing Meginord's song!
flavour.FourUniqueRing11:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.
flavour.FourUniqueRing12:
Forged by the last remaining brother
to return all that was once given.
flavour.FourUniqueRing14:
It coils deeper and deeper
It slithers between thoughts
It lies beneath the valley
It lies in our minds
flavour.FourUniqueRing15:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.
flavour.FourUniqueRing16:
Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart
flavour.FourUniqueRing17:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.
flavour.FourUniqueRing18:
Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.
flavour.FourUniqueRing19:
The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved
together as one, shoulder to shoulder.
flavour.FourUniqueRing20: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
flavour.FourUniqueRing21:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.
flavour.FourUniqueRing22:
Power comes to those who seek
Death comes to those who reach
flavour.FourUniqueRing23:
When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain,
and the last thought that flickered through his
fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.
flavour.FourUniqueRing24: They wrap around you until your blood turns as cold as theirs.
flavour.FourUniqueRing25: God blesses those who bless themselves.
flavour.FourUniqueRing26a:
"Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.FourUniqueRing26b:
"From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.FourUniqueRing26c:
"With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.FourUniqueRing27:
"Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.FourUniqueRing28: A pact with Prospero always comes at a price.
flavour.FourUniqueRing29: Danger is the price of wealth.
flavour.FourUniqueRing2a:
Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of 
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.
flavour.FourUniqueRing2b:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.
flavour.FourUniqueRing3: Agony brings clarity to those of pure mind.
flavour.FourUniqueRing30:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.
flavour.FourUniqueRing31: The darker the eye, the more diligent the watched.
flavour.FourUniqueRing32: Power is a matter of perspective.
flavour.FourUniqueRing33:
Drink deeply of the Well.
Let the Abyss coil within.
flavour.FourUniqueRing34:
The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit 
they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's. 
In time, the merest touch could break their reality.
flavour.FourUniqueRing4:
As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange
blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above,
blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.
flavour.FourUniqueRing5: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.
flavour.FourUniqueRing6: The dawn of a new era is set into motion
flavour.FourUniqueRing7: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.
flavour.FourUniqueRing8:
"The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets.
Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."
flavour.FourUniqueRitual1:
Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.
flavour.FourUniqueRitual2:
They crawl and chitter and swarm
in the shadow of his presence.
flavour.FourUniqueRitual3:
Experiments with geomancy taught
the Maji more than they ever expected.
flavour.FourUniqueRitual4:
In an endless war against darkness,
one must be ever vigilant.
flavour.FourUniqueSanctum1:
The final element the tale-women
mastered was Time itself.
flavour.FourUniqueSanctum3:
"We survived the endless winter.
We endure the long summer.
One day, spring will return the rains."
flavour.FourUniqueSanctum4a:
The Vaal protected those who integrated into their 
culture. Many neighbours became one. Sekhema Safrin 
vowed the Maraketh identity would remain resolute.
flavour.FourUniqueSanctum4b:
During the Winter of the World, her akhara began
shepherding jingakh across the harsh Vastiri. Sekhema
Eshtera planted the seeds of Maraketh diplomacy.
flavour.FourUniqueSanctum4c:
The relative peace under the fledgling Empire saw
the first Sekhema to choose, in her resplendent age and
wisdom, to step down. The role of Zaitema was born.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre1:
Rare is the Necromancer who leads
his undead armies from the front.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre14:
Darkness howls through ancient bones, a wistful cry
on hollow winds. The moon listens. The pack gathers.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre2: Her sons sang with hate and mockery, their howling twisted in dark harmony.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre4:
Tale-women may not fight directly,
for they have a much higher purpose.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre6:
"When the Third Pact was written in stone, the Dreamer gave the alliance of men and
beasts knowledge. In return, they gave him a drop of blood; one from each of the
races of Wraeclast. In the centuries that followed, his Will began to subtly change."
- Book of the Benevolent Dreamer, Histories 220:5
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre6a:
"Power of the Red Pyre! Flaming Heart of the Hive!
I release your burning message to rest here, forevermore."
The Dreamer declared, casting out the lingering dark embers within him.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre6b:
"With piercing eyes, you saw through the Stillness.
Undulating as one, you gloriously covered all in white. 
But... I can bear you no longer."
The Dreamer whispered with fogging breath, ice creeping down his hand.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre6c:
"Deep in thought, you would tremble the very air before you.
Wreathed in light, you nurtured them all. 
And yet... Your nature became you."
The Dreamer mused with aching heart, as remnants of forking tendrils burst forth.
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre6d:
"We sometimes fail. We sometimes succeed. Who determines one from the other?
I now know we can never be made One, if we are bore of differing desires.
And yet, I have hope for a new truth. And I will see it... made real."
- The Benevolent Dreamer
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre7:
"Drink deep. Unlife depends on life. Yours,
to be specific." - Selassie of the Black Fen
flavour.FourUniqueSceptre8:
A chilling hush, a scraping sound
Of things no more entombed in ground.
A shambling horde is on its way
To crush the very light of day.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex1:
"A thief in the night, Draven did creep,
families asleep, taken, held on high.
Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid.
Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex10:
Light as a board,
Stiff as a feather.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex11_: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex12:
"Lundara held back the hordes, while Solerai rose to split the sky.
With a single stroke, she ended the Winter of the World."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex14:
"As long as I see death in my mirror, so will Wraeclast."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex2:
Light and shadow chase eternal,
but neither knows the other exists...
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex3:
"Resist for long enough, and your oppressor
will lose his will. Then, you've won."
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex4:
A window onto a realm of red,
where countless voices scream...
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex5: Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex6:
As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to
feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldDex7: An eye for an eye. A curse for a curse.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr1:
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate
the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr10:
Tukohama knew that he could not lose a fight in his fortress.
So he carried his fortress to the fight.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr12:
Lunaris crossed silently, shining and full,
Softly night left her, alone and forlorn.
Solaris rose to meet her, feeling her pull.
'Neath the midday sun, the night was reborn.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr13:
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr14:
"Upon plains of endless chill,
They Who Never Tire... dominate.
They Who Never Surrender... terrify.
 And They Who Lay Beneath... wait for Nightfall."
- Tul, She That Silences
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr2:
The Counts of Ogham share a
legacy of cunning and power.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr4:
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare,
the Saviour will build Utopia."
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr6: A true predator does not chase; It waits.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStr8:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex1:
The unending carnage of war
mercilessly grinds away
at body and mind.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex12:
From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's
gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease.
True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex2: Lead by example, and you shall never be alone.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex3:
The Wildwood was a gift, meant as a haven
against the Winter of the World.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex4: Ride the western wind, and take flight.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex5:
Crimson burn'd the star of sadness,
All was woe that seem'd but gladness.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex8: Not even the storm knows when lightning will strike.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrDex9:
Never let the audience know your true form.
Misdirect them, beguile them.
Strike when they least expect it.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt11:
Born from the marriage of ice and sky,
the aurora evokes both awe and power.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt2: The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt3: A swift mind solves problems before they occur.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt4:
When the Red Sekhema called,
the Ardura were the first to answer.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt5: When blood is paid, the weak think twice.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt6:
My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
flavour.FourUniqueShieldStrInt9: Be not blinded by the light.
flavour.FourUniqueSpear1: The Baleful Gem's corruption lingers still...
flavour.FourUniqueSpear13:
The spear was specially forged to assassinate Voll,
but Maligaro never got a chance to use it...
flavour.FourUniqueSpear14:
"My people? I'm not doing this for them.
They belong to me. They want this for me.
Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love
and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."
flavour.FourUniqueSpear15: May the Lightless drown in the violence of His devotion.
flavour.FourUniqueSpear2:
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable,
but rebels of every culture stood together as one.
flavour.FourUniqueSpear3: The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.
flavour.FourUniqueSpear4: Heads fall to the sand, just as the star fell from the sky
flavour.FourUniqueSpear5:
"You killed their Golden Sekhema. The Maraketh will think of nothing
but vengeance now." - Dimos, Advisor to General Titucius
flavour.FourUniqueSpear6:
"In the hands of Orbala, it made a god bleed."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
flavour.FourUniqueSpear7:
Born in a star of man's own make,
fused to her hand by her last mistake.
flavour.FourUniqueSpirit1:
To become a warrior and a hunter, each young
Azmeri must prove themselves before the Spirit.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff1: The candlemass tradition was born in a time of darkness and fear.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff13:
In ghastly pits beneath the world,
Kulemak grows countless new bodies,
each more powerful than the last.
Not all of his abominations survive.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff14:
"From what beast you derived, we can only fathom.
Aye, you of living ice, rotting gill, and untold nightmare!
We Brinerot return ye to the sea."
- Weylam Roth
flavour.FourUniqueStaff15:
With Kulemak dead and the Abyssals destroyed, the
Master Below All could do nothing but wait... and plan.
As the cold crept in, an age of gods and heroes began.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff16:
For three centuries, the Wayward Druid returned each
spring to bless the lands of Ogham. None knew from
whence he came, or where he went, but he was loved.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff17: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff18:
"Where the boy went, ravens gathered,
feasting on misery. His vile influence
spread, swift as the carnage they wrought."
flavour.FourUniqueStaff2:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff3: An ancient Azmeri staff, overgrown by roots...
flavour.FourUniqueStaff5:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.
flavour.FourUniqueStaff6: That which was broken may yet break.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet1:
In his broken madness, Xesht spills forth the hordes,
reaching out to wreak pain and ruination.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet10:
The Well was naught.
The Precursors dug too deep.
The Well always had been.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet11:
For a brief shining time, the Precursors
could resculpt the world as they saw fit.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet2:
Before the starlight barrier failed, before the end came,
countless Kalguuran settlers sought a new life on Wraeclast.
Of the towns they founded and the lives they lived, little remains...
flavour.FourUniqueTablet3:
A simple instruction that will purify an entire region,
making it safe and kind for weary travellers.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet4:
When darkness comes, we pray for light.
When darkness is all that there is,
we pray for death.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet5:
"I see a pattern in these towers. Whoever the Precursors were, they sought to master
this world, to shape it as they saw fit. My people had the same ambition..."
flavour.FourUniqueTablet7:
"If they had ever completed the tower network,
it could have changed the face of the world..."
flavour.FourUniqueTablet8:
Darkness and light, naught but forest between.
As the forest fades, the twilight hunt begins.
flavour.FourUniqueTablet9:
The lash of the whip,
the ire of the tithe...
the press of the boot.
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman1:
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr
followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested
island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman10:
"A traditional hatungo does not carry an axe,
it is true. But as Narumoa showed us, there
are many ways to crush one's enemy..."
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman14:
Gruthkul was the Mother of Despair...
but one day, the Father will return,
and discover the fate of his children.
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman2:
If you see the blushing tree of the northern woods,
remember: "Blossoms of red, the tree's been fed.
Blossoms of white, prepare for a fight."
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman4:
In a time of great need, surrounded by Abyssals,
the Wayward Druid came to the Sun Clan's aid.
It is a debt they have never forgotten.
flavour.FourUniqueTalisman8:
Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe learned
how to tap into the flow of Vivid lifeforce to
'cooperate' with their enemies... forcefully.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace1:
There was a very clear and delicious
reason why the Ezomytes chose to
stop their flight and settle in Phaaryl.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace10:
"Drunken Erqi boasted to Tukohama; the God of War
challenged him to a clash of strength. Woe to the
Divine - he should have made it a test of skill!"
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace13:
The secret Order endured by publicly
praying however the Templars demanded.
One day, justice would fall upon them...
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace14: Infinite mutations over endless eons borne upon it in a singular moment.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace2:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
