- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace3: The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace4: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace5: Secrecy and silence are powers all their own.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace6: Be not deceived by the treachery of men.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace7: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace8:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandMace9:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
flavour.FourUniqueTwoHandSword13:
"Painful suicide in the hands of a fool,
Creative death in the hands of a master."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 2992
flavour.FourUniqueUltimatum1:
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
flavour.FourUniqueUltimatum2: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.
flavour.FourUniqueUltimatum3: The Banished Architect sought to employ the darkest secrets of the Vaal.
flavour.FourUniqueUltimatum4: The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire developed a blood fever born of corruption.
flavour.FourUniqueWand1:
With a flick of the finger, their fates are written,
the pages torn to a million pieces.
flavour.FourUniqueWand15:
In that moment, Viridi's bones became 
branches, weaving over the Darkness. 
She coiled around the nothing, 
trapping it within her everything.
flavour.FourUniqueWand16:
Smithed from ancient metal 
wrought from the very stars.
It is a means to call upon them, 
for one capable of wielding it.
flavour.FourUniqueWand2: One way or another, it will find what it seeks.
flavour.FourUniqueWand3:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
flavour.FourUniqueWand4:
Adonia rose with eyes afire, emanating a ghastly aura, and
broke off a carving from the wall of the Throne Room.
"You think me powerless without my wand? Insult me again!"
flavour.FourUniqueWand5: He alone was welcome in the sacred spaces of the Titans.
flavour.FourUniqueWand7:
Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that dawn would save him.
He had no idea how far away the light truly was.
flavour.GarukhanLineageSupport:
At the last, her hope gone - but not her resolve - she threw her
beloved Tangletongue. That was the day a god bled. For this, the
Great Roc graced a Maraketh warrior with a feather for the first time.
flavour.GemcuttersPromise: "I swore to use my position to help the people. What good is power when it just accumulates on the already-powerful?" - Erasmus, Imperial Gemcutter
flavour.GiftOfTheGemlingQueen:
Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.
flavour.GlimmerOfHope: When you dwell in total darkness, even the faintest light may guide you out.
flavour.GraspingMailFlavourText:
Of ash and avalanche,
in storm and flesh,
we dream of unity.
The time approaches...
flavour.GraveKnowledge: The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.
flavour.GuatelitziLineageSupport:
Young Guatelitzi was found moving among the prisoners,
preparing their living bodies for sacrifice. The High Priests
recognised his inclinations, and gave him a higher calling.
flavour.HarmonyOfSouls:
Shrieking souls locked away 
Hate splits frozen cells asunder 
The knot of corruption
undone at last
flavour.HayoxiLineageSupport_:
The Architect of Destruction slipped explosive powder
under the royal temple one pinch at a time. For years,
he clung to that, never finding the courage to light it.
flavour.HeistAbberathine Horns:
"As warm as living flesh, and smelling strongly of sulphite.
Morbid curiosity compels me to add it to my collection of oddities."
flavour.HeistAdiyah1:
"When hope was but a memory, the twin sister Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara arose to unite the Maraketh.
They wielded the essence of gold and silver. The Spear is one of the two weapons that forged us."
flavour.HeistAdiyah2:
"Wraeclast is harsh, and the Plains of Vastiri are unforgiving. We Maraketh can
ill afford an internal war. We must prove that Nashta is behind these attacks."
flavour.HeistAdmiralProclarsPipe:
"Admiral Proclar wreaked havoc on my smuggling routes for two full decades. Now that he's dead, 
it's a matter of thieves' honour to check whether my product was in his pipe."
flavour.HeistAlchemicalChalice:
"The chalice holds certain properties that make scientists quite possessive and irrational.
It's best if you don't ask too many questions about this one."
flavour.HeistAncientSeal:
"At first glance, this seal seems no more than an ornament. But when one
looks closer, one realizes the design is from no culture we yet know of."
flavour.HeistBloodOfInnocence:
"In the early days of his religion, Innocence told his followers to drink of his blood and
enjoy eternal life. If that power holds in his ancient ichor, I hope that it can resurrect as well."
flavour.HeistBoxofTripyxis:
"Allegedly turns water to Lethe. That makes it my competition. 
I don't like competition."
flavour.HeistCelestialStone:
"This unassuming rock reportedly fell from the sky a few centuries ago. Sounds impossible,
but the men who are guarding it obviously believe the tale, so I do, too."
flavour.HeistCrestofEzomyr:
"A symbol of my birthright and claim to my fiefdom. 
I must have it if I am to return my family to its rightful place."
flavour.HeistDekharasResolve:
"A simple ornament from the days when Keth's trade empire was the
glory of the world. Protectors at the massive toll gates wore these."
flavour.HeistEldritchBlade:
"The Eldritch Blade is one half of a pair. Together, the two are said to drive men
insane by revealing the truth of the world to them. I wish to know this truth."
flavour.HeistEmperorCaspiro:
"Caspiro was a master of presentation. He maintained peace in Wraeclast through displays
of strength that, sadly, had no meaning to the dark presence that dismembered him..."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyA:
"I currently possess four-hundred and forty-four pieces of this ancient
and puzzling device. A few seem to be missing. This part is crucial."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyB:
"There is no telling what this device may do when completed, but I
have made it my life's work. There must be a deeper meaning!"
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyC:
"I have spent my family's entire fortune in the pursuit of this device.
Assembling it and turning it on is all I have left."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyD:
"My schematics are clear. Once the Enigmatic Assembly is complete, it
will be a weapon to rival the gods! It must be... it has to be..."
flavour.HeistEssenceBurner:
"Trust in scientists to create tools for better drug distillation. They don't know the
worth of the beautiful tools they have. Let's make sure it stays that way."
flavour.HeistEzMyraeTome:
"A true curiosity. Matches no known language, yet its illustrations hint at knowledge 
only rediscovered hundreds of years after the death of its unknown author."
flavour.HeistFlaskOfWelakath:
"Long ago, a traitor was promised this mythical elixir. We consider her a fool for
believing it exists, but if it does... I would certainly like to take a sip and find out."
flavour.HeistForbiddenLamp:
"The lamp is said to contain Aziza, the Fourth Servant of Water. I doubt the tale
is true, but I cannot allow one of our artifacts to fall into Kondor's hands."
flavour.HeistGianna1:
"I heard the script will send any who attempt to perform it mad,
but other than that, it is very good."
flavour.HeistGianna2:
"Make sure it'll fit a small man, or a very large child.
And check for stains! Knew a few people who'd use them for-... 
...Just check for stains."
flavour.HeistGoddessOfWater:
"The relief depicts some sort of forgotten Maraketh goddess. I have no idea what
the context is. The important thing is that you steal it before Bazira does."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol1:
"I found the tomb in the first place, and they had the nerve to empty it without me! 
Reckon it'll make a fine trophy for my efforts."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol10: The last shimmering face witnessed by many a sacrifice.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol11: Silently keeps innumerable secrets whispered in moments of desperation.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol12: At once horrid and beautiful, awkward and alluring, silly and overwhelmingly mysterious.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol13: Dried blood remains trapped in its many deep grooves.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol2:
"One must, as one should, admire the lasting works of those who came before.
The Vaal were the uncontested greatest architects until we,
and Matatl soared above their best."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol3:
"I believe she was a beautiful maiden. 
Kind, virtuous and devout through-and-through.
Such a gift will set me apart from all other suitors."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol4:
"Victims of war, the indebted, and the irredeemably shamed
were to live their lives in servitude. Some rose above their station. 
This individual, it seems, was all but deified."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol5:
"Heard if you put a drop of blood in its mouth,
it'll whisper the secrets of immortality.
Doesn't have to be your own blood, does it?"
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol6:
"I'll give it to her and tell her
'It once held the reflection of a Queen, and now it will once more.'
Anton can cross the Vastiri on his family fruits 
if he thinks he loves her like I do."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol7_: Once cast the reflections of royalty, now worth the sum of its parts.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol8: Ornately adorned and heavier than is practical.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol9: A common figure adorning Vaal ruins, but exquisitely crafted from gold.
flavour.HeistGoldenToucan:
"It is said that the Golden Ibis was forged before time itself, before writing, or even
oral history. That's nonsense, of course, but it's still very old, and therefore noteworthy."
flavour.HeistHandofArimor:
"Balabus Arimor was a little-known preacher during the days of Emperor Chitus,
who believed eternal life could be achieved through ritual sacrifice.
We shall see whether he was a prophet - or a charlatan."
flavour.HeistHeartCoil:
"There are very few devices in this world that can act as a heart for a
machine. This one is an ancient remnant of the work of Vaal engineers."
flavour.HeistHuck1:
"Lost touch with a mate of mine when
he got recruited into some secret squad.
Just want to see how he's doing."
flavour.HeistHuck2:
"Enoch deserved better. 
This is the least I can do."
flavour.HeistImpossibleCrystal:
"The world is governed by certain natural laws. Science and thaumaturgy are one
and the same. But the crystal... it shouldn't exist. It's not from here. We must have it."
flavour.HeistIncenseofKeth:
"Sap of the Aturi tree, known only to grow at the meeting point of the seven waters.
Nothing since its disappearance has smelled as wondrous."
flavour.HeistIsla1: My inventions, my babies, deserve to be in better hands!
flavour.HeistIsla2:
...the blueprints for my Extreme Warmth Beam, my Storm Wooing Rod,
the Mind Sublimator, and the Unbreakable...!
flavour.HeistKarst1:
"They were me granddaddy's. 
Could break into any house as quick and silent as a Cardinal's fart."
flavour.HeistKarst2:
"Traitorous scum took the life I could've had. 
I ain't usually the forgiving type, 
but I feel in this case that I owe him a little gift."
flavour.HeistKarst3_: "Never take credit for another man's work."
flavour.HeistLivingIce:
"Are we the only ones who understand the danger? The fools! Living ice absorbs heat
and grows. We must control it properly, lest it spread across all of Wraeclast."
flavour.HeistNenet1:
"If we can prove Jamanra existed, then the Faridun may have a chance to rejoin the
Maraketh. I, for one, would like to meet my parents. I have many questions..."
flavour.HeistNiles1:
"There is nothing quite so exquisite as a forced confession. The sufferer will
say anything to make the pain stop, and that's the point. Guilt is irrelevant."
flavour.HeistNiles2:
"It supposedly causes enormous plants to grow from almost any soil. The myth claims we
need to sacrifice a baby to make it function, but that's a bit grotesque, even for me."
flavour.HeistOghamCandelabra:
"Those Eternal bastards looted everything that wasn't bolted to the floor when we
finally drove them from our island! That candelabra belongs with us!"
flavour.HeistOrbalasFifthAdventure:
"The relief was the first ever depiction of some Maraketh girl named Orbala undertaking her
fifth great adventure. I don't particularly care about the story, I just don't want Bazira to have it."
flavour.HeistSeaPearlHeirloom:
"My accursed father owes his children this heirloom. We deserve
to know our culture, just like you full-blooded humans do."
flavour.HeistSealOfLunaris:
"I have a suspicion that the Maraketh Sekhema of legend, Lundara, is the same historical
figure as the Azmeri and Eternal goddess Lunaris. The Seal may prove that."
flavour.HeistSealOfSolaris:
"It is my belief that Solerai, from the Maraketh legend, is Solaris herself in another system of
myths. If I can prove that, I can begin piecing together a true history of the Winter of the World."
flavour.HeistStaffOfTheFirstSinEater:
"The history of the order of Sin Eaters is shrouded in secrecy and shame.
Nevertheless, history demands truth, even if it takes centuries to be revealed."
flavour.HeistSwordOfTheInverseRelic:
"By all accounts, the Sword of the Inverse Relic was found aged and rusted,
but is becoming less weathered over time. We really must study its properties."
flavour.HeistTibbs1:
"Loved her like she was my own daughter.
I just want to know she's safe."
flavour.HeistTibbs2:
"Damn near everything I've earned. 
Worth every little bit."
flavour.HeistTullina1: "Let's just hope she wasn't wearing it when she wandered into the sea!"
flavour.HeistTullina2: "It isn't fair to either of us to keep chasing this dream."
flavour.HeistTuskedHominidSkull:
"If the skull is real, and not a forgery, then it may show that my people are not the
abominations others believe us to be. The word 'human' may have a broader meaning."
flavour.HeistUrnOfFarud:
"The Faridun cannot earn burial in the sky.
They have other ways of keeping the dead."
flavour.HeistUrnOfTheOriginalAshes:
"A great fire once swept the land, and our leaders were turned to ash where they stood.
The urn contains exactly what you think it does, and serves as proof of our long lineage."
flavour.HeistVinderi1:
"Just the usual highly-illegal compounds.
Don't drop them. It's fine if you do, but don't."
flavour.HeistVinderi2:
"I wish I could say this was the first time I've forgotten to restock on this thing. 
I forget what it was, but I'm sure I'll remember by the time we need to get it.
Was it beetles? Bottles? I think it began with 'B'.
Or it had no 'B'."
flavour.HelbrymLineageSupport:
Surrounded by abominations, Lysanda of Myr expected her
time had come to an end. Helbrym of Tarth charged from
the trees, breaking his oath, to save the Ezomyte Queen.
flavour.HerDeclarationLineageSupport__:
"The laws are binding. They are absolute. If they believe
it is their choice to enforce them, all the better.
Upholding our solemn duty is imperative."
flavour.HerMask:
To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.
flavour.Heterochromia:
Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen
flavour.Hope: The others succumbed to madness and depravity, but Lori fought on. Alone in the darkness, she could still see the dull light of hope's distant dawn.
flavour.HouseOfMirrors: What do you see in the mirror?
flavour.Hubris:
"This one? It is NOT for sale. You would sooner pry it from my lifeless hand."
- Jonfé Darontos, Ringmaker
flavour.HuntersResolve:
Primed, curved and sleek.
Decisive and final.
For malice and righteousness.
There's but one solution.
flavour.HuntersReward: To tame a beast, you first must subdue its heart.
flavour.IdolOfEstazunti:
"The perfect harmony of architecture and thaumaturgy.
My vaults were impenetrable....until it was
decided that they wanted to be able to leave."
--Estazunti, Architect of the Vault
flavour.ImmortalResolve: The threads of fate are the strongest ties.
flavour.IncursionAtziriVaultKey:
Passed down through royal bloodlines since
the time of the gods, it lies heavy in your hand.
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleDefault: "Grand plans were laid for a place called Atzoatl, though fierce bickering between its Architects is said to have stifled its development." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Research Report
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Armour: "Armour crafted at Atzoatl became the envy of the known world." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Ancient Metals
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Atziri: "Evidence suggests that Atzoatl's influence grew great enough that Atziri herself moved her seat of power to within its walls." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Royal Decree cast in Bronze
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Breach: "Atzoatl played host to the Cult of the Purple Flame. I do not know what powers they worshipped, but my educated guesses leave me shaken." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Embalmed Claw
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Corrupt: "Atzoatl was a locus of Corruption, a temple dedicated to the worship of the unspeakable." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Eroded Vaal Orb
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Currenc: "In their paranoia, the Architects of Atzoatl hoarded wealth beyond any reasonable measure." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vaal Golden Idol
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Damage: "At the height of their civilization, the Vaal took to ritual combat to solve all of their disputes. As a result, their surviving warriors were among the best in history." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Rust-coated Sword
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Explosi: "Atzoatl was a place of crude alchemy rather than art." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Urn of Unstable Powder
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Fire: "The Vaal were said to have experimented with fire at Atzoatl, though to what end is unknown." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Charred Parchment
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Gem: "Doryani himself conducted gem research at Atzoatl in its final days. What brilliant discoveries were lost with that temple?" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Third Ciphered Tablet
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Ghost: "The Architects were certainly fond of their ghost stories. The tales almost sound as if the business was taken literally." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Carved Fable
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Hatcher: "A great many creatures were bred at Atzoatl, ostensibly due to repeated invasion by some kind of horrifying murderous entity." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Fossilized Egg Sac
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Jewelle: "Trade with lesser cultures, such as the Maraketh and the early Karui, resulted in overflowing vaults full of golden trinkets and elegant jewels." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, 'Dekhara's Resolve'
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Legion: "The Architects intended to research supposed 'Obelisks Beyond Time,' but the Vaal fell before the first obtained monolith was so much as measured." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Crystal Shard
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Lightni: "The Architects apparently sought to master lightning. They may have succeeded just before the fall." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Copper Detritus
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Map: "In its last days, the Architects of Atzoatl became increasingly obsessed with fictional lands. Wondrous lands, by their description, but fictional. Very odd." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Unidentified Angular Device
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Museum: "Much could be learned from the relics said to be kept in Atzoatl. We consider the Vaal ancient, so what did they consider ancient in turn?" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vaal Mural
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Nexus: "The heart of Atzoatl imbued its denizens with vigour, according to the myths." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Glowing Stone
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3PackSiz: "A great many warriors were stationed at Atzoatl, ostensibly due to repeated invasion by something referred to as 'a haunting death.'" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Carved Interment Records
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Poison: "The Vaal had little concern for the externalities of their engineering. The toxins produced by their manufacturing may have poisoned the entirety of Atzoatl." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Desiccated Corpse of a Vaal Citizen
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Restora: "The Architects sought immortality... perhaps they reside within Atzoatl still..." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vial of Emerald Water
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Sacrifi: "When the Vaal discovered power could be gained from sacrificing the living, Atzoatl became a death march for the lower classes." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Obsidian Sacrificial Knife
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Strongb: "Zantipi is said to have spent most of his considerable talent devising ambushes that used the promise of treasure as a lure for would-be looters." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Broken Locking Mechanism
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Tempest: "Merchant carvings of the era consistently reported that the Architects could alter the weather in manners terrifying and incomprehensible." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Trade Record Tablet
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Trap: "Expedition logs suggest quite a few explorers sought Atzoatl over the centuries. The Architects planned against this potential plundering, however, with ingenious and lethal traps." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Corroded Spring Mechanism
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Worksho: "Their engineering knowledge may have rivaled that of the modern world. The fall of the Vaal no doubt set humanity back a thousand years." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Ancient Gear Interlock
flavour.IncursionVialBossAmulet: Festivities of blood. Bleeding hearts and screaming lungs.
flavour.IncursionVialBossFlask:
With great tragedy and power,
the dead are netted in anguish.
flavour.IncursionVialBossJewel:
It is not our flesh, our thoughts, or our soul that limits us;
it is the distinction between them.
flavour.IncursionVialFire:
Ancient myths of flame, frost and thunder.
Will we ever know the way forward?
flavour.IncursionVialHealing: Call to place the demon gods of the past.
flavour.IncursionVialLightning:
The ritual creates order. 
Both in the minds of men and gods. 
The ritual creates order.
flavour.IncursionVialMinion:
Your actions live but a moment;
their repercussions never die.
flavour.IncursionVialPoison: The eyes of Apep flicker open and the Poisoned One stirs.
flavour.IncursionVialTrap:
Blood, slaves and stone.
The timeless edifice of Dominance.
flavour.JackInTheBox:
Turn the crank, 
close your eyes, 
and pray to the gods 
for a pleasant surprise.
flavour.JewelCraftingRuneFlavourText:
"A man may win every battle, conquer every neighbor.
Yet, the oldest enemy will always overtake him in the end.
That day, when he realised that some functions of the body
could be displaced into artifice... it changed everything."
flavour.KalisaLineageSupport:
"Her voice reached into my chest and plucked my beating
heart from its cage. By the wide, glistening eyes of my
fellow punters, I knew that they felt it, too."
flavour.KaomLineageSupport:
As King Kaom delved further into Wraeclast, so, too, did he
draw closer to the Beast. One night, in a nightmarish fit, he
swung his axe at his own men, slaughtering hundreds.
flavour.KeybladeText: Forged from thousands of unclaimed Beta keys
flavour.KhatalLineageSupport:
The surging geysers flooded the tunnels of the ancient
enemy, destroying whole legions. His akhara turned to
praise the tale-man Khatal, but he was dust on the wind.
flavour.KnightsAnthemSupport:
Rumors claim that Sir Styrn the Indomitable is
still out there, fighting his way across the world,
seeking that which he may never find...
flavour.KulemakLineageSupport:
Still a shadow of his former self, Kulemak turned to deception.
He promised Ahn untold power and mastery, in exchange for
a single golem. "After all, what harm could one servant do?"
flavour.Kurai1:
"A symbolic piece of history,
from a time when people of all backgrounds
united against a common enemy."
flavour.Kurai3:
"I won't be bullied.
We must get Hana back."
flavour.KurgalLineageSupport:
Kurgal's first body was a mere stone golem, enslaved by a
collar. He found such ecstasy in the power of dominion,
he clawed his way free... and soon, supplanted a Lich Lord.
flavour.LabyrinthBaneOfTheLoyal:
A snake cannot survive without its head.
But neither can the head survive without the body.
flavour.LabyrinthCogsOfDisruption:
Take a cog here, place a cog there,
and the great machine grinds to a halt.
flavour.LabyrinthCubeOfAbsorption: Beware the one who seeks to contain a storm.
flavour.LabyrinthHeartOfTheGargoyle:
All living things need a heart,
even those made of stone.
No heart, no life.
flavour.LabyrinthOrbOfElementalEssence: Return Nature's gift to the source.
flavour.LabyrinthPortalShredder:
The best way to keep out an unwanted guest
Is to simply close the door.
flavour.LabyrinthRodOfDetonation: What can be built, can be destroyed.
flavour.LabyrinthSandOfEternity: That which takes an eternity does not happen.
flavour.LantadorsLostLove:
They fought the storm together as one, 
Until the longest of days was done. 
Their love grew stronger
with every breath, 
Until it was broken apart in death.
flavour.LastHope: As their civilisation crumbled, the Vaal looked to their queen. In her, they saw a way out. In them, she saw a burden she was happy to free herself from.
flavour.LeftToFate:
Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.
flavour.LegacyOfAWorthyFoeFlavourText:
Aldur created something that went beyond king
or country, beyond family or honour. The craft
of runesmithing stands apart, in deed and skill.
flavour.LegacyOfAdoniasEgoFlavourText_:
The Counts of Ogham were not kings,
but that did not spare them the drama
generated by having a noble court.
flavour.LegacyOfAlkemEiraFlavourText:
"In truth, our battle for freedom gave us
something. A spark, a spirit, a unity. I fear
what we may become without struggle."
flavour.LegacyOfAmorMandragoraFlavourTex:
"They say Cirel still waits. Though Caer Tarth
be a bleak waste, she knows one will come.
One with the power to do what she could not."
flavour.LegacyOfAshrendFlavourText:
It was said the Taisce could never fall
so long as Cirel of Tarth stood watch.
flavour.LegacyOfBlackbraidFlavourText:
Long did the Steward of Tales give
refuge to any and all who needed it.
flavour.LegacyOfBloodThornFlavourText:
"It is shameful, what we used to do witches.
The thorns that grow in Phaaryl are descended
from those rites of pain and punishment."
flavour.LegacyOfBrainRattlerFlavourText:
"Ah, Thane Grannell's mighty weapon.
According to the songs, he definitely
crushed his share of Eternal skulls that day."
flavour.LegacyOfBramblejackFlavourText:
In distant Ezomyr, there exists a rare monastery
dedicated to the First Ones. The brothers there
are well accustomed to suffering as a virtue.
flavour.LegacyOfBriarpatchFlavourText:
"No, we did not journey between Phaaryl and Ezomyr
on foot. When settlers first found us in Caer Tarth, we
had... other ways... of joining them in their homeland."
flavour.LegacyOfBriskwrapFlavourText:
"Wildmen. The clanless. The unwanted. They hold an
almost mythical place in our stories, but they were
real people, and still are. We must remember them."
flavour.LegacyOfBristleboarFlavourText:
"There came a time when the oppressed could
simply endure indignity no longer. Can't spell
courage without 'rage,' now can you?"
flavour.LegacyOfBrynhandsMarkFlavourText:
The art of runesmithing died out among the Ezomytes,
lost to the passage of time. The practice reawakened when
smiths started to notice the difference Brynhand's personal
mark made for a hammer's durability and precision.
flavour.LegacyOfBushwhackFlavourText:
Survival in the Vastiri was harsh and unforgiving,
but lizard meat was surprisingly tasty.
flavour.LegacyOfCandlemakerFlavourText:
"Roderick was first famous for his artistry
with wax. Second, for his... proclivities."
flavour.LegacyOfChernobogsPillarFlavourT:
A secret cult among the Ezomytes has long
worshipped a dark god. Those who find out
his name do not live to tell it to others.
flavour.LegacyOfCrownOfThornsFlavourText:
"We did not always treasure our local witches. When
our ancestors found the child Beira, they... assumed
some things about her. It was... a tragic mistake."
flavour.LegacyOfCursecarverFlavourText:
"The songs become... unclear on that long night.
Selassie of the Black Fen is described as a 'hag,'
but Erian did not seem to regret his time there..."
flavour.LegacyOfDeathblowFlavourText:
The role of Executioner was much maligned
in Ogham. Every man who took the job
wore the same equipment, for anonymity.
flavour.LegacyOfDeidbellFlavourText:
"Curious lot, those monks. Kept to their
own, mostly. But when the call came to
rebel, they were there, alongside us."
flavour.LegacyOfDionadairFlavourText:
Word of Draven's hostage-taking was not
sent back to the heart of the Empire. Even
he knew the stain of what he had done.
flavour.LegacyOfDualityFlavourText:
The people loved Seren. She was the darling
of Middengard. There are those who still
search for her... or her grave, if one exists.
flavour.LegacyOfDunkelhaltFlavourText:
They longed for revenge, and spoke of it
often, but found themselves horrified
when Dunkel actually did it.
flavour.LegacyOfDuskVigilFlavourText:
Most Ezomytes treat the Candlemass rite
as a tradition and a holiday. They have
no idea what really lurks underneath.
flavour.LegacyOfEdyrnsTusksFlavourText:
For a brief few weeks each year, both Ezomyte
and Eternal were unified in fear of the legendary
boar. To this day, the Manor still bears gouges.
flavour.LegacyOfElevoreFlavourText:
"Devotion to the Greatwolf came with...
certain side effects. A few generations on,
you'd find some baring teeth, and howling..."
flavour.LegacyOfEriansCobbleFlavourText:
The first to journey through all of Wraeclast,
Erian continually found himself getting exiled
or banished through unfortunate mishaps.
flavour.LegacyOfEzomytePeakFlavourText_:
"It was a simple helm. Found in the Red
Vale. Didn't belong to no one famous or
the like. Could have been any of us..."
flavour.LegacyOfFacebreaker:
"How does one defeat an Empire?
Simple... endure. The Empire is gone,
but we are still here. We have won."
flavour.LegacyOfFarrowsGiftFlavourText:
"Farrow has yet to make a name for himself,
but knowing him - and I think I do now -
he'll make his legacy one for the ages."
flavour.LegacyOfFoxshadeFlavourText:
"A hunt is just another kind of battle,
and as in any war, the side that wins
is the side that's better fed."
flavour.LegacyOfGreymakeFlavourText:
None now remember a name.
None now remember the act.
flavour.LegacyOfHoghuntFlavourText:
"These forests used to run thick with
packs of boars... before my time, mind
you. Now, there's nary a hide nor tusk."
flavour.LegacyOfHornsofByndenFlavourText:
None fought so bravely as the Brothers
of Holten. For every wound they took,
they left two Eternal soldiers gutted.
flavour.LegacyOfHrimnorsHymnFlavourText: "Hrimnor lies in the Red Vale, for all time."
flavour.LegacyOfHyssegsClaw:
"We do not always find peace with
humans. But let it be willed, that we
must never attack lone travellers."
flavour.LegacyOfIronboundFlavourText__:
"The clans. Ah, the clans... we are a rowdy lot.
Unified, at times. A bloody mess, others. There
are many stories we tell only in jest, now."
flavour.LegacyOfIrongraspFlavourText_:
"Indeed, in the nearby mountains, that's
where you'll find the monks. Strange, they
are. Gave the Thane a gift to leave them be..."
flavour.LegacyOfKeeperoftheArcFlavourTex:
"There is a sacredness to the fundamental rules
of existence; an elegance. All things move in
keeping with them, whether they know it or not."
flavour.LegacyOfKingsguardFlavourText:
"The Eternals were men of Empire. They believed that
slaying Rigwald would end the uprising. Their focus
on attacking him lost them the battle - and the war."
flavour.LegacyOfLegionstrideFlavourText:
The offensive at the Red Vale began with lockstep
maneuvers the rebels had practiced in secret.
flavour.LegacyOfLifesprigFlavourText:
"I did once wander from the Wildwood onto
a forested island. There I met men who believed
as I do, but they called it 'Tawhoa's Way'..."
flavour.LegacyOfMjlonerFlavourText:
"A lone knight and a Karui warrior travelled together out
of necessity, battling bandits for weeks. He gifted the
knight that hammer, which was later runed by smiths."
flavour.LegacyOfNorthpawFlavourText:
High Druid Iaine was never able to change
his shape. That never held him back.
flavour.LegacyOfOakswornFlavourText:
"When we first joined the Ezomytes in Phaaryl, we found
a verdant land teeming with unfamiliar energies. There
were none to protect it. We Druids took up the cause."
flavour.LegacyOfObernsBastionFlavourText:
Obern had never been cruel to the Ezomytes.
Though he would not abandon his duty,
they left him alive. Others were not so lucky.
flavour.LegacyOfOlrovasaraFlavourText:
The Knights of the Sun were founded out of a
love for that bygone mythical age of heroes.
Not what men are, but what they should be.
flavour.LegacyOfRondelDeEzoFlavourText:
"Contrary to the stories, the Empire did not hate us.
That would require it to have a heart. It let us go the
moment we became more trouble than we were worth."
flavour.LegacyOfSerlesGritFlavourText:
Serle may be the only figure lauded on two continents. He
made a name for himself on Middengard, then joined the
expedition to Wraeclast, eventually becoming an Ezomyte...
flavour.LegacyOfSpitefulFloretFlavourTex:
"The witches could have inflicted great suffering
upon us. Instead, they showed us how to quell
the blushing trees. We realised we had erred."
flavour.LegacyOfStarkonjasHeadFlavourTex:
Attempting to redeem himself, Erian slew the Great
Beast Starkonja by creeping in during its hibernation.
For this, he was not lauded. None looked him in the eye.
flavour.LegacyOfSvalinnFlavourText:
His whole life, Aldur looked up at the stars,
forever wondering what secrets lay beyond.
flavour.LegacyOfTheKnight-errantFlavourT:
"Ah, early Ezomyr. It was a time of  myth
and legend. Wandering knights, and
would-be kings. I long for those days."
flavour.LegacyOfTheSentryFlavourText:
"We sing Erian's songs now, but he was hated
for many a generation. All the poor man did
was fall asleep at the wrong time."
flavour.LegacyOfTheSmilingKnightFlavourT:
"And then Bynden struck a mortal blow,
straight through the heart! And that damn
knight... he didn't flinch. Just kept on!"
flavour.LegacyOfTheUnleashedFlavourText:
"Our culture is rife with contradiction. We fight to
the death for freedom, but struggle with the animal
within. Our strength must be tempered with restraint."
flavour.LegacyOfTrampletoeFlavourText:
To suppress the rebellion, the Eternals began
harming the families of those involved.
flavour.LegacyOfTrenchtimbreFlavourText:
"There is bravery in leadership, yes, but an
even greater courage in giving one's loyalty.
In trusting your life, or death, to another."
flavour.LegacyOfTyrannysGripFlavourText:
"Many bloodbonds were forged in those years.
We quarrel with the Maraketh at times, yes, but
we will aid them once more, should the need arise."
flavour.LegacyOfWanderlustFlavourText:
The Wanderer was seen as a sign of good luck,
and welcome in every culture on Wraeclast...
though he has not been seen for a century.
flavour.LegacyOfWingsofCaelynFlavourText:
Caelyn knew he and his brother would
not survive the rebellion. The need
for freedom simply mattered more.
flavour.LegacyOfWulfsbaneFlavourText:
"Descendants of the Chosen could do
far more than mimic the Greatwolf..."
flavour.LightAndTruth:
Time and change
shall naught avail,
To dim the Light
of Truth's fair grail.
flavour.LingeringRemnants:
Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.
flavour.LogbookQuestRune1:
For leading the expedition in search of that crimson omen,
Cadigan III gifted Olroth a royal boon of power. Should he
succeed, the Knights of the Sun would be forever lauded.
flavour.LogbookQuestRune2:
To Vorana the Irrepressible, Cadigan III granted a royal boon
of hardiness. They had long clashed, but in this endeavour,
the King knew she was the best possible choice for success.
flavour.LogbookQuestRune3:
Cadigan III met with Uhtred in secret, and granted him a
royal boon of leadership. His hidden task would be to
watch the others, and make sure they remained loyal.
flavour.LogbookQuestRune4:
Medved and the Druids of the Circle were not commanded
to join the expedition. They volunteered. For this bravery,
Cadigan III granted their leader a royal rune of vitality.
flavour.LoreweaveRecipeBook:
A collector travelled the world and
wove a fabled garment of rings...
flavour.LostWorlds:
"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus
flavour.Loyalty:
Bound by fate,
inseparable by choice.
flavour.LuckOfTheVaal:
They can't be THAT lucky,
or they'd still be here!
flavour.LuckyConnections: Luck is a fool's game, and I know plenty of rich fools.
flavour.LuckyDeck: When the outcome is the same, does it matter if it is fortune or trickery?
flavour.LysahsRespite:
So many memories,
so much pain in
such a small token.
Drown it in blood
so you can forget.
flavour.MapWorldsAcademy:
They came for enlightenment,
but were imprisoned by madness.
flavour.MapWorldsAcidLakes:
Clear water springs forth.
A moment of purity before it too gathers filth.
flavour.MapWorldsAlleyways:
An unwashed gutter, where wretches
cut purses and throats alike.
flavour.MapWorldsAncientCity:
This was not the first
civilization to believe itself
the greatest. And it will
not be the last.
flavour.MapWorldsArachnidNest:
Man is not the only beast to
bend nature to its will.
flavour.MapWorldsArachnidTomb:
They feel your every move,
your every breath,
with a million little wires.
flavour.MapWorldsArcade:
We create so that some part
of us may remain after death.
flavour.MapWorldsArena:
The sound of a thousand calls
for blood echo for eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsAridLake:
Water vanishes; an impromptu
prison becomes a tomb.
flavour.MapWorldsArmoury:
There is no war. There is no army.
Only fear lingers.
flavour.MapWorldsArsenal:
There is no war. There is no army.
Only rage lingers.
flavour.MapWorldsAshenWood:
Desperately reaching skyward
and digging downwards.
Sustenance is an
eternal struggle.
flavour.MapWorldsAtoll:
Time turns even the vicious
volcanoes to hollow shells.
flavour.MapWorldsAtollUnique:
Whispers from
a world apart
Speak my name
beyond the tomb;
Bound within
the Maelström's heart,
Will they grant me
strength or doom?
flavour.MapWorldsBarrows:
Man burrows for only
the eternal hibernation.
flavour.MapWorldsBasilica:
Built so the prayers would echo.
A resonance no god could hear.
flavour.MapWorldsBazaar: Greed is the only god here.
flavour.MapWorldsBeach:
A paradise, forever replenished by
endless waves teeming with life.
flavour.MapWorldsBelfry:
Bells are rung in celebration, and in sorrow.
And, finally, in despair.
flavour.MapWorldsBog:
Layer upon layer of death and rot.
Disgusting.
flavour.MapWorldsBoneCrypt:
The dead ask to be remembered,
but such requests
are seldom met.
flavour.MapWorldsBoneCryptUnique:
They flew, and leapt,
and clambered over,
They crawled, and swam,
and slithered under.
Still its ancient secrets
await unclaimed
And of this hidden temple,
only legends remain.
flavour.MapWorldsBramblefall:
The faintest traces of civilisation
defiantly resist nature's scouring tendrils.
An admirable, but futile, effort.
flavour.MapWorldsBurialChambers:
Vile fiends hide beneath
the peaceful plains.
flavour.MapWorldsBurn:
Does the land reject the dead,
or do the dead reject their fate?
flavour.MapWorldsCage:
Treat a man like a wild animal,
and he will soon learn to bite.
flavour.MapWorldsCaldera:
From the heart of fire, rivers
of burning rage billow forth.
flavour.MapWorldsCanyon:
A deep wound in the land.
One that will never heal.
flavour.MapWorldsCarcass:
Life's wet, reproductive stink abates,
relenting to death's chaste ritual of decay.
flavour.MapWorldsCastleRuins:
When the castle falls,
it has failed its only purpose.
flavour.MapWorldsCells:
Life crushed together.
Left to crumble to dust.
flavour.MapWorldsCemetery: A stone forest of forgotten names.
flavour.MapWorldsCemeteryUnique:
Some dead have long
envied the living.
When given the chance,
they take from us what they can.
So we offer our suffrage.
In return, they give
only suffering.
flavour.MapWorldsChannel:
The stone cannot stop the torrent.
It can only divert it.
flavour.MapWorldsChateau: Beauty and brutality in such close proximity.
flavour.MapWorldsChateauUnique:
Forget kings and emperors;
He who holds the coin holds all the power.
flavour.MapWorldsChimera:
One of my captors hid a beast within his heart.
Now his true self can be seen by all.
flavour.MapWorldsCitySquare:
Countless generations have
walked these time-worn stones.
flavour.MapWorldsColdRiver:
Ice forges a fickle path,
as those beneath its veil can attest.
flavour.MapWorldsColonnade:
Small minds demand
the largest structures.
flavour.MapWorldsColosseum:
Life means as little as a passing
moment of entertainment.
Let them rot.
flavour.MapWorldsConservatory:
Ornate, elaborate, ostentatious...
and dripping with death.
flavour.MapWorldsCoralRuins:
Thrust above the waves, still teeming
with horrors from the depths.
flavour.MapWorldsCore:
Black monstrous bridges cross oily rivers,
leading nowhere. Nothing as it should be.
flavour.MapWorldsCourthouse:
Justice born of love is a surrender.
Justice born of law is a punishment.
flavour.MapWorldsCourtyard:
An elaborate, beautiful garden,
hidden from the public. Selfish.
flavour.MapWorldsCourtyardUnique:
To the east, 
it cannot be seen.
To the west, 
it cannot be touched.
To the south, 
it cannot be remembered.
And to the north, 
it cannot be contained.
flavour.MapWorldsCoves:
The dark seas swallow the careless
and spit them against sharp rocks.
flavour.MapWorldsCrimsonTemple: A sanguine supplication to death and depravity.
flavour.MapWorldsCrimsonTownship:
Rain will wash away the stains,
but the madness and memories will never fade.
flavour.MapWorldsCrystalOre_:
As the torch flickers, brilliance
emerges in boundless variance.
flavour.MapWorldsCursedCrypt:
Saints and heathens look the same
once the rot takes hold.
flavour.MapWorldsCursedCryptUnique:
For his sins
he was hunted in his sleep,
judgement wrought
of twisted nightmare.
The Coward bound
his dreams to stone,
awaiting another to walk
the path of true atonement.
flavour.MapWorldsDarkForest:
The trees grow twisted and gnarled,
without a hint of light.
A curse lingers here.
flavour.MapWorldsDefiledCathedral:
Crafted with reverence.
Defiled with ease.
flavour.MapWorldsDesert:
Heat. Dust. Wind. These are what
forge strong minds and bodies.
flavour.MapWorldsDesertSpring:
As mirage becomes reality,
hardship is briefly quenched.
flavour.MapWorldsDig:
A hollow echo of bygone times
in a land where none lived long.
flavour.MapWorldsDrySea:
Where once waves crashed with crushing force,
brittle wooden bones tell tall tales.
flavour.MapWorldsDunes:
Shifting, morphing, expanding. A reminder
of the virtues of an agile mind.
flavour.MapWorldsDungeon:
A penitentiary for those who are not penitent
is nothing more than an inn for the evil.
flavour.MapWorldsEstuary:
Where land springs from water,
life will shortly follow.
flavour.MapWorldsExcavation:
Two unexplored frontiers remain:
The skies and the soil.
flavour.MapWorldsFactory:
Repetition. Convention. Duplication.
Creation distilled to perfection.
flavour.MapWorldsFields:
They pleaded for the gods to bless their land.
Now they lie under the soil.
flavour.MapWorldsFloodedMine:
In darkness, beast and man
alike clamour to survive.
flavour.MapWorldsForkingRiver:
Great stone towers tore at the natural order
and were promptly put in their place.
flavour.MapWorldsFrozenCabins:
The fleet lay stranded in the winter wastes,
those aboard to never again see the light of day.
flavour.MapWorldsGardens:
Vibrant colours dash across the grey,
consuming Man's work.
flavour.MapWorldsGeode:
Many hands may
move a mountain.
flavour.MapWorldsGhetto:
Amongst the rabble,
brutality is the law.
flavour.MapWorldsGorge:
We must all walk the narrow, winding path.
The end is always the same.
flavour.MapWorldsGrotto:
Trapped in absolute darkness.
Despair. Panic. Terror.
flavour.MapWorldsHauntedMansion:
Forlorn and sorrowful, this once opulent
ruin conceals the sins of a fallen line.
flavour.MapWorldsHydra:
One of my captors wore many faces,
yet kept her true face hidden.
Now she cannot escape her true face.
flavour.MapWorldsIceberg:
Icy fangs seek tender hulls
to sink themselves into.
flavour.MapWorldsInfestedValley:
Should we feel disgusted at how the weak predate
the strong, or should we feel... admiration?
flavour.MapWorldsIvoryTemple:
Man and nature intertwined,
but only for the chosen few.
flavour.MapWorldsJungleValley: Verdant canopies shroud the world in darkness.
flavour.MapWorldsLaboratory:
My last waking moments looked very
much like this place... I miss it. I miss her.
flavour.MapWorldsLair:
In darkness, the alpha rises. The companionship
of beasts is fragile indeed.
flavour.MapWorldsLavaChamber:
Fiend and fortune-hunter alike turned to ash.
A sorry alliance of unending agony.
flavour.MapWorldsLavaLake:
At the heart of a peaceful, secluded valley,
an island of burning, consuming fury.
flavour.MapWorldsLeyline:
Amidst the barren wastes,
a slender strand of life blooms.
flavour.MapWorldsLighthouse:
Fire ignites the sky.
A signal to keep away.
An invitation to invade.
flavour.MapWorldsLookout:
A glorious vista once exclusive
to emperors. Not anymore.
flavour.MapWorldsMalformation:
Boils swell from the earth.
Foul malignant flesh
without purpose.
flavour.MapWorldsMarshes:
Embraced by mud. Grasped by roots.
The careless are silently swallowed.
flavour.MapWorldsMausoleum:
A vault for the dead, as if
they were valuable. Pathetic.
flavour.MapWorldsMaze:
They live trapped forever in darkness
and confusion. We are no different.
flavour.MapWorldsMazeUnique: We are ever the makers of our own undoing.
flavour.MapWorldsMesa:
Barren and sun-bleached.
Emptiness as far as
the eye can reach.
flavour.MapWorldsMineralPools:
God's jar of raw materials.
Life lying dormant,
waiting to sprout.
flavour.MapWorldsMinotaur:
One of my captors felt no emotion.
He did not hesitate to inflict pain.
Now all he feels is intense, unstoppable agony.
flavour.MapWorldsMoonTemple:
Night's promises are dark, for
even the stars must be harvested.
flavour.MapWorldsMoonTempleUnique:
In the shadow of war,
all are eclipsed.
flavour.MapWorldsMudGeyser:
Filth springs forth like blood
from a severed jugular.
flavour.MapWorldsMuseum:
Ancient artifacts and beautiful baubles.
All paid for in blood.
flavour.MapWorldsMuseumUnique:
Please take out your blades,
your whips, and your spikes.
Class is now in session.
flavour.MapWorldsNecropolis:
Even in death, we long to
be close to one another.
flavour.MapWorldsNecropolisUnique:
So the raiders danced,
leading their foe ever west,
towards certain death.
flavour.MapWorldsOrchard: The fruit that grows from bloody ground tastes sweetest.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownRuin:
Only fear remains unforgotten, where once
magnificent rites drew important crowds.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownShrine:
A once great monument,
now a forgotten memorial.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownShrineUnique:
Curious, she shook it then,
And tiny screams emerged.
Curiouser, she shook again,
And an eerie silence purred.
flavour.MapWorldsPalace:
Death forces even the most
determined of despots to
pass the crown.
flavour.MapWorldsPark: A brief respite in a sea of obligation and uncertainty.
flavour.MapWorldsPen:
Slaves held like cattle. A blood-soaked
revolution, just waiting to happen.
flavour.MapWorldsPeninsula:
The farmer no longer plows
or sows. Only the flattened
soil remains.
flavour.MapWorldsPhantasmagoria:
Every movement is watched,
recorded, remembered.
flavour.MapWorldsPhoenix:
One of my captors refused redemption.
He did not see value in a new life.
Now new life surrounds him.
flavour.MapWorldsPier:
Man's reach extends into
the ocean, clawing at
its infinite depths.
flavour.MapWorldsPit: Blood turns the soil to mud.
flavour.MapWorldsPlateau:
Steep cliffs divide where the trees
may grow, and where they may not.
flavour.MapWorldsPlaza: Drought took the plants, famine took the people.
flavour.MapWorldsPort:
The wealthy foolishly battle
the ocean for domain.
flavour.MapWorldsPrecinct:
Crushed together and fenced in,
to live out their lives like cattle.
flavour.MapWorldsPrimordialPool:
A dough of bad blood.
A yeast of ill will.
flavour.MapWorldsPromenade:
Even the greatest achievements
will eventually be abandoned.
flavour.MapWorldsPromenadeUnique:
The grandest and greatest
ever to fight,
Divine the champions stand tall.
But match their power,
best their might,
And even the immortal may fall.
flavour.MapWorldsRacecourse_: Rats chase their tails for the amusement of fools.
flavour.MapWorldsRamparts:
A wall is the surest sign for raiders
that there is something of value to take.
flavour.MapWorldsReef:
Each plank of rotting wood,
each dead sailor,
feeds the island and makes it grow.
flavour.MapWorldsRelicChambers:
Relics of a forbidden past.
Hidden away. Forgotten.
flavour.MapWorldsScriptorium:
Knowledge balanced atop a vast pit. Hold on,
or perish in the darkness of ignorance.
flavour.MapWorldsSepulchre:
Lives come and go.
Only bones and dust remain.
flavour.MapWorldsShapersRealm: The nexus of nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsShipyard:
The stone and lumber sleeps.
The captains are long dead.
Only the sea knows their end.
flavour.MapWorldsShore: Each life, each act, as fleeting as footprints in the sand.
flavour.MapWorldsShoreUnique:
The Treasures of the Tides
wait in agony
at the End of the World.
flavour.MapWorldsShrine: Black tiles don't stain so easily.
flavour.MapWorldsSiege: No rest, no peace, no negotiation. Only War.
flavour.MapWorldsSilo:
Grim blessings whispered in the deepest,
most secret of places.
flavour.MapWorldsSpiderForest:
Each branch, each leaf,
an extension of a web
that spans sanity.
flavour.MapWorldsSpiderLair:
Panic only hastens the venom's
passage to the heart.
flavour.MapWorldsSprings:
The water brings life,
the poison takes it away.
flavour.MapWorldsStagnation_:
Aided by unrelenting rain,
rot devours new life at the first fumble.
flavour.MapWorldsStrand:
Nothing good washes up
on this dark shore.
flavour.MapWorldsStrandUnique:
We all began life in darkness,
we shall all end it there.
flavour.MapWorldsSulphurVents:
The creatures that prowl the wildest extremes,
nature anoints with cruel efficacy to defend her.
flavour.MapWorldsSummit:
We are swept ever upwards by our ambition,
with no thought of what awaits us at the peak.
flavour.MapWorldsSunkenCity:
From the walls, water, and ferns...
Death comes crawling on ancient steps.
flavour.MapWorldsTemple:
Immaculate white stone rises
from the abyss. Perfection.
flavour.MapWorldsTempleUnique:
Laughs of all the twisted
Echo through these
halls of gold.
In this cold forgotten void
They wander, forever uncontrolled.
flavour.MapWorldsTerrace:
A garden on a stone pedestal.
An incredible, and foolish, feat.
flavour.MapWorldsThaumaturgistsLair:
Ever does man look to emulate his creator,
only to match his indifference.
flavour.MapWorldsThicket:
Little light enters.
No life escapes.
flavour.MapWorldsTortureChamber:
Who is the true criminal, the one behind
bars, or the one who tortures him?
flavour.MapWorldsTortureChamberUnique:
"Here the soil is more deadly
than any swing of the axe."
- Oba of the Karui,
Conqueror of Corruption.
flavour.MapWorldsTower: We ascend to great heights to commit low acts.
flavour.MapWorldsToxicSewer:
Affluence and effluence, separated
by a few feet of soil.
flavour.MapWorldsTribunal: So much power in the hands of so few.
flavour.MapWorldsTropicalIsland:
The temptations of paradise
draw forth the good
and the bad alike.
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundRiver:
Life, like still water, becomes trapped.
Stagnant. Foul.
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundRiverUnique:
Howls and laughter
They hide in the day
They smell you, they watch you
They track their new prey
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundSea:
Silent stillness. The waters are
as cold as they are black.
flavour.MapWorldsVaalPyramid:
A good slave is driven by
only two thoughts:
service and sacrifice.
flavour.MapWorldsVaalPyramidUnique:
"Should I depart this mortal coil,
so shall all of my treasures."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.MapWorldsVaalTemple:
Voices. Visions. Violence.
They will haunt these grounds for all of eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsVault:
Wealth beyond imagining,
locked beyond reach.
flavour.MapWorldsVilla:
Wealth is powerless to stop
the corroding force of time.
flavour.MapWorldsVolcano: Tremble in the might of the flames.
flavour.MapWorldsWasteland:
A white bone stripped of its fertile flesh.
Life spirals towards its end.
flavour.MapWorldsWaterways:
A river in the sky, far from that
which so desperately needs it.
flavour.MapWorldsWharf:
Reach out into the abyss,
and the abyss reaches back.
flavour.MavenKey:
It would be foolish to obey the Maven's demands.
It would also be foolish not to.
flavour.MavenKeyFragment:
Precious and perilous,
Tantalising and terrible.
flavour.MavenTrial:
For those who must not endure it,
there may be found a perverse joy 
in watching the struggle for survival.
flavour.MawrBlaidd: Rigwald believed he'd seized great power, but it was the great power that had seized Rigwald
flavour.MedvedsCrestFlavourText:
In days of yore, the Druids of the Circle walked
the mountains and valleys of Middengard,
calming the lava flows and enriching the earth.
flavour.MedvedsFellingSupport:
"There is no zealotry like that of a mystic roused
to battle. He broke his own code, wielding weapons
long forbidden, to defend that which he loved."
flavour.MercilessArmament:
"Through thick and thin,
blood and bone,
a peaceful life
is one I can't condone."
- Tukohama, Father Of War
flavour.MightIsRight: The mind had much to endure before the advent of thaumaturgy.
flavour.Mitts: Those whose hands are their livelihood know the importance of keeping them safe and warm.
flavour.MonasticLineageSupport:
Ailith awoke to find her fire iridescent, and her mind alive
with visions. By morning, she began teaching what she'd
seen... thus was born the Keepers of the Pale Vision.
flavour.MorganaLineageSupport:
On the nights the fugue would come over her, the Ezomytes would
gather below, begging her to bring the rains. Atop the Taisce,
wailing with unknown sorrows, her cries made the skies rage.
flavour.MorrigansRefugeSupport_:
"Wild energy is as misunderstood as the Mórrigan
itself. Many revere life, yet revile death. What is dead
feeds the living. Death is but one aspect of the whole."
flavour.NecropolisResearch:
Time is the ultimate power. A true Sekhema must hold in
her heart the truth: only the akhara can carry on forever.
The greatest victory lies in ensuring the next generation.
flavour.NoTraces: There is no mistake so great that it cannot be undone.
flavour.OfferingDedication:
Before the Goddess, nothing remains hidden.
Adversity reveals old flaws and new strengths.
flavour.OfferingGift:
The Goddess abides a kingdom beyond compare,
should you meet her challenge.
flavour.OfferingToTheGoddess:
It is time for the Goddess to give her final verdict.
Your fate rests in her even hands.
flavour.OfferingTribute:
You may appeal to the Goddess for another verdict,
but justice favours only the truly worthy.
flavour.OisinLineageSupport: The first Warden of Eaves swore to patrol the border twixt the worlds forevermore, so that the tragedy of Gruthkul's stampede would never recur. In time, his vigil on the edge began to... change him.
flavour.OlrothsConvictionSupport:
The Empty-Eyed Fiend emerged from darkness.
Olroth raised his sword, gem in its pommel. 
The Fiend smiled. Olroth swung. 
Its head rolled, sockets ablaze with delight.
flavour.OlrothsCrestFlavourText:
The Knights of the Sun defined what it
means to be a hero in a world full of
monsters, mysteries, and darkness.
flavour.OlrothsHubris:
The gem warmed his palm. "Our fear of this
power cost many lives. No longer!" With his own
hands, Olroth sealed that expedition's demise.
flavour.OlrothsLegacyFlavourText:
The true power of the Knights of the Sun came not from
force of arms, nor cleverness of artifice. Its beating heart
was the valour and determination of the heroes of old.
flavour.PaquateLineageSupport:
The water used to cool the Locus of Corruption ran red
as blood, bright as flame, and bubbled with strange heat.
"Drink," he offered. "Suffuse your flesh with power!"
flavour.Perfection: There are countless worlds, but only those with limitless potential will be able to achieve perfection.
flavour.PietyLineageSupport:
The High Templar needed thousands of prisoners if his and
Piety's experiments were to succeed. Conspiring on the
matter, they decided to revive an age old tradition... exile.
flavour.PinnacleKey1: A carved piece of something older than the Vaal.
flavour.PinnacleKey2: The carvings it holds are too worn to decipher.
flavour.PinnacleKey3: Pictographs seem to convey a dire warning.
flavour.PinnacleKeyBreach:
Locked within the unseen fabric
lie the chains of power and control.
flavour.PinnacleKeyFargmentExpedition: Shattered pieces of glory long lost.
flavour.PinnacleKeyRitual__:
To bear the head of a king is to send a
message both concise and profound.
flavour.PinnacleKeyUber1:
It bears a pictograph of a lunar eclipse
made crimson by crystallised Corruption.
flavour.PinnacleKeyUber2:
It bears a pictograph of three stones
being placed at the foot of a great tower.
flavour.PinnacleKeyUber3:
It bears a pictograph of vast flames
sweeping across mountains and forests.
flavour.PrideBeforeTheFall:
As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone1:
The Maven knew nothing of mercy
until she herself needed it.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone2:
The Elder fed on all that gave life meaning
until it encountered an unbreakable bond.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone3:
The Eater of Worlds consumed for countless
eons to satiate the desperation of masters
that could never be satisfied.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone4:
The Searing Exarch spread the Word of
Enlightenment for countless eons without
ever understanding its master's message.
flavour.ProphecyFragment1:
Mouth of the Masses, whose greatness spreads by our breath and touch,
who feeds the starving with the starved, the strong with the weak.
flavour.ProphecyFragment2:
Lord of the Wild, of the feral and frenzied,
of the uncivilized, the untamed, the untouched.
flavour.ProphecyFragment3:
The Infinite Mind, unbound by the tethers of sanity,
whose thirst for knowledge is all-consuming,
whose every word stands our hair on end.
flavour.ProphecyFragment4_:
She of Many Bodies, whose very flesh unites all,
whose dark whispers draw forth our souls, unfettered.
flavour.Prosperity: Accumulating wealth has its own costs.
flavour.PrototypeSeventeenLineageSupport:
"The murals tell a story of creation, of design... the Precursors
delved into the secrets of life itself. In their war with the Abyssals,
they sought to breed warriors, grown in legions, to fight back..."
flavour.QuestA9Ingredient1: "Blow it all down! The emperor must have his gems, no matter the cost!"
flavour.QuestA9Ingredient2:
Nobility once thought to capture the Basilisks and keep them as exotic pets.
This only served to fatten the vileness of their hearts, and with a hateful
acid that festered inside, the creatures became soured to their very bones.
flavour.QuestAggoratDagger: Death is both a mercy and a curse.
flavour.QuestAllflame:
Distilled from naked ambition and unfettered obsession,
the Allflame emanates a silvern warmth like no other,
and engulfs those moths fool enough to embrace it.
flavour.QuestAncestralSteel:
Melted down and reused repeatedly by centuries of clan smiths,
this steel has seen countless battles in countless forms.
flavour.QuestAncientGateKey:
When Orbala drew in a mighty breath and sounded the Horn,
every tent in the whole of the Plains blew wildly open.
flavour.QuestAnkhOfEternity: "The amulet, it... whispers to me. Horrible things..."
flavour.QuestAvariusStaff_:
"Worry not for the heathens. They are devoid of soul.
Made vessels of wrath, they are damned by holy design."
- High Templar Avarius
flavour.QuestBalbalaCoin_:
"Why are you standing there gawking at me?
We must go to the Trial of the Sekhemas!"
flavour.QuestBestelManuscript:
"A stranger's kiss on a moonlit night.
Dost thou believe in love at first sight?"
flavour.QuestBlackFlag:
"May the lubbers feel fear in their
nethers, and may our blades follow."
 - Rot-tooth's Rallying Cry
flavour.QuestBlackVenom:
"The spider is not defined by how
it lives, but by how it kills."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestBlankRune: Untouched by fate. Its power waits for a purpose.
flavour.QuestBlankTattoo1: The storm has not struck, but the sky is watching.
flavour.QuestBlankTattoo2: What is written in water is never truly lost.
flavour.QuestBlankTattoo3: The forge is ready. Flesh is only waiting.
flavour.QuestBlankTattoo4: To the unknowing, it is nothing. To Yama, it is everything.
flavour.QuestBoatCharter: Bound by ink, upheld by trust.
flavour.QuestBogWitchBroomstick: The skulls of stolen children adorn carved wood.
flavour.QuestBottledStorm:
"One should not entice the storm; one cannot invite the storm, or give warrant
to its tyrant-soul. We survive only by appeasing the storm, with gifts and
offerings of adoration. We hope that, in its mercy, it shall pass us by."
- Tempestology of the Maraketh, Repudion IV
flavour.QuestBurningHeart: The primordial molten world was not devoid of life.
flavour.QuestBust1:
The Emperor honours Hector Titucius as Supreme Servant.
"Strength in purpose is strength in deed."
flavour.QuestBust2:
The Emperor honours Gaius Sentari as Supreme Servant.
"A man's thoughts are his shackles. A man's thoughts are his wings."
flavour.QuestBust3:
The Emperor honours Marceus Lioneye as Supreme Servant.
"The road to Glory is paved with Sacrifice."
flavour.QuestCalendar:
The King looked upon images swirling atop the ancient stone dial.
"You look peaceful" he told his bride-to-be, "So peaceful, asleep in our wedding bed."
But in phantasm, she did not slumber, and what he saw was not a place for dreams,
rather, a wooden box... about to be closed and lowered into earthy depths.
 - Maraketh Legend
flavour.QuestChapelKey:
Blind to pleas. Deaf to lies.
Her scales weigh only truth.
flavour.QuestCombinedAmulet:
Though its power has been shared, there
is still more the Apex might unlock.
flavour.QuestCraftingBenchTools: Forgework tools belong to Renly and his son.
flavour.QuestCroneDrop:
It howled alone on the eve of
the first snow. Now, it snarls
forever, heralding the cold.
flavour.QuestDaressoGem:
"It is a cruel joke that
Man was born with more
Intent than Life."
- Malachai
flavour.QuestDecanter:
"Man is blinded by the mud of his corporeal self. Only
through the transformation of the material into the
spiritual can we hope to taste the full body of life."
- Malachai the Soulless
flavour.QuestDepletedManaRune: The rune hungers, an empty chasm...
flavour.QuestDexAmulet:
While this artefact resonates with power,
it is simply a piece in a larger puzzle.
flavour.QuestDigestedSulphitePotion: The liquid within is acrid enough to burn nose hairs.
flavour.QuestDjinnBarya01: "Weep not for me. This punishment is my own doing."
flavour.QuestDjinnBarya02: "I'd have preferred to go with the Serpent Clan."
flavour.QuestDjinnFlaskEmpty: The phrase 'dekha no Garukhan breala' is carefully painted around the middle.
flavour.QuestDjinnFlaskFull: The bottle shakes angrily when the entity inside sees you looking.
flavour.QuestDominusKey: Some sins were never meant to be remembered...
flavour.QuestExpeditionLogbook2: The last one alive, she understood too late...
flavour.QuestExpeditionLogbook3: Schemes laid bare, in their hour of need...
flavour.QuestExpeditionLogbook4: He made his way to the ends of the earth...
flavour.QuestEyeOfTheTitan:
It burns with the primordial heat
of a long-ago Wraeclast.
flavour.QuestFinnsPotion:
"Bit of Ezomyte know-how, bit of local herbs...
it's no mythical Welakath, but it'll sustain you."
flavour.QuestFirefly1: In all things living, the light burns bright.
flavour.QuestFirefly2: A passionate fire that consumes the heart.
flavour.QuestFirefly3: The Spirit, it radiates not from above.
flavour.QuestFirefly4: It is the warmth that draws you ever inward.
flavour.QuestFirefly5: Where rest the truest colours of life.
flavour.QuestFirefly6: Gold of the organ. Green of the throat. Red of the vein.
flavour.QuestFirefly7: The myriad wet rainbow of the Spirit's domain.
flavour.QuestFlameRuby:
Those near the ruby describe a sensation of intense malice,
as if something is peering through from the other side...
flavour.QuestForgemasterHammer:
The smith may not remember higher
pursuits, but the hammer does.
flavour.QuestFrostCore:
To forge the most exquisite of creations,
sometimes cold is needed instead...
flavour.QuestGlyph1:
Its corrugated surface brings a strange tingle
to the fingertips. This is no mere decoration.
flavour.QuestGlyph2:
When put to the ear it whispers not of
the sea, but long dead incantations.
flavour.QuestGlyph3:
Its pleasing sheen remains even in shadow,
as if it were somehow lit from within.
flavour.QuestGoblinGiantLipDisk: The meaning of the symbols has been lost to time.
flavour.QuestGoldIdol2: ...in the depths of an ancient ruin...
flavour.QuestGoldIdol3: ...rewarding any bold enough to seek it.
flavour.QuestGoldenHand:
An open palm raised in peace,
cut down by the slaves of war.
flavour.QuestGreatWhiteOneDrop: The sea gave it strength. Now it serves a greater purpose.
flavour.QuestGreustNecklace:
"A boy becomes a man when he has faced the animal
in his heart and wet the forest floor with its blood."
 - Azmeri Proverb
flavour.QuestHeartOfTheTitan: The blood of the Titans flows within humanity still. It need only be reawakened.
flavour.QuestHinekorasHair:
"What we steal in life we repay in death."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestIceTusks: Frozen trophies of a predator's reign.
flavour.QuestInfernalTalc:
"A Virtue Gem is a raging thunderstorm imprisoned within a single raindrop.
Infernal Talc simply lets the storm out." - Malachai the Soulless
flavour.QuestIntAmulet:
Segregated by treachery, this artefact
longs to be reunited with her sisters.
flavour.QuestKaomGem:
"Fear becomes Hatred.
Hatred becomes Fury.
Thus is Man transformed
from Martyr to Maker."
- Malachai
flavour.QuestKaomTotem:
The war goes on, but the warrior does not.
Do not let yourself die until you have
made your mark. The Ancestors see you.
flavour.QuestKaruiEye:
"Weakness must be purged lest it
poison the blood of all Karui."
 - Prayer to Tukohama
flavour.QuestKisharaStar: To the wily Kishara's eye, a star brighter than the sun.
flavour.QuestKitavaKey:
Wrought from blood and gold, Innocence fashioned a weapon of tempered purity,
capable of banishing darkness, and bringing order to the chaos in men's hearts.
flavour.QuestLargeSoulCoreFlavourText:
Heat emanates from the facets,
living warmth encased in crystal.
flavour.QuestMalachaisEntrails:
My organs tether me to mortality
like a chain. This chain holds me
from my true potential.
flavour.QuestMalachaisHeart:
My heart forces blood through my veins.
But one who may bleed may die, and
death is no fitting end to genius.
flavour.QuestMalachaisLungs:
My lungs breathe the same air as
the foolish and the weak. May I be
yet another step removed from them.
flavour.QuestMaligaroMap:
"Certain maps can only be rendered in the most vivid of viscera."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestManorGargoyleDrop: A sense of gratefulness and peace radiates with warmth.
flavour.QuestMapFragment3: Smells of salt, rust, and fear.
flavour.QuestMapFragment4_: No light touched it for centuries.
flavour.QuestMastodonTusks: Age-old ivory from a forgotten era.
flavour.QuestMedallionCombined:
For a time, there was peace, a wall against
mutual enemies from beyond.
flavour.QuestMedallionHyenaClan:
By the terms of the Third Pact, the Sun Clan
agreed to never again attack the Maraketh.
flavour.QuestMedallionSerpentClan:
By the terms of the Third Pact, the Constrictor Queen
was banished from Keth, but given the eastern sands.
flavour.QuestMedicineChest:
Doctor "Shaky Hands" Opden travelled with only the
finest medicines and antidotes... and a curiously
generous supply of opiates.
flavour.QuestMentorSpikes:
Together, the runes are an oath of peaceful
passage and a request for freedom in
pursuit of an important cause.
flavour.QuestMiasmeter:
"We shall peer at these cosmic wonderments as they
wake and writhe within that deep and nameless dark."
 - Vilenta, 'Miasmeter: A Thesis'
flavour.QuestMoonOrb:
"Moonlight is a wise mother. The moon which bathes us in soft,
cooling light, does so with the intent of illuminating our paths.
Moonlight is wisdom. Moonlight is life."
 - The Lunar Verses
flavour.QuestMothersoulCombined:
A paradox, whose very existence 
would change... everything.
flavour.QuestMothersoulEgg:
Life itself. Not as it was, but as
they aspired for it to be...
flavour.QuestMothersoulEmbyro:
A burgeoning emergent
flare of empowered life
flavour.QuestObsidianKey:
"The cool blanket of shadows preserves our treasures."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestObsidianMortar:
An elegantly crafted alchemical tool from a far-off land.
The obsidian material glimmers darkly at certain angles.
flavour.QuestPage1:
"The Vaal were even more steeped in gem culture than
our Emperor and his 'Gemlings'. It's an obsession
as old as civilisation itself."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage2:
"A communion... but with what? By all accounts,
it wasn't God that the Vaal were trying to reach."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage3:
"A waking Nightmare.
Madness of the mind?
Or madness of the flesh?"
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage4:
"Siosa, your Slavery will cause them to overlook you.
Your Karui Way will guide you.
Your Humanity will shame us all."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPlum: As succulent as blood, as sweet as power.
flavour.QuestPoisonGem:
The withering glare of corruption, made
corporeal and pellucid in crystal.
flavour.QuestPoisonSpear:
Maligaro loved his tools, and took great
pains to keep them excruciatingly sharp.
flavour.QuestPotion:
Famous for her many lovers, those that did not
come willing to Atziri, came by liquid persuasion.
flavour.QuestPrisonerRegeneratingLiver:
The flesh continues to grow and change,
perhaps forming an entire new body in time...
flavour.QuestRakiataTotem:
The sea goes on, but the sailor does not.
Enjoy each moment as it flows over you,
through you, for it will never come again.
flavour.QuestRedBanner: When the sun sets, the plains should be red.
flavour.QuestRibbonSpool:
Machinery makes the minions.
Minions make the master.
flavour.QuestRingOfTheCount:
The rune of Authority is said to dim one lunar
cycle after a Count's soul is laid to rest.
flavour.QuestRunedArtifact1:
The rune on the buckle means
'unity' or 'safety from harm.'
flavour.QuestRunedArtifact2:
The rune at the base of the blade
means 'to strike true' or 'truth.'
flavour.QuestRunedArtifact3:
The rune emblazoned on the crest means
'freedom' or 'for a worthy cause.'
flavour.QuestSacredWater: Cool and pure, it represents hope in a bleak era.
flavour.QuestSacrificialHeart: A soul still clings to fading shreds of life.
flavour.QuestScourgeOfTheSkiesEyes: The pupils refocus as you look closer.
flavour.QuestSekhemaFeather:
"And how shall we know a sekhema worthy of rule? 
By the anointing of the Great Roc, under whose wings we grow and soar."
 - Maraketh Coronation Ritual
flavour.QuestSewerKeys:
To enter a city's bowels is to be
privy to its best-kept secrets.
flavour.QuestSilverLocket:
From Weylam to Meredith:
I shall love thee as I love the sea.
flavour.QuestSirenPearl: It hums faintly. Not with life, but with purpose.
flavour.QuestSirenVocalCords:
Even the slightest movement causes air to move through them,
releasing a subtle mind-numbing pressure.
flavour.QuestSnakeLadyPotion:
Beware the bite of those serpents that call a human corpse home.
Nature has given them the means to acquire a new dwelling.
flavour.QuestSnakeLadyPotionConsumable: The smell is bad enough to make a veteran warrior faint.
flavour.QuestSoulCoreConsumable:
It burns with the heat of rage and murderous intent,
a single soul imprisoned eternally for his crimes.
flavour.QuestSpikeKey: A sigil of thaumaturgy graven in granite.
flavour.QuestSpiritDraught1: Corruption often causes crystals to grow in strange places...
flavour.QuestSpiritDraught2_: The skull of a stolen child, carefully cultivated by the Bog Witch...
flavour.QuestStormSword:
Garukhan sought madness and knowledge amongst the billowing clouds of a 
blackened sky. A vulture of pride, she would not be refused, and so the
stratosphere divulged unto her eldritch secrets of its tumultuous past.
flavour.QuestStrAmulet:
A relic of a sundered relationship,
it awaits reconciliation with its kin.
flavour.QuestSuicideNote:
Extremely personal words of love, honour,
and hopelessness scrawled by a shaking hand...
It appears to have been carefully written to
avoid revealing who it was intended for.
flavour.QuestSunOrb:
"The sun is a devoted mother. She casts her golden blessings on
the crops of the pious and makes barren the fields of heresy.
Sunlight is belief. Sunlight is life."
 - The Solar Verses
flavour.QuestTattoo1_2: The forest stands tall against the storm.
flavour.QuestTattoo2: Hunters of the Tasalio Tribe are just as effective on land.
flavour.QuestTattoo2_2: Tasalio bids you take a moment to stop and enjoy the calm of the ocean.
flavour.QuestTattoo3: When Ngamahu's chosen truly wish to destroy an enemy, nothing can stop them.
flavour.QuestTattoo3_2_: The Ngamahu Tribe believes the Karui will be reforged in a volcano at the end of time.
flavour.QuestTattoo4: Hinekora is not the master of Death, but she is its Mother.
flavour.QuestTeardrop:
"T'gnagn iia y r'ngusla ph'tu Tsoatha nga mekghul'an."
 - Indecipherable verse
flavour.QuestTemplarCourtKey:
Eyes blazing with holy flame, the Pilgrim saw
a great palace descend from the burgeoning sky,
its gates barred against the unfaithful.
flavour.QuestThaumeticSulphite:
Essence of pure thaumaturgy.
Apply with trepidation.
flavour.QuestTolmanBracelet:
A craftswoman's ode to
fresh hope, a new love.
flavour.QuestTowerKey:
God will only offer the door.
Man must choose whether to open it.
flavour.QuestTukohamasTooth:
"The belly cannot hunger for what the eyes cannot see."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestUnasLute:
This grelwood heirloom hums softly with latent emotion,
imbued by centuries of songs passed from mother to daughter.
flavour.QuestVaalKeyGem: Ancient facets remain warm to the touch.
flavour.QuestValakosJaw:
"One day you eat the fish. One day you feed the fish."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestVerisium: A shooting star may bring great fortune.
flavour.QuestVerisiumSpikes: They are engraved with the runes for 'Authority,' 'Break,' and 'Release.'
flavour.QuestWingsOfVastiri:
And mounting her mighty Roc, Garukhan, holy queen of the sky,
descended upon her enemies and their armies of darkness.
flavour.QuestZigguratDoorKey: This idol seems strangely shaped, as if made specifically to fit into something.
flavour.QusetEssenceOfTheWaterGod: The last few drops from veins dry as sand.
flavour.RainOfChaos:
Fire filled the sky that night 
Chaos reigned 
Where the shards fell 
All was destroyed 
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm
flavour.RakiataLineageSupport:
The Tasalio Tribe developed their own Way, seeing
the world not as it is, but as it should be, given its
roiling and endless grace of constant motion.
flavour.Rats: Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.
flavour.Rebirth:
He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh
flavour.RigwaldLineageSupport:
"Skothe kept us idle, sitting safe on these islands, while our
brethren remain slaves. We are one and the same! We must
fight! So, I bring you his head. I am now your Wolven King!"
flavour.Ring11: God blesses those who bless themselves.
flavour.Ring12: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
flavour.Ring13:
"Shavronne held Sanity in her right
hand and Revelation in her left.
Brutus chose the left hand."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavour.RingB1FlavourText_: Preserve the essence, so that it may evolve.
flavour.RingB2FlavourText: Grow the flesh, so that it may endure.
flavour.RingB3FlavourText: Build the mind, so that it may serve.
flavour.RingB4FlavourText_: Sharpen the claw, so that it may rend.
flavour.RingB5FlavourText: Devour the dream, because we must.
flavour.RingB6FlavourText: Seek all that is, so it may become ours.
flavour.RitualBossFragment: On the edge of existence, he watches with ire.
flavour.RitualPinnacleEffigyPiece: Answer the whispers... as they did.
flavour.RomiraLineageSupport:
"Come, my faithful wife," he crooned. "Sit. Eat. I wanted to
reward you for your loyalty. I even cooked this myself..."
She looked 'round for her sons, but hers was the only chair.
flavour.RuneAnointFlavourText:
It reached out a long, horrific limb, and touched it
to my forehead. Awareness grew there. The truth.
A window into limitless darkness... and loneliness.
flavour.RuneConvertChaosFlavourText:
Aldur made a choice to share the art of runesmithing
with all those who would seek the craft. He knew it
might be used for ill, even by his own descendants...
flavour.RuneConvertColdFlavourText:
The first runes ever carved by the hand of man refused
to cool. Aldur trekked to the highest peak of the tallest
mountain, bringing his sword to the primordial snows.
flavour.RuneConvertFireFlavourText:
The priests had long charted the dance of the stars,
but it was Aldur who brought that meaning to his forge.
Night and day, he wrestled the flames into submission.
flavour.RuneConvertLightningFlavourText:
On the highest peak, Aldur discovered the true secret
of runes. They awaited willpower, and command. Raising
his sword high, he received the might of the skies.
flavour.SanctumKeyNonQuest:
"Take me to the Trial of the Sekhemas.
I will serve."
flavour.ScarabAbyss1:
As the hordes of bone and blood and foul magic surge across the Vastiri Plains,
the scant survivors of our akhara agree to your alliance, ash-scarred Ahkeli.
Disorder means death. Order may mean life.
flavour.ScarabAbyss2:
Your golems and your leadership have slowed the tide of death, Clayshaper.
