The relics of power you bid us find have kept the Vastiri Plains from the brink
of oblivion. The defences of the Maraketh will hold.
flavour.ScarabAbyss3:
The Winter of the World has ended at the hands of the Three Sisters. We lay this scarab
upon your ancient grave in thanks for your efforts, Honoured Founder. As you hoped,
the fate of your people will never befall another.
flavour.ScarabAbyss4:
The Abyssals creep forth by night and by storm. Their eons underground were not
a respite, but an amassing, and now they number beyond comprehension.
flavour.ScarabBeasts1:
Feuding Ezomytes slaughtered your kin, young Agnar, but we pulled you
from the flames. The Order of the Djinn is your clan now.
flavour.ScarabBeasts2:
None among us understand the beasts of this world better than you,
honoured Agnar. You will root out the mysteries of wild-artefacts.
flavour.ScarabBeasts3:
The Order was your clan in life, Agnar, Beastmaster, but the First Ones call
back their favoured son. The gift of their Visions will pass to another.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4a:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4b:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4c:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4d:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight1:
We pulled you from the raging ocean, young Dhunan,
but we cannot return you to your home. The Order of the Djinn
offers you a place on Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight2:
For using the techniques of your homeland to contain
the fungal plague, honoured Dhunan, you shall lead the war
to eliminate it and end the century-cycle of infestation.
flavour.ScarabBlight3:
Be at rest, Blightmaster Dhunan, on the distant shores of
your home. A dangerous expedition, but one worthy for
he who gave his life to cleanse Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight4:
The fungal plague returns, and its roots have adapted.
The undiscovered Blightheart that Dhunan theorised
must still exist somewhere, yet none remain
with the skill to see to its destruction.
flavour.ScarabBreach1:
The Ember-dwellers sought to throw you to their volcanic god, young Omid,
but we caught you instead. The Order of the Djinn is your tribe now.
flavour.ScarabBreach2:
We task you, honoured Omid, with the investigation of this mysterious
'Xoph' and artefacts related to rifts in the boundaries of our world.
flavour.ScarabBreach3:
Omid, Master Researcher, has left a final commandment upon his death:
the world must never know.
flavour.ScarabBreach4:
The Master Researcher's final commandment has failed.
The High Templar has seen the truth of our situation,
and the world will be undone by his fear.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards1:
You were a casualty of callous Karui warfare, ageless Narumoa, but the Order
mended your wounds. You are bound to us now by your own code.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards2:
Though your peers fear you, Narumoa, the elders have decided that your
second sight is ideal for handling all artefacts that seek to subvert Fate.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards3:
Your centuries of service have been invaluable to us, Narumoa. Go now,
return to Hinekora, and join your ancient kin in the halls of the dead.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards4:
Hinekora has sent the world another herald, but this hatungo walks another path.
We are left blinded, and subject to the vagaries of Fate.
flavour.ScarabElderRares1_:
Your visions led the Azmeri down into a world left abandoned by the Vaal.
They cast you out, young Egrin, but the Order of the Djinn accepts you.
flavour.ScarabElderRares2_:
Speaker of unclean truths, Egrin of the Dark Between Stars.
We curse you whose soul echoes the madness of the void!
flavour.ScarabElderRares3:
Egrin of the Dark Between Stars, Forger of the Sealing Blade,
let your name be redeemed by your unexpected sacrifice.
flavour.ScarabElderRares4:
We are all equally fools for our childish notions.
That dread force Decay cannot be defeated by self-sacrifice.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger1:
Your ancestry has been much maligned by history, young Sarina Titucius,
but to the Order of the Djinn, you are born anew.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger2:
For deciphering the language of the inscrutable ones, honoured Sarina,
we charge you with investigating their intent in our land.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger3:
For your valour beyond the Gate, Sarina Titucius, we honour you with the first
Gilded Scarab awarded while its recipient still lives. Remain vigilant.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger4:
The thousand year truce has faltered, for the inscrutable ones have imprisoned their own God.
Should they invade again, there will be no warning.
flavour.ScarabLegion1:
Your faith and our Order are not in opposition, young Eutychus. 
Let this be the start of a new era of cooperation.
flavour.ScarabLegion2:
As our hand in the Chamber, we grant you, Deacon Eutychus,
access to a domain we lack the resources to explore.
flavour.ScarabLegion3:
Given the fate of Deacon Eutychus and the men under Cardinal Sanctus Vox,
let none dare the Domain, lest they too feed that vile hunger eternal.
flavour.ScarabLegion4:
As the passage between Wraeclast and the land beyond time's reach is torn open,
we stand on the precipice of eternal war.
And no one remains to hold us back.
flavour.ScarabMaps1:
Consider yourself an orphaned Eternal no longer, young Betucia.
The Order of the Djinn is your family now.
flavour.ScarabMaps2:
For your loyalty and valour, honoured Betucia, we are proud to put
the requisition of dream-artefacts in your capable hands.
flavour.ScarabMaps3:
Betucia, Bearer of the Sealing Blade, the Order of the Djinn survives
because of your sacrifice, but will be forever wounded by your loss.
flavour.ScarabMaps4:
The Sealing Blade has been removed, and the agent of Decay
shall feed upon this world until nothing remains but dust.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph1:
Rejected even by the Faridun outcasts, young Saresh, you were cursed to walk the
white sands until we found you. The Order shall command your penance now.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph2:
As you explore the vast well of human darkness, Saresh, our Surgeon of the Dead,
remember that the price can sometimes exceed the value of knowledge.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph3:
There was a man of bone, rotting flesh, and weeping black, but his name, his
ill-gotten knowledge, and his role in the Order shall be stricken from memory.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph4:
Though the Necromancer of Weeping Black fell in the desert by the hand of Garukhan,
his mindless legions remain scattered throughout Wraeclast, with no master to curb their hunger.
flavour.ScarabPerandus1:
Your people no longer walk this continent, young Revna,
but the Order of the Djinn will give you a new home.
flavour.ScarabPerandus2:
As you delve into the mysteries of this world, apprentice Revna,
remember to learn from the past, not be consumed by it.
flavour.ScarabPerandus3:
We lay you to rest in the forest deep, Runesmith Revna, so that you may be
forever hidden from the stars which so terrified you in your final days.
May the secret you took to your grave be lifted from your burdens.
flavour.ScarabPerandus4:
Darkness surges in the shadows of the past. Ancient evils stir. The stars
watch, forever aloof, forever menacing. None remain who know the
secret, so we are defenseless in the face of the unknown.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares1:
The Peak-dwellers saw you as impure, young Qianga, but the Order of
the Djinn sees you as all the stronger for your uniqueness.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares2:
Bold dreamer, Qianga of the Stars, she of the Celestial Cold! These titles
we bestow upon the one among us whose soul speaks to the ineffable.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares3:
Qianga of the Stars, Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers, go now, and
let your half-dreamt life be troubled by nightmares of achromic hunger no more.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares4:
The Watchers have gone silent, yet they scream still.
Something lurks among the stars of our dreams, knocking at the door,
whispering with the voices of long lost friends...
flavour.ScarabStrongbox1:
Your outlaw camp abandoned you when their surprise attack failed, young Rindwik.
Now that you know we exist, we cannot let you go. You have two choices.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox2:
Your people were renegades, Rindwik, but you have proven your loyalty.
You will lead the martial defence of our expeditions.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox3:
Master Warrior Rindwik fell to one opponent alone: old age.
Only the greatest soldiers can say as much.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox4:
In the absence of a strong martial presence, the renegades rise once more.
Their poisons threaten to cloud the land.
flavour.ScarabSulphite1:
As the first Brinerot to join the Order, you have much to prove,
young Raethan. We are confident you will succeed.
flavour.ScarabSulphite2:
For harnessing and controlling the power of lightning, you, Raethan,
are now charged with researching this new energy.
flavour.ScarabSulphite3:
Let him not be called Raethan the Betrayer. His discovery was too important
to keep locked away. Now, for good or ill, it is in civilisation's hands.
flavour.ScarabSulphite4:
Madness marches in machine form.
Harnessed lightning, grim faces, and cold ambition abounds.
Civilisation will be its own undoing.
flavour.ScarabTorment1:
Young Tsarsk, you were a broken and forgotten child lying glassy-eyed
in a flesh-pit in Trarthus, but the Order found and cleansed you.
flavour.ScarabTorment2:
Your tortured soul long kept you isolated from your peers, Tsarsk, but has attracted
new kindred in kind. You are tasked with appeasing these anguished spirits.
flavour.ScarabTorment3:
Though you were swallowed by your own darkness, you saved countless others
from eternal misery, young Tsarsk. You were not nothing, as you feared.
flavour.ScarabTorment4:
Without a speaker of the dead, the countless anguished spirits only grow in number.
They have no voice, and no hope. The sun darkens with each passing year.
flavour.ScarabUniques1:
The Maraketh left you to die alone in the desert, young Sumei, but we
saw the potential in you. The Order of the Djinn is your akhara now.
flavour.ScarabUniques2:
As the best of our lorekeepers, honoured Sumei, it is now your task
to investigate the mysterious duplication of artefacts of power.
flavour.ScarabUniques3:
Go to your rest now, Sumei, Master Lorekeeper. The Order shall keep
contained the terrible secret that burdened your final years.
flavour.ScarabUniques4:
The books were burned, and the scribes set themselves aflame.
What secret so terrible could they have discovered?
Though centuries have passed, we must investigate this for ourselves.
flavour.ScholarOfTheSeas: I've never come upon a ship I could not command. I have however met sailors that were not willing to be led.
flavour.SentinelController:
For aeons, ancient constructs have lain dormant,
but now their designs are under your control.
flavour.SeraphsHeartLineageSupport:
Intricate machinery imperceptibly woven into a
biological foundation. It felt delicate in her hands.
In him, it would be her greatest achievement.
flavour.SerlesTriumphFlavourText:
The pinnacle of Serle's work was not a grand artefact.
It was a subversion; a window. He stood upon a peak
and saw beyond mortal limitations, understanding, in
that moment, that so much more was possible...
flavour.ShaperFragment1:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment2:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment3:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment4:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperKey:
I spent my life shining a light on truth...
but some things should remain in darkness,
locked away for all eternity.
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_1:
"...It wasn't long before we were met by the Shade itself.
The very essence of the Elder, demanding of me in visions to
tell it why I had returned. But before I could answer,
Venarius stepped forward and greeted the phantom..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_2:
"...Before we knew it, we stood at the base of that blasphemous effigy.
"Pull the sword from my chest." The Elder imposed, and Venarius didn't hesitate.
The earth shook in the face of the Elder's reunion with its body. The true scope of the
Elder befell the High Templar and his men, and as it began to feed, I began to run..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_3:
"...I fear this to be the end. Not just the end for me, but the end of all things. 
The Elder has been freed. Soon it will feast on me... on the rest of the world.
It was too late for me. The Elder had to be stopped. I knew of the shaping powers.
Only I could have a hope at defeating the Elder..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment1_1:
"...A golden machine was found broken in the ruins of Wraeclast. 
Believing it to contain some dark infernal secret, 
High Templar Venarius asked that I restore it 
and weaponize whatever powers it might contain..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment2_1:
"...Though the device seemed to be mostly functioning, 
something important appeared to be missing...
...I worked tirelessly in search of answers, until finally, 
at the base of that cruel device, I fell into a deep, deep sleep..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment3_1:
"...I awoke in the most beautiful of places, and as I wandered this strange new land, 
I felt a growing sense of realization that I was not alone. 
A Shade, a whisper of embodied smoke, spoke to me through thoughts and pictures.
I found myself enthusiastically volunteering information in detail of Oriath..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment4_1:
"...The Shade knew of the device - a doorway between my world
and the dreamlands. It offered to help me rebuild the missing part, 
to create a conduit between this beautiful land and Oriath. 
All that the Shade asked of me was to return the favour..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment5_1:
"...Every night, I found myself asleep at the foot of the strange device, 
awoken to the reality of another world within my own.
The Shade taught me how to shape and build things from my imagination,
how to transport such phantasmagorical treasures back into the world of man..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment6_1:
"...The missing part of the great device had finally been formed.
The Shade requested its one favour. I was shown images of the past,
the Shade as King of the dreamlands, the hateful Watchers of Decay...
It led me deep into a cave, to a statue pierced by a sword..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment7_1:
"Pull the blade from my chest. Free me!" the Shade imposed.
But doubt entered my mind, and the Shade flew into a fury!
I felt my mind torn asunder as images of murder and mutilation were forced upon me. 
I fled in a panic, cursing myself for ever trusting such a strange creature so blindly..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment8_1:
"...Months have now passed since the Shade revealed its true nature.
Each morning, I lock myself inside my study, searching for some knowledge 
that might save us. I have found at last, some information on the Watchers of Decay. 
The truth is so unutterable that I hesitate, even now, to write it down..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment8_2:
"...They called it the Elder. A creature of malignant madness... it cannot be killed.
The Watchers built the device to lock tight its kingdom, bringing with them the
blade - 'Starforge'. A weapon to give the Elder eternal rest. But the Shade...
I must find a way to put a stop to it before it finds a path to freedom..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_1:
"...I've spent every waking hour since, trying to find a way to end this unholy Elder.
Within my secret study, I've begun work on a device of my own, tinkering and shaping.
When I'm finished, this Elder will never bother our world again.
The creature cannot be killed, but maybe... it can be exiled..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_2:
"...Lack of progress on the device has given the High Templar cause for suspicion.
Clapped in irons, I was lead off to the Theopolis prisons for my insubordination.
I must find my way from these chains at all costs. The Elder is coming for us.
Only I can save us from this blasphemy that will soon befall Oriath..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_3:
"...Venarius, that bastard... he marched me through the streets.
His men beat me within an inch of death... I... I told him everything. 
He demanded that I take all of us into the dreamlands, to meet with the Elder.
Using the device, we stepped through, setting foot in the Atlas of Worlds..."
flavour.ShardOfFate:
Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.
flavour.SirusFragment1:
He sought to be the best,
but lost his family.
flavour.SirusFragment2:
He sought God,
but lost himself.
flavour.SirusFragment3:
He sought a kingdom,
but lost his people.
flavour.SirusFragment4:
She sought to bring salvation,
but lost her compassion.
flavour.StruckByLightning:
'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.
flavour.StyrnsFerocitySupport:
Each knight who encountered Styrn challenged
him to the traditional duel. One by one, he fought
his way across all of Middengard... and beyond.
flavour.StyrnsMountainSupport:
Bound by his oath to the Runefathers, Styrn the
Indomitable refused to bow to Cadigan the First.
His resistance laid the seeds for future defiance.
flavour.SupportGemEshLineage:
"Where life once thrived, now only metal grows, inching
like endless worms through the ash. Where silence fell,
now sourceless thought whispers numbers in the dark."
flavour.SupportGemTulLineage:
"Countless graves glow silently in endless rows that stretch
on unseen. The living lie within, but do not decay, do not
die. Their eyes remain open, their essence stilled, waiting."
flavour.SupportGemUulNetolLineage:
"The Lords could not breathe, so they grew new lungs.
The Lords could not venture, so they grew new skin.
The Lords were alone, so they grew us, to serve them."
flavour.SupportGemXophLineage:
"They drank until only dust remained. Ate until their gums
bled rust. Such was their greed, the only thing that remains
of the Broken Sun... is the Red Pyre, the Torus Eternal."
flavour.TacatiLineageSupport:
He almost saved the Vaal. His unique poison made it past
the Queen's cupbearers; he had only to direct his anger...
but in her presence, he could feel naught but lust.
flavour.Talisman1_1:
The First Ones stalk with us
upon this lifelong hunt,
and cast their contempt
upon those that would make us their prey.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_10:
The First Ones hold us
between two sharpened blades.
That should we stray too far from the path,
we find ourselves severed.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_11:
The world of the First Ones is harsh;
We struggle on our bellies to survive.
But that which imprisons us also changes us
And soon we will emerge anew.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_12:
For too long we have crawled in darkness,
scavenging through rotten scraps.
The First Ones teach us to scavenge until we can hunt,
and then never crawl again.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_2:
The civilised man must wrestle
with the demands of heart and mind.
The First Ones share no such struggle.
For their Spirit is swift and deadly certain.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_3:
The fire of the hearth is a docile dog,
leashed and tamed.
The fire of the First Ones is a ravening wolf,
wild and free.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_4:
The First Ones thundered over Ezomyr
upon hooves of grey and black.
The people felt their stamping rage
and cowered as the fury rained down.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_5:
We have basked in the cloying warmth of servitude.
Now the First Ones harden us
against the numbing chill of despair
so that freedom will not slip through our trembling fingers.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_6:
I stood among the stones
And called out to the First Ones;
That with tooth and mighty claw,
They should tear our enemies asunder.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_7:
The Empire poisons our blood with sweet wine.
Poisons our flesh with silk.
Poisons our minds with civil lies.
Poisons our children with servitude.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_8:
'Sleep when you are weary,' our mothers told us.
'Sleep when you are dead,' our fathers told us.
To the First Ones, the slumbering and the corpse
are one and the same.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman1_9:
To catch a big fish you need tempting bait. 
And there is no fish bigger than the Empire,
and no bait as tempting as Ezomyr.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_1:
The Hunter faced the First One
and notched his final arrow.
The First One bared its fangs
and savoured its final breath.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_2:
With the will of the first ones in our sinews
we shall tear down the walls of Sarn.
Yet as is the way of the wildlands,
Only the strong may grow stronger.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_3:
It's said to be noble to stand one's ground.
To soak the earth in stalwart blood.
While the First Ones chose to laugh and run
and caper with untamed glee.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_4:
From flesh and ferocity,
the First Ones roamed
through the realm of Spirit,
and into the darkness beyond. 
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_5:
Fear the children of the First Ones.
Let fear shield your back.
And let the dullard speak of bravery
when the First Ones come for him.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_6:
The first ones live where they can, where they must.
They embrace the frost, the storm, the drought.
Waxing and waning, breaking and mending,
living with time and happenstance, as must we.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_7:
The First Ones are the forever ones.
There is no dust of the hourglass in their blood.
No fissures of weariness in their faces.
To drink of their blood is to drink of time itself.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman2_8:
The Empire hides lies and falsehoods
Behind a mask of politeness and civility.
The First Ones teach us to look through the lies,
And that no beast can truly cover their tracks.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_1:
We Ezomytes are beasts of burden
bearing wealth of an empire on our backs,
growing lean and strong
while our masters grow fat and weak.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_2:
When we free ourselves from the shackles
of civilised existence
we learn to feed and run and breathe
as the First Ones have always done.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_3:
The first ones marked their hunting grounds
with blood and piss.
We have tried to paint our future in words.
Now we shall paint with inks of savagery.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_4:
We grew contemptuous of our past.
Dismissed the first ones as ignorant and wild.
We were fools and naive children
to turn our backs on our inheritance.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_5:
Death met with the First Ones
and demanded they hunt with mercy.
For while pain might delight the mind,
it does not fill the belly.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_6:
Look not upon me with fear, my men.
Though I seem strange, even monstrous,
were you to see with the eyes of your forebears,
your hearts would be filled with wonder.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman3_7:
We breed thoughts of single mind,
fashion tools of single purpose.
While the First Ones bring to bear
anything that the wildlands provide.
- The Wolven King
flavour.Talisman4:
The wolf greeted the king,
In the light of the harvest moon.
The wolf offered the strength of the wild,
And the king paid for it in blood.
flavour.TangleBossKeyFlavourText:
From the heart of the Tangle, the Eater of Worlds
reaches out for control of the Atlas.
flavour.TangleKeyFlavourText:
The Infinite Hunger awaits in a cosmic stomach where
whole civilisations are digested - but do not die.
flavour.TangmazusThuribleLineageSupport:
In his roiling fog, their fear becomes form.
Dark truths unveiled by a shroud. They see only
their perception of him, and thus, he is remade.
flavour.TasalioLineageSupport:
The Chieftain built a grand waikoama, and boasted that
it could never be sunk. Tasalio grinned, and the waves
rolled in, tilting the ship, cresting higher and higher...
flavour.TawhoaLineageSupport:
A scavenging warrior found Tawhoa meditating in a grove.
"There is only so much jade in this world," intoned the god.
"Take my gift to your tribe. Ironwood will grow for all time."
flavour.TecrodLineageSupport:
The Lich Lords destroyed his body, but with his dying fury,
Tecrod found a way. He lurks deep, in the blood, in the flesh,
in the Well... perhaps walking among them even now, unseen.
flavour.TemporaryTutorialSupport: This gem is only temporary, and only for the tutorial.
flavour.TestUniqueRing1:
"When one stares into the depth of the flavour text
file, one will gain no knowledge, only an addiction
to speculation." - Maligaro, Grand Trolllord
flavour.TheAdmirer: Lucian lost himself in ancient scrolls and found in those scrolls a love whose power bridged a millennium.
flavour.TheAesthete:
"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.TheArenaChampion: The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.
flavour.TheArmyOfBlood:
I gave my mind without a fight, 
The twelfth hour I lost control. 
The day is gone but there is light, 
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.
flavour.TheArtist: "Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless
flavour.TheAvenger:
Justice comes swift 
Equal to the crime 
Revenge is a gift 
Life for a life 
Eye for an eye
flavour.TheBattleBorn: "No man can best me, no demon can fell me. For I vanquish all with my axe!"
flavour.TheBeast: To know the monster, you must become the monster.
flavour.TheBetrayal: It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.
flavour.TheBlazingFire: Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.
flavour.TheBody: They say it is the head that leads, but all must flow through the body at some point.
flavour.TheBreach: Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?
flavour.TheBrittleEmperor:
"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.TheCacophony: Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.
flavour.TheCalling: Blood flows not just through veins, but through worlds.
flavour.TheCarrionCrow:
From death, life. 
From life, death. 
The wheel turns, 
and the corbies wheel overhead.
flavour.TheCartographer:
My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.
flavour.TheCataclysm: The mighty warriors traded in blows, the nimble archers in arrows, yet it was the brazen thaumaturgists who would bring catastrophe to all.
flavour.TheCatalyst: Simple actions can lead the world to an early grave.
flavour.TheCelestialJusticar: Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.
flavour.TheCelestialStone: Stare into its depths too long, and you may lose yourself entirely.
flavour.TheChainsThatBind: Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.
flavour.TheComingStorm: No man may hope to turn back the storm. You can only hope you do not attract its ire.
flavour.TheConduit: The path to godhood is guided by the hand of sacrifice.
flavour.TheCursedKing:
The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.
flavour.TheDapperProdigy: "Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."
flavour.TheDarkMage:
With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
flavour.TheDarkestDream: A dream from which you cannot awake is nothing other than a nightmare.
flavour.TheDeceiver: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.
flavour.TheDemoness: Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.
flavour.TheDevastator: Only a fool tries to contain unlimited power.
flavour.TheDoctor: "They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal
flavour.TheDoppelganger: Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!
flavour.TheDragon:
Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.
flavour.TheDragonsHeart: They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.
flavour.TheDreamer:
A dark note drips 
from the dreamer's lips, 
A honeyed melody. 
We stand, we fall 
on his beck and call, 
for in his dream we're free.
flavour.TheDreamland: All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.
flavour.TheDrunkenAristocrat: The finer the brew, the harder it is to remember drinking it.
flavour.TheEncroachingDarkness: No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.
flavour.TheEndlessDarkness: Gaze towards the stars, but beware what gazes back.
flavour.TheEndurance:
Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.
flavour.TheEnlightended:
Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.
flavour.TheEthereal:
"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge
flavour.TheExplorer: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.
flavour.TheEyeOfTheDragon:
Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.
flavour.TheFathomlessDepths: Fall into endless night; a voyage into an ocean of oblivion.
flavour.TheFeast: Shame what happened to my husband. He had such good taste.
flavour.TheFiend:
Your era is now,
your power unwavered, 
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.
flavour.TheFletcher: Let these fine arrows pack a punch.
flavour.TheFlorasGift:
Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.
flavour.TheFormlessSea:
Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.
flavour.TheForsaken: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.
flavour.TheFox:
"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb
flavour.TheGambler: "I don't believe in karma. If it were real, I would never win."
flavour.TheGarishPower: Maligaro may have valued function over form, but that did not mute his flair for the dramatic.
flavour.TheGemcutter: In the hands of a master craftsman, a worthless pebble can adorn the crown of a king.
flavour.TheGentleman: "Axes and mauls are so uncivilised. A good clean cut to the neck with a sharp blade, that's the Sarn way!"
flavour.TheGladiator:
The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars, 
they want death 
and the blood is yours.
flavour.TheHaleHeart: Though the years weakened his mind, his body remained deadly as ever.
flavour.TheHarvester:
Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.
flavour.TheHermit: The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.
flavour.TheHoarder: "More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable
flavour.TheHunger:
"How many lives have you consumed?" 
"How many times have you blinked?"
flavour.TheImmortal:
"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness
flavour.TheIncantation: When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.
flavour.TheInnocent: His brother would not atone, so he took his brother's life, and with it, his sins.
flavour.TheInoculated: Chaos spread, wreaking havoc and death. They said none would be spared, and yet here I stand.
flavour.TheInsatiable: A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.
flavour.TheInventor:
Jump right in, 
But beware 
Of things broken 
Or beyond compare.
flavour.TheIronBard:
Fourfold the refrain, fortissimo cheer.
One hundred rent twain, naught left for a bier.
The song rattles on, though hollow a bit.
See the hope is gone, no prize shall ye get.
flavour.TheJester:
Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.
flavour.TheJewellersBoon: The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.
flavour.TheKingsBlade:
"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords
flavour.TheKingsHeart: 500 times Kaom's axe fell, 500 times Kaom's Heart splintered. Finally, all that remained was a terrible, heartless Fury.
flavour.TheLastOneStanding: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.
flavour.TheLich: When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.
flavour.TheLion: The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.
flavour.TheLordInBlack:
Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.
flavour.TheLover: "I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."
flavour.TheLunarisPriestess:
Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.
flavour.TheMaster: In a world filled with chaos, he could always seek comfort in the hands of his master.
flavour.TheMayor:
A ruler is only as powerful as he is wealthy. 
Control the coin, control the empire.
flavour.TheMercenary: Loyalty can be bought. Just make sure you know who the buyer is.
flavour.TheMetalsmithsGift_: A month's work, a year's wages, a foolish shortcut through a Rhoa's nest, and a grieving bride-to-be, who never received her betrothed's great gift.
flavour.TheOath: An oath once made is an oath never broken. Do not delay in keeping it, for I take no pleasure in fools.
flavour.TheObscured: Our world, dangerous as it is, is far safer than what lies just beyond our sight.
flavour.TheOffering: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.
flavour.TheOneWithAll:
Embrace death to honour the lost,
no fear in life no matter the cost. 
With one of all we are, 
and all of one we trust, 
throughout past, present and future... be just.
flavour.TheOpulecent: Wealth can, in fact, buy happiness.
flavour.ThePackLeader: Become the leader you were born to be.
flavour.ThePact: "On this day I mark the first of many agreements that I will have with this land and its people."
flavour.ThePenitent: First, I gave my wealth, and we went hungry. Next, I gave my land, and we were homeless. Then, I gave my family, and I was alone. Last, I gave my eyes, and all I could dream was mine.
flavour.ThePoet:
God had forsaken the land 
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land 
And Victario's tears turned to blood.
flavour.ThePorcupine: The first quill separates the quick learners from the dead.
flavour.ThePriceOfProtection:
To protect her mansion, she would cut a deal with anyone. Anything. 

Something answered.
flavour.TheProfessor: The academic route to knowledge is wide and well-trodden; but it is the untaught one who scales the mountain.
flavour.ThePuzzle: As countless fractures weaken the divide, nightmares seep through from the other side.
flavour.TheQueen:
The power of the world, 
lies upon your hands.
flavour.TheRabidRhoa:
"Experiment 22A: Rhoas, when deprived of water, secrete a most delightfully potent toxin."
- Maligaro
flavour.TheRealm: If you wish to rush into strange places, be prepared to face strange things.
flavour.TheRisk: "There is no right or wrong choice, no best or worst. There are only choices and their consequences."
flavour.TheRiteOfElements:
A mind as quick as lightning, 
fists as hard as stone, 
a heart that burns with fury, 
and eyes that chill to the bone.
flavour.TheRoadToPower: A beacon on the horizon; a guiding light, a call for help, or a warning to turn back.

Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.

At the beck and call
of The Siren's hand,
winter ravages
the trembling land,
and the weight of ice that binds

If you beckon the

do not be surprised
when you are struck.

A lucky number 
For us all 
To help us through 
The perils told.

Many were slain by the sword king 
Their blood decorating his ring 
Those who retreated were slaughtered 
Those who fought bravely were honoured

On the 21st of Eterni, 
two become one, 
their light outshines 
the setting sun.

The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.

Can you hear the siren's calls,
Just beyond the sea?
A voice which hearts
of men enthralls,
I too am hooked to thee.

To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.
flavour.TheWatcher:
Strange eyes on top of spines 
Gaze beyond the veil of time 
Deep down below the mines 
A dream of crimson and of grime

A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.

A wanderer in the wild strives 
Against countless foes he survives 
A fool pursues a quest contrived 
By the gift of the witch, alive.

ascend, we must empower that flesh."

"The results prove it. With enough focused Corruption,
we can alter the fundamental laws of existence in a
small area... the question now: what do we try first?"

flavour.ThesisOfSouls:
"The soul carries the truth of what we are.
That is where we should focus our efforts."

You walk away bloodied and exhausted,
but victorious. You have overcome.

Your broken body lies forgotten,
nourishing only the worms.

Mortals spend their lives wondering which
fate shall be theirs. Chaos takes amusement
in knowing the answer: all of them.

You stagger away, embarrassed by your failure.
Your only consolation prize is your life.

Fight enough battles, and it
becomes all but inevitable.

There is always a chance, however small,
that you might actually succeed.

unthinkable and the unimaginable made manifest.

rattled in his head. He'd no control over crops, or herds, but

absence of stillness, their screams echoed.

They knew the truth, but had no choice

there would be a chance

That which could not be digested

of whole cultures, of entire worlds.

Champions of her collection may take what

Minds are not the only thing

There is a place, a state of being,

I have already lost more

with gems and set forth alone to face the endless hordes.

something was very wrong among the first Kalguurans.

paranoid. Now, only two remained... Olroth and Vorana.

lines tracing a constellation. You may only see
pieces, but I see the whole, and it will be glorious."

The Order of the Chalice still exists today.
Its priests teach engineering, mathematics,
and science to all those who would learn.

can deny that my work has made quite the splash..."
- Maligaro's Journal
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt10:
The First of the Sky was the Last of the First.
It was he who showed us that our limits are self-imposed,
that what we take for law may just be an illusion.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt11: There can be no defence against the celestial siblings entropy and time.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt11x:
"The form of this replica came to me in a troubled dream.
I do not believe we should ever allow it to be used."
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt12:
He may have returned from the frozen southern reaches,
but that doesn't mean he ever truly escaped them.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt13:
The Oriathans built their empire on naval mobility, which allowed
them to wage war wherever their enemy was weakest.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt14:
Within each of us exists a being of pure malice,
held back only by the lies we tell ourselves.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt15: Those that can never die have but one wish.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt2:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt3:
Use the dead to stave off death,
An armour of bones and rot.
Hanging on with bated breath,
One lapse and all for naught.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt3x:
"Further research must be done on Prototype #282.
There is power here, if it can be tapped."
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt4:
"Every life is a story.
If you're not writing your own,
you'd better know who's writing it for you!"
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt5: Thin is the line between mechanical genius and magic.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt6:
Don't hesitate; bring death to all, conclusively and swiftly,
or they will give you the same treatment.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt7: What mother wouldn't give her life for that of her children?
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt8:
Ask any tracker and they'll tell you:
the most dangerous animals
are the ones who don't bother to hide.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt9: Look to the darkness for nourishment and you will never go hungry.
flavour.UniqueBodyDexInt9x:
"Eyes of black, three by three, staring ever darker into me..."
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueBodyInt1:
Shavronne's apparel became ever more extravagant
as her body and soul became ever more corrupted.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt10:
The quickest way to understand
your own strengths and weaknesses
is to walk in the skin of another.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt11:
Renowned by those distinguished,
Exalted by the few.
He skulks in darkness, 
and watches from beneath the city.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt12:
Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt13:
We happily give our limbs.
A net woven to keep safe the bones of the Lords.

This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Chayula
flavour.UniqueBodyInt14:
The Lords are chosen so carefully.
Only they may grace His flesh.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt15:
As she was sentenced to death, Doedre was silent.
As she was tied to the stake, Doedre was silent.
As the flames licked away her life, Doedre was silent.
But Wraeclast had not heard the last of her.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt16:
He took me by my hand, promised me power beyond compare.
But I did not do it for power.
I did it for love.
And I'd do it again in an instant.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt17:
The First of the Night was the first explorer
It was she who first braved night's terrors
and found comfort in silence and solace.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt18:
In their crimson nightmare, the Vaal are still sacrificing themselves to her glory and beauty. 
They stab their own hearts and cry out in ecstasy, only to rise again.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt19:
Exceptional men and women of strong will can flicker a spark, 
but something much greater is needed to unleash the wildfire of true divine flames.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt2: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt20: Imbue the body with stolen spirit, hold the leash tight.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt21: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt3:
My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood
flavour.UniqueBodyInt4:
Despair hums, softly, deadly, in the bones of my enemies.
Eyes will burn, and souls wither, as they bask in my radiance.
flavour.UniqueBodyInt5:
The night of a thousand ribbons
To remember the day of a thousand flames
When Sarn burned
And was born again
flavour.UniqueBodyInt7:
The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made
flavour.UniqueBodyInt8:
When dead men rise and darkness falls
Only faith can be your walls
Walls of Light, not of brick
Twice as strong and twice as thick
flavour.UniqueBodyInt9:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
flavour.UniqueBodyStr1:
The warrior who
fears will fall.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr10:
The First of the Deep was the First of All.
It was He who conquered the waves,
who stood guard as land rose from sea.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr11:
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?
flavour.UniqueBodyStr12: The giant cares not for the ants.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr1x:
"Useless for our purposes, but perhaps we can sell Prototype #5
to an archmage to fund other experiments."
flavour.UniqueBodyStr2: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr3:
Tears of blood, aching heart,
My dear Isildria must depart.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr4:
Give me neither havens nor solace;
They are for the weak and frightened.
Instead, light the path to greatness,
So that I may begin my bright pursuit.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr5:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr6:
"The Virtue Gems are a gift from the land, 
our land, and we will not let our gifts
be destroyed by savages."
- Marceus Lioneye
flavour.UniqueBodyStr7: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr8: The pirates of Pondium know that full pockets have a tendency to sink.
flavour.UniqueBodyStr9:
"The Council have a great many secrets.
Some are better kept that way, Cospri."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex1:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex2:
"There's nothing like imminent death
to galvanize one's purpose in life."
- Malachai the Soulless.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex3:
"When your back is against the wall,
And your opponent is bleeding you dry,
There is only one appropriate response:
Unbridled, overwhelming violence."
- Daresso, the Sword King
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex4:
"The Consort of Chaos descended,
swiftly, brutally, artfully, she consumed the living,
leaving naught behind but a Rosemarie bloom,
to celebrate the massacre."
- Blass, explorer, hunter, adventurer
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex5:
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. 
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex6:
Swift and silent.
One strike, one corpse.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex7: Simple is the life of the bear.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex8:
The First of the Plains was the First of the Hunt
It was she who showed us that there is honour
in waiting in the shadows and picking your moment.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDex8x:
"Attempt #120: the prototype has finally achieved power similar to the original
without breaking all the bones of the test subject. A rousing success."
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDexInt1:
"When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.UniqueBodyStrDexInt2:
Destined for sacrifice,
they were dressed in garments
that blurred the lines between this world
and the next.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt1:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt10:
A general may carry his men to greatness, 
or be dragged beneath the mire by their burden.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt11: A glacier of putrid meat, crushing mountains and valleys alike.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt12:
Shrouded in seed, a conduit of contagion,
yet the source of septicity remains unknown.

"This was the first step in some grand design, 
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher." 
- Dominus, High Templar
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt15:
Seek not to avoid the mortal pains of this world.
In flagellation, there lies freedom from temptation.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt2: Nothing stops the pain like a courageous rush into battle.

"Prototype #7 achieved even greater injury responsiveness than expected,
though at considerable cost to the long-term survival rate of the user."
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt3:
When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt4:
. . . and the Light faded and hope waned
Zahndethus cast aside his faith
and embraced the darkness.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt5:
Only light may banish the shadows from this land
And the black lies wrapped around your heart
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt6: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt7:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt8:
Fragile is the vessel that holds the soul.
Wrap it in cloth, seal it tight.
For once the seal is broken, the contents are lost forever.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt9:
When it comes to finding a use for surplus,
a rich man has within himself
boundless creativity.
flavour.UniqueBodyStrInt9x:
"Better... stronger... more vital... and then... failure. Always, failure.
What key fundamental secret are we missing?"
flavour.UniqueBootsAtlas1: Nothing spreads as quickly as an idea.

Live and stagnate, or risk death for truth.
I would rather see the end of the Vaal
than help it tread water." 
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavour.UniqueBootsDemigods1: Victory is on the march and nothing can stop it.
flavour.UniqueBootsDemigods2: Those who burn for victory burn for eternity.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex1: Do not let them step on your feet. Keep them at bay.

The Goat King knew not of war,
of the lands and laws he trampled.
The Goat King knew only joy
at turning life to ash.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex11: The higher you soar, the further you must fall.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex13:
A secret is a weapon your enemies do not have.
When the First of the Plains hunted, she moved in silence and acted quickly.
To do otherwise is to arm your foes.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex14:
The High Priests ensured the loyalty of their slaves by habituating
them to narcotic stimulants with lethal withdrawals.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex15:
The inferno surged past, devastating Stridevolf, but the Maraketh
warrior somehow remained. Soot-blackened and resolute, she
grinned. In that moment, the bandit king knew true despair.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex2: The wyrm draws warmth from the fires of desire.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex3:
Alive but not unscathed, Victario fled
as slaughter blossomed at the gates.
flavour.UniqueBootsDex4:
"Sharks thrash and swirl
To the pounding drum of their frenzied hearts
As they dance in the waters red."
-Lavianga, Guardian of the Karui Way
flavour.UniqueBootsDex5:
"Death can be outrun with these, but beware!
In running from death, you may forget to live."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 202
flavour.UniqueBootsDex7:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.UniqueBootsDex8: It takes a clear mind to outrun a storm.

Move in with haste.
Strike quick, strike hard.
Vanish like smoke in the wind.

system in the hallway functioned as expected."
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt1:
Blazing body, shining bold.
Dance beneath the orb of gold!
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt10:
Relentlessness. Nothing more, nothing less.

test subject by timing their arrows between his explosive dashes."

flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt11:
Every glorious conquest
stands astride innocent bones.
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt12:
A multitude of beings share a wretched existence
irrevocably bound together in perpetual torture.
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt2:
"Bored gods won't give you any favours."
- Maraketh proverb
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt4:
Those Theopolis fatcats put a price on our heads.
Let's see what they'll pay for their own.
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt5:
Step into the void
and experience true freedom.

flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt6: Even the dead serve the Lightless.

When the fires spilled out of the mountain, The First of the Night wove a net
and was carried into the night on its hot winds.
Though we cannot live without danger, we can learn to live with it.
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt8:
Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.

Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.
flavour.UniqueBootsDexInt9:
Only a fool seeks meaning
in a life so fleeting.

In their hour of desperate need, the Knights of the Sun
called out for aid... and the Black Scythe answered.

Where others would retreat when vulnerable,
Olroth the Gallant fought deeper into battle.
flavour.UniqueBootsInt2: All the world is my home.

Shavronne raced to Brutus' side,
her last hope against the Karui tide.
flavour.UniqueBootsInt4:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.

"They say that you should take life's troubles in your stride.

- Gaius Sentari

To fight an enemy on their lands is a tactical mistake. 
Make those lands your own, and the mistake becomes theirs.
flavour.UniqueBootsInt7:
The quick die young, the brilliant go mad,
and the powerful stand alone in a wasteland of their own creation.
flavour.UniqueBootsInt8:
Though the path we walk is the same,
each journey is different.

and improved ability to micromanage us, I'm not so sure."

The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell.

When the land rose above the sea, The First of the Deep did not move.
When the sky turned to fire, The First of the Deep did not perish.
We must remember our place, and play to our strengths.

Centuries ago, there existed a unique grove imbued with ancestral fire.
As with all things, the Karui used its wood for war.
flavour.UniqueBootsStr12:
In a void strewn with incandescent stardust,
the emissary of flame traverses interplanetary space
consuming the knowledge of fallen civilisations.
flavour.UniqueBootsStr2: Don't flinch. It's a waste of good hitting time.
flavour.UniqueBootsStr3:
Our home was swallowed beneath 
the great mountain for our complacency. 
Now we must prove our value to the Molten One 
by sating his hunger for life.
flavour.UniqueBootsStr5: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod

We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.

We leave a trail, that we may know
where never we will return.

- Administrator Qotra

Stand and lead the righteous pride,
Fight till death, never hide.

it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."

"A lick of shadow may ease
the petty frictions of one's life."

flavour.UniqueBootsStrDex4:
The cursed ghosts march forever,
On their hopeless last endeavour.
flavour.UniqueBootsStrDex5:
Corruption sweeps across this land,
but our bloodline is clear.
It is our duty to keep it so.
flavour.UniqueBootsStrDex6:
A bird, too heavily laden, cannot take flight.
The First of the Sky teaches us to put aside our possessions
so that we may live more freely.
flavour.UniqueBootsStrDex7:
All that was loved, all that was hated -
naught remains but ash.

Pray that the flames find fascination,
for the true end follows when the great eye closes.

Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.

Alberon walked among the accursed,
and they welcomed him.

To extend your life as long as possible
is to extend all the maladies that come with it.
flavour.UniqueBootsStrInt5:
For the immortal, what is the difference
between an age and an instant?

rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.

Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch

The Eternals commanded an army that need not eat, sleep, or breathe

flavour.UniqueBow15:
Night's frost becomes morning's dew
Darkness cleansed, pure and new.
flavour.UniqueBow16: We stand together. We strike together.

Upon the red pyre we are born.

Through droughts, fires, floods and frost,
the ancient giants stand resolute,
while deep in the rich, dark earth,
their grasp stretches ever farther.

Their last thoughts were not of their friends,
or their families, or their homes.
Their last thoughts were untethered from reality,
and bathed in fear and ferocity.

A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.

Mark us with mercy, then press on with care,
Execute us steadily, notch away at our despair.

A captain's first love is his ship.

or forever linger apart.

Whispered memory,
A shimmer in the darkness.
