but the offer of her blood was refused. 
She rose from the pit alive and anew.  
A Leader. A Conquerer. A Viper.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt22: The Light drove the darkness from our lands and from our hearts.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt23:
The villagers seared the blight with lightning, but it only forked into countless tendrils.

This item can be anointed by Cassia
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt24: A dance as old as time.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt25:
Where that searing dawn fell, silence reigned.
We sought the shadows, but none remained.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt26:
Bold and beautiful, a castaway
Hemmed and hawed, for her to stay
Oh, what I'd give for one more day
For she's the one that got away
-Franklin
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt4: The malice in her gaze froze blood and shattered bone.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt5: You are the powerless master of fire.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt6:
Many still hold the belief that the fossilised bones
of Vaal sacrifices have magical properties.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt7:
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt8:
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind. 
A curious paradox."	
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.UniqueHelmetInt9:
A scar of the flesh you'll never forget,
A scar of the mind you'll never remember.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr1:
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr10:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr11: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr3:
When you have slain all of your enemies,
what is left to fear?
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr3x:
"While Prototype #3 does imbue its wearer with strength to match the original,
the first researcher to don it burst into flames when he walked into sunlight..."
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr4:
Our skin turns to ash
and we are swallowed by his brilliant red light.

This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Xoph
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr5: He burns us to keep us from harm.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr6:
"The Emperor's trusted surgeons are not the only ones who 
practice the dark arts. Some of us are just more discreet."
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr7:
The villagers seared the blight with fire, but it only spread like dancing flames.

This item can be anointed by Cassia
flavour.UniqueHelmetStr9:
A cacophony of battle cries
Reverberate through time and space
Inflicting pain beyond measure
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex10:
As the fiery remnants of our outpost were subsumed into the caldera,
a thunderous voice echoed across the barren landscape,
"Your fragility is your folly. May others rise where you have fallen."
- El'Abin, Bloodeater
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex2:
Swift as thought are the actions of Man 
when borne on wings of divine providence.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex3: May you never hear it toll.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex4:
"What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex5:
All that was left of the Iron King was his bleached skull.
Yet it was all the Iron King needed.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex6:
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex7:
When you're on the run,
look only to yourself for survival.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex8: Expand one single ambition to crystal clarity... and beyond.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrDex9:
The single well-placed arrow that changes the world
must be preceded by ten thousand practice shots.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt1:
"The craven mind is sharp with self interest.
The honourable mind is much easier to manipulate."
 - Malachai the Soulless
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt10:
Your memories are a bridge to the past.
Let no one cross.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt11:
The eyes of the living hold a glimmer of hope.
Don't waste it.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt12:
When the rains come, we cower beneath shelter.
The First of the Deep teaches us
that we should seek no shelter but ourselves.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt13:
Our flesh is our most sacred gift.
Taint it not with the occult.

This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Summoning
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt14:
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt15:
You will know if your subjects follow you from fear
or respect when you have your first moment of weakness.
If it's the former, they will tear you into pieces like rabid dogs.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt16: The judge determines worthiness by comparison to the paragon: himself.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt17: Divinity is not the only path to enlightenment.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt18: The Azmeri must never touch the Tears of Maji, lest Viridi weep.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt18x:
"I believed I understood Prototype #112 quite fully, until a test subject
with Azmeri ancestry donned it. I will be haunted by the results
for the rest of my life."  - Researcher Graven
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt19:
The line that divides hope and fear,
life and death, crowd and mob,
is as thin as a whisper.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt2:
In the battle for honour, Geofri won.
Not so, the battle for survival.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt20:
"Her sisters eternally fought for that shining apex in the skies,
but Viridi instead found strength in humility."
- Azmerian Creation Myth
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt21:
Primordial rage slumbers, waiting for the call
of the stars to return and swallow the world.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt3: Where top is bottom and weak is strong.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt4:
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt4x:
"Prototype #722 might look like a helmet, but I believe it to be something else
entirely. The visions it shows the wearer... are beyond mortal endurance..."
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt6:
Tukohama, Tawhoa and Kitava went to the lake to fish.
Tawhoa weaved a net to catch the fish,
Tukohama built a fire to cook the fish,
and Kitava swallowed the entire lake, fish and all, with a single gulp.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt7:
A strong pair of legs may carry you far,
but a silver tongue and a few brutes
can take you to the edge of the world.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt8:
Greatest is the Brine King's domain,
and every day it grows a little greater,
not through force, but patience.
flavour.UniqueHelmetStrInt9:
"To touch it is to be overwhelmed with the need to carve your name into history.
A face no one remembers, yet once you have seen it, you will never forget."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 48
flavour.UniqueHelmetWreath1:
To stand triumphant you must serve
no master other than your own ambition.
flavour.UniqueHelmetWreath1v2:
The second trial brought most to their knees.
But not you.
flavour.UniqueIntHelmet1:
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
flavour.UniqueIntHelmet2:
Asenath's mind was as quick and nimble
as the fingers that drew her bowstring.
flavour.UniqueIntHelmet3:
"It takes true strength to hold power,
and my grip grows tighter by the day."
 - Emperor Chitus
flavour.UniqueJewel1:
In the end, time comes for all of us.
It just comes for some much sooner.
flavour.UniqueJewel100:
At night, as a young Daresso shared his bed with a woman whose name he could not recall,
his thoughts remained in the one place he called his own: The Grand Arena.
flavour.UniqueJewel101:
The infamous Weylam Roth was never afraid
to push the boundaries of Templar authority,
and was never deterred when the Templar pushed back.
flavour.UniqueJewel102:
Izaro gave rise to Chitus.
Chitus gave rise to Voll.
None could know how it would end.
None could stop it.
flavour.UniqueJewel103:
Exposure led to the deaths of many slaves.
And it was the duty of slaves to bury the dead in the frozen ground.
A growing circle of misery and death 
that the elite were all too happy to sustain.
flavour.UniqueJewel104:
The Cataclysm was but the first act in a play of horrors.
The dead lingered, and the living began to rot.
flavour.UniqueJewel105:
"Rage, malice, hunger - some traits are more easily carried across the barrier of death."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavour.UniqueJewel106:
Of the elements at the thaumaturgist's disposal, lightning remained the least understood.
The simple passage of energy from one to another could result in profound power, or rapid death.
flavour.UniqueJewel107:
Sarn's crematorium, built amidst the city's slums, 
coated the nearby shanties in a film of ash.
The dwellers grew ill, sputtering and coughing,
and in this way the crematorium guaranteed it would have many customers.
flavour.UniqueJewel107b:
"Would you leave an orchard of apples to rot unharvested?
A cemetery is no different." 
-Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavour.UniqueJewel108:
The Eternal Empire gave few freedoms to the Ezomytes, but fostered their talents as archers. 
At auction, an Ezomyte slave's value was only as good as their aim.
flavour.UniqueJewel11:
"The swallow flew fast and took many turns,
spilling a seed where no plant had grown before. 
This seed grew and grew until the desert became fertile and abundant. 
Your mind is like this seed." 
- Maraketh Proverb
flavour.UniqueJewel110:
In the years that followed the twisted sky,
cold winds cloaked Wraeclast in snow.
The pure-white blanket masked a black heart
that lay dormant deep beneath the earth.
flavour.UniqueJewel111:
The skilled know how to learn.
The talented know who to learn from.
flavour.UniqueJewel111x:
"Twelve test subjects were expended in the production of Prototype #800.
Was it worth the expense? Only time will tell."
flavour.UniqueJewel112: Enough mice can kill a wolf.
flavour.UniqueJewel113: Hurt as you would be hurt.
flavour.UniqueJewel114:
Candles with the brightest light
Bring life to death and day to night.
But lovely as the glow may seem,
Their light is fleeting, as a dream...
flavour.UniqueJewel115:
One by one, they stood their ground against a creature 
they had no hope of understanding, let alone defeating,
and one by one, they became a part of it.
flavour.UniqueJewel116:
We are born raw and untested, and we are shaped by life.

This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence
flavour.UniqueJewel117:
Though the body rots, the spirit lives on.

This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence
flavour.UniqueJewel118:
Any thought, no matter how fleeting, changes the thinker.

This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence
flavour.UniqueJewel119:
We are as much shaped by what we do
as what is done to us.
flavour.UniqueJewel120:
Take comfort knowing that, even in death,
we may serve our Queen and fuel her empire.
flavour.UniqueJewel121:
A keen mind sees what others do not,
makes connections where others do not, 
and is dangerous in a way that others are not.
flavour.UniqueJewel122:
Kaom watched the torches patrol the top of the Watch. 
He observed the lay of the beach, its barricades and rocks, 
and his men in their canoes, ready to lay their lives down for him.
But when his foot hit the sand, he thought only of the fight.
flavour.UniqueJewel123:
Standing behind iron bars,
Daresso thought of his adoring fans cheering his name, 
his wife's warm embrace waiting for him, 
and of the celebrations that would soon be thrown in his name.
But when the arena gate lifted, he thought only of the fight.
flavour.UniqueJewel124:
Voll stood at the gates of Sarn, and a nation stood behind him. 
He thought of the righteousness of his cause, 
and of the glory he would bring to the empire he would soon lead. 
But as Chitus and his gemlings advanced, he thought only of the fight.
flavour.UniqueJewel125:
"I don't know how I know, 
I just know that I know."
flavour.UniqueJewel127:
In the weeks that followed the Cataclysm,
the dead began to rot and fester.
The air fouled with such concentration,
that passing birds drowned in flight.
flavour.UniqueJewel128: They believed themselves the pinnacle of civilisation, but that height toppled their empire.
flavour.UniqueJewel129: They believed themselves the greatest warriors, but that savagery turned upon their own.
flavour.UniqueJewel130: They believed themselves the most ordered, but that tradition turned their forests to salt.
flavour.UniqueJewel131: They believed themselves the utmost faithful, but that conviction became oppression.
flavour.UniqueJewel132: They believed themselves better than the past, but that confidence brought about nightmare.
flavour.UniqueJewel133:
The enslaved Ezomyte clans were not permitted to own weapons.
For years, they trained in secret, watching and waiting for the
perfect moment to reveal the true depth of the Empire's folly.
flavour.UniqueJewel134: Forsake what you might have had. Command power beyond your potential.
flavour.UniqueJewel135: Lose that which you never had. Gain power you could not have grasped.
flavour.UniqueJewel136: Though we cannot touch; one thought, one wish, through centuries alone in darkness.
flavour.UniqueJewel137:
Savour the bitter, cherish the sweet,
For there may never be another chance to eat.
flavour.UniqueJewel138:
"Try as I might, I could not escape it.
When I closed my eyes, I saw only death.
Each breath tainted with the scent of seared and smouldering flesh,
And each sound tangled with pleas for mercy."
flavour.UniqueJewel139:
You can take the girl out of the woods, 
but you can't take the woods out of the girl.
flavour.UniqueJewel13_: Even the strongest of steel can be made to bend.
flavour.UniqueJewel14:
When you get down to it, we're all really just
an unprepared meal for something or someone.
flavour.UniqueJewel140:
Pain is a fine motivator,
But if you seek the truth,
Fear of pain unknown has no parallel.
flavour.UniqueJewel141:
As the dead battered Highgate's barricades,
The Black Sekhema accepted her fate,
And stood her ground.
flavour.UniqueJewel142:
Maids used to threaten to send misbehaving children of
nobility to the pits beneath the Grand Arena.
For the children of slaves, it was more than just a threat.
flavour.UniqueJewel143:
Once you begin to rely on your weapons, 
You ensure you can't live without them.
flavour.UniqueJewel144:
It was a great honour to fight at the front. 
The few that survived the initial charge were guaranteed fame and fortune.
flavour.UniqueJewel145: You need not go looking for a second opinion.
flavour.UniqueJewel146: If you're going to act like you're better than everyone else, make sure you are.
flavour.UniqueJewel147: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
flavour.UniqueJewel148:
The sky, the land, the people burned.
What little still stood soon faced wild, battering storms.
Winter arrived suddenly and stayed for a generation.
Civilisation was not simply halted, but reversed, erased.
flavour.UniqueJewel15:
The strongest Karui tribes left the longest impressions on the land.
Their symbols served as guidance many generations
after their creators had been buried deep beneath the earth.
flavour.UniqueJewel150:
Quenched, the blade hardens, becomes brittle.
The edge will not last forever,
But when it breaks, its service will continue.
flavour.UniqueJewel151:
Her apprentice spends hours working the steel,
and the end result is melted for scrap.
Each one made better than the last.
Each one made more quickly.
She knows the path well.
flavour.UniqueJewel152: Maximum power fueled by science gone mad.
flavour.UniqueJewel153: Indiscriminate destruction fueled by science gone mad.
flavour.UniqueJewel154: The Hated Slave seeks dominion over his own kind.
flavour.UniqueJewel155: The Sovereign of the Well seeks dominion over the light.
flavour.UniqueJewel156: The Blackblooded seeks dominion over darkness itself.
flavour.UniqueJewel157: The Liege of the Lightless seeks dominion over the surface dwellers.
flavour.UniqueJewel158:
"We awoke to a sudden jungle rupturing the valleys of our home.
Grasping limbs coiled around us, into us. We sank into each other,
then rose into the living sky. My family screams alongside me still."
flavour.UniqueJewel159:
"We awoke to a sudden dawn cresting through the mountains.
Each peak rose into searing fire, a massive roiling tide.
A great eye gazed upon us, and we became known—utterly."
flavour.UniqueJewel16:
When you create life from nothing, 
sometimes things get a little stuck in between.
flavour.UniqueJewel160:
The minds of those studied utterly by the Cleansing Fire
continue to think and dream and beg for silence...
flavour.UniqueJewel161_:
The bodies of those wholly subsumed by the Tangle
continue to merge and mutate and cry out for release...
flavour.UniqueJewel162:
Gripping the stolen Spear of Solerai in hand,
the bandit king of Stridevolf watched his enclave burn.
As foretold, the weapon was powerful beyond compare,
but using it had cost him absolutely everything.
flavour.UniqueJewel163_:
She was the last of countless progeny bred to test the limits of limitless power.
In the cosmic prison of her birth, her siblings fought each other to the death
for supremacy. She alone reached her limit... and broke through.
flavour.UniqueJewel164:
This world is not good enough for her,
so I will make a better one. Nothing
matters but the pursuit of perfection.
flavour.UniqueJewel165: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.
flavour.UniqueJewel166: A mountain fortress safe from the storm.
flavour.UniqueJewel167: A mass of flesh writhing with savage fury.
flavour.UniqueJewel171:
Logic wanes in shining faith, and in rationalism, ardour dims
Thus, the cynic and the zealot are divided
But can they not be one and the same?
flavour.UniqueJewel172:
How simple a power, on which empires turn,
when one man stands firm and says, "I refuse."
flavour.UniqueJewel173:
The true secret of the elements
is that all are one and the same.
flavour.UniqueJewel174:
Within a firestorm, the Thane commands the flames
Emblazoned by glory and the song of the First Ones
For the master of fire fears nothing.
flavour.UniqueJewel175:
In darkest night, 'neath waxen moon
A witch snatches a boy from his room.
He wards off her hexes
The witch he perplexes
And so becomes part of her stew.
flavour.UniqueJewel176:
Fellshrine stood as a holy bastion opposite the
Chamber of Sins, and all that it represented.
For one to rise, the other must fall.
flavour.UniqueJewel177:
The spirits of our ancestors guided us from the Archipelago to the continent.
Inextricably, the purity of our souls is linked to the ones who came before us.
flavour.UniqueJewel178:
At the core of the warrior's spirit,
a fierce determination burns,
igniting their capacity to endure.
flavour.UniqueJewel18:
When you throw iron weapons against an iron wall
you only make the wall grow thicker.
flavour.UniqueJewel1b:
In the end, time comes for all of us.
For some, it comes much sooner.
flavour.UniqueJewel2:
"True Thaumaturgy can only be learned 
by the brilliant or the mad."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.UniqueJewel20: It's hard to stay still when you're engulfed in flames.
flavour.UniqueJewel20x:
"Does this jewel accomplish nothing? If only we could somehow
master cold and turn it to our own ends..." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavour.UniqueJewel22:
And lo, Nick said unto his disciples:
"It May Be Crazy Broken"
And his disciples replied
"Meh"
And made it anyway.
flavour.UniqueJewel24:
The first green shoots of Spring are the most resilient,
and the most vulnerable.
flavour.UniqueJewel24x: "Distribute Prototype #723 to the guards. Perhaps their survival rate will increase."
flavour.UniqueJewel25:
The difference between the master and his apprentice
is what they see when they look at the same block of wood.
flavour.UniqueJewel26:
"If one is an annoyance
then a hundred is a threat."
- Ancient Karui Proverb
flavour.UniqueJewel28: Each life taken makes the next a little easier.
flavour.UniqueJewel29:
"Take your time, make all your plans. 
Then tell me which plan
pulls my axe from your ribs."
- Barkhul, the Butcher
flavour.UniqueJewel3:
If you do not learn from a won battle
then you have already lost the war.
flavour.UniqueJewel30: When your thoughts flow like a river, why build a dam?
flavour.UniqueJewel32_:
"Curiously, as I deepen my understanding of Thaumaturgy,
I find I better understand the land we inhabit
and everything in it."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavour.UniqueJewel33: Some people live on the suffering of others.
flavour.UniqueJewel34: Working smart and working hard aren't mutually exclusive.
flavour.UniqueJewel35:
Picking a lock takes an immense amount of skill and practice.
Breaking it with a hammer takes about three seconds.
flavour.UniqueJewel36:
"Greatly outnumbered, Deshret dressed her personal guard 
in identical garb. When the Empire rode north, Deshret and 
her guard took turns revealing themselves, creating the illusion 
of speed beyond the capabilities of even the Virtue Gems."
- History of the Maraketh
flavour.UniqueJewel37: There is no force without movement.
flavour.UniqueJewel4: A gentle hand rarely leaves a mark on the world.
flavour.UniqueJewel41: A sharp eye can be more deadly than a sharp blade.
flavour.UniqueJewel42: A steady hand can hold back an army.
flavour.UniqueJewel43: A quick step can advance great plans.
flavour.UniqueJewel44x: "The effect is subtle, but potentially lethal..."
flavour.UniqueJewel45: What you earn is almost as important as what you take.
flavour.UniqueJewel46_: Victory is as simple as being the last one standing.
flavour.UniqueJewel47: The best dancers often make the best fighters.
flavour.UniqueJewel48:
Winter provides us with her own weapons,
hanging from the eaves of our homes.
flavour.UniqueJewel49:
Leaders are not born in times of peace.
Leaders are born in ruins and flames.
flavour.UniqueJewel5:
The shield crab does not leave his shell unless it is forced to, 
and even then, it knows to keep its distance.
flavour.UniqueJewel50: "I've yet to see prayer stop an arrow."
flavour.UniqueJewel51:
The Azmeri ascetics learnt the power
of going without the body's ordinary cravings.
flavour.UniqueJewel52:
Once you understand how your body truly works
you can't help but treat it better.
flavour.UniqueJewel53:
"Movement expends energy, but perhaps a little of that energy
can be recaptured and... reappropriated."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.UniqueJewel54: For the ambitious, flesh is a limitation.
flavour.UniqueJewel55: True strength can be found anywhere, and in anything.
flavour.UniqueJewel56:
The prisoners of the empire raised their shackled hands.
Begging to be delivered from Corruption.
The rebellion smote their chains,
And gave them the freedom to choose corruption for themselves.
flavour.UniqueJewel57:
Ondar not only betrayed his emperor,
He betrayed his friend.
And in his dying moments, Chitus ensured,
That Ondar felt the full weight of his guilt.
flavour.UniqueJewel58:
With a fire burning brash in his golden eye,
Marceus fired his arrow into the pitch-dark sky,
And seared the hope of surprise,
From Kaom's skulking horde.
flavour.UniqueJewel59:
The Sekhema rode to the mountain,
With her tribe, devoted and strong.
And sewed shut the mouth of nightmare,
So that it would not consume her world.
flavour.UniqueJewel6:
The carpenter who picks up a blade is not mad.
He's ambitious.
flavour.UniqueJewel60:
Maligaro understood that devotion to science,
Means devotion to trial and error.
For Maligaro's errors, death was slow,
And very painful.
flavour.UniqueJewel61:
There's no motivation for genius
quite like desperation.
flavour.UniqueJewel61x: "Prototype #298 must be contained in a non-conductive glass box at all times."
flavour.UniqueJewel62:
When Voll took the throne,
He swore to care for the empire with eyes open.
And so he looked to the salvation of his people,
Blind to the damnation in his hands.
flavour.UniqueJewel63:
From north to south the sea of fire swept,
Rolling waves of gorging flame,
Growing taller and hungrier,
With every land they consumed.
flavour.UniqueJewel64:
As a boy, Rigwald was taught to hunt,
Through the first snows of winter,
When beasts have gorged their fill,
And see nothing but the long slumber ahead.
flavour.UniqueJewel65:
The Purity Rebels fought with heart and soul,
To free their empire from corruption.
And the fires of war did merely serve,
To temper the steel of their spirits.
flavour.UniqueJewel66:
The once-glorious emperor spent his final days
imprisoned in his greatest creation;
a tool to filter out the unworthy
that pushed a monster to power.
flavour.UniqueJewel67:
A mage from the coast rode up on a broken nag, legs burnt to his bones.
Before he collapsed, he uttered:
"I watched the world we know end yesterday."
flavour.UniqueJewel68:
Chitus began to aggressively expand his empire
into neighbouring nations at great human cost. 
But for absolute power, there is no price 
that a Perandus won't pay.
flavour.UniqueJewel69:
Lioneye's men stood at the walls,
eyeing the savages that walked the beach below.
With a single word,
a thousand bodies, and ten thousand arrows,
would litter the sands.
flavour.UniqueJewel7:
The Darktongue clan has long let their undead feed at the table
with their slaves, and occasionally on them.
flavour.UniqueJewel70:
Long after the Karui passed through,
the whispers of those who stood their ground
at Lioneye's Watch could be heard amongst the rubble.
flavour.UniqueJewel71: Why waste the good stuff on something that's going to blow up?
flavour.UniqueJewel71x: "A curious jewel. Like so many others, a shining little paradox."
flavour.UniqueJewel72:
Anyone can catch a lumbering beast.
Try catching a bird before it has even landed.
flavour.UniqueJewel73:
The Ezomytes have a saying:
Take everything and waste nothing.
flavour.UniqueJewel74: Saboteurs, like chefs, have their own secret recipes.
flavour.UniqueJewel74x:
"Researchers will refrain from giving test subjects virtue gems which produce traps.
We are still finding explosives in the vents months later." 
- Administrator Qotra
flavour.UniqueJewel75: Thoughts that shimmer like light across the rain.
flavour.UniqueJewel76: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.
flavour.UniqueJewel77: Fists that strike like a falling tree.
flavour.UniqueJewel78: The smaller the teeth, the sharper the bite.
flavour.UniqueJewel79:
All revere the earth they walk,
For it wields strength beyond compare,
Holds knowledge more than thought,
Stands long after all else falls.
flavour.UniqueJewel80:
They roamed, they fed, they grew,
Killing as they went,
Conquer though they may,
Their hearts will never be content.
flavour.UniqueJewel81:
"A stone is not a stone.
It is but one part of a fortress."
- Ezomyte proverb
flavour.UniqueJewel82:
"Do not cause the land to stir,
It holds secrets better unknown."
- Azmerian proverb
flavour.UniqueJewel82x:
"The summoned golems immediately battered through the chamber wall

flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword1:
"Today, clansmen, my sword is my voice!"
- Rigwald, at the Battle of Glarryn
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword10:
The cuts on my hands are a small price to pay
for the opportunity to drive my steel
beyond the flesh and into the demon's soul.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword11:
Faintly gleaming in the moonlit night,
Kondo's Pride was primed to fight.
Driven by an inner fire,
bloodlust, spite and ill desire.
He swiftly moved to strike them all,
wreaking havoc like a steel squall.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword12: The end is written into the beginning.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword13:
A weapon born of nothingness,
can only create more nothingness.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword14: Witness the emergence of a new cosmic power.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword2:
Stoic visage, icy heart.
Life of sorrow, lived apart.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword3:
His final sensation was of the executioner's blade.
It was not cold, instead warm and reassuring,
murmuring a promise of better times ahead.
Smiling, he returned death's embrace.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword4:
The nobles wanted to take her throne.
She let the peasants take their wealth.
The peasants wanted to take her wealth.
She let the soldiers take their heads.
The soldiers wanted to take her head.
She sat on her throne and wept.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword5:
Heavy as guilt.
Beautiful as temptation.
Painful as betrayal.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword6:
Give yourself to the flames and your name
will burn in the minds of men forever.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword6x:
"Ice and flame antagonized in the essence of a prototype.
What once burned now chills the soul."
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword7:
Soon, the pleas for mercy were muted.
Only one voice remained.
Laughing.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword8:
So the seed of hate was born,
Evil forged and Hope forsworn.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword9:
Take your partners by the hand,
Keep your steps in time.
Swing together, spin apart,
And dance with death sublime.
flavour.UniqueVaalReliquary:
Ambition followed progress,
Vanity followed passion,
Hubris followed intellect...
And silence followed all.
flavour.UniqueWand1:
Cast into darkness
And trapped for a thousand years,
The lonely moon weeps
flavour.UniqueWand10:
The Goat King drank the smoke and ate the flames
as his ruin spread across the land.
flavour.UniqueWand11:
We forge order from the world around us
Wielding anarchy and destruction as our tools of genesis.
flavour.UniqueWand12:
You can never truly tame the tempest.
You can barely even leash it.
flavour.UniqueWand13:
Every decade, Lunaris devours Solaris
Each time, Solaris emerges from Lunaris, born anew.
flavour.UniqueWand14:
"We do not command fire.
Ngamahu lends it, and Hinekora returns it."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavour.UniqueWand15:
We remember the stillness.
Then the great fall.
The pain of separation.
We return once more.

This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Tul
flavour.UniqueWand16:
We fracture and splinter.
We pierce our sides.
But in the great freeze we are forged anew.
flavour.UniqueWand16x:
"Are we mad for attempting to build an engine out of this?
Looping cycles, power and pain..." 
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueWand17: Without light, there can be no shadow.
flavour.UniqueWand18: In every piece of prose, lies a tiny spark of magic.
flavour.UniqueWand19:
All at once, a calmness would encompass them,
and all at once, it would be torn away,
unveiling forms no sound mind could grasp.
flavour.UniqueWand2:
A chilling hush, a scraping sound
Of things no more entombed in ground.
A shambling horde is on its way
To crush the very light of day.
flavour.UniqueWand20: Crush your enemies with your essence, so that you may drink of theirs.
flavour.UniqueWand2x:
"Simply incredible. I caught an escaping test subject myself with
swarms of burning skulls. Delightful!"
- Researcher Olesya
flavour.UniqueWand3:
"The trick is to give nothingness,
and to receive everything in return."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.UniqueWand4:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
flavour.UniqueWand5: And the thunder rumbled on and on.
flavour.UniqueWand6:
"Stone still, amidst the reeds,
breath fogging in the iron cold air. 
he sits, he waits, he watches.
A piscatorial vigil, sat by the river,
his cathedral, his patience his unanswered prayer."
- Jojoba Mansell, bard, angler, adventurer
flavour.UniqueWand7:
Apep's poison entraps, encircles,
and engulfs the leaking mind of Man.
flavour.UniqueWand8: If it's worth doing once, it's worth doing twice.
flavour.UniqueWand9x:
"Energy redirected is energy imbalanced.
Prototype #78 serves as a prime example."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone1:
Those who could flee did so.
The rest fought bravely,
and died horrifically.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11a:
"The village was locked within its walls,
protected from those who could do them harm,
protected from those who could save them."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11b:
"Believing them to have discovered new lands,
they planted their flag in the dirt and called it their own.
A gesture not taken with a great deal of pleasure
by those who already dwelt there."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11c:
"The first explorers took to the hills to discover the lay of the land,
and watched with wonder as the land undulated, crashed and twisted."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11d:
"Atop the highest peaks, the sunlight pierced but did not warm.
The air choked and did not nourish.
And those that made the trek realised the folly of their desire for greatness."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11e:
"Where once a mountain stood there was now but fields and dust.
One by one, the stones were moved and placed with intention,
the consequences borne by the destination and the origin."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11f:
"The Shade walked the land with no end in sight,
no purpose in mind,
but the one it invented to pass the time."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11g:
"There were seasons in this strange new place, but not of sun and snow.
Seasons of stone that rose and fell like waves.
Seasons of structure and growth and madness and chaos.
Seasons of birth and decay that seemed untethered to cause."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11h:
"For a time, it was thought this place could seed an empire
greater than any in history.
The lands could be tamed, and commanded, they thought.
But control, like all things in that place, was an illusion."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone2:
They came, full of vim and vigour, to take what was not theirs.
They crashed and clamoured like waves against rocks,
and were swept back out to sea.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone3:
The King's Eye returned from the west.
Fertile pastures lay just beyond sight.
Just a little farther, he said.
It was always just a little farther.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone4: Nothing is more alluring than mystery.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone5:
There exists in every man and woman
a desire to push boundaries, to break new ground,
to make great discoveries,
no matter the personal cost.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone6:
Conflict begets only suffering.
For some, that is by design.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone7_:
Does the belly swell, or the belt shrink?
To those caught between, there is no difference,
and something must soon give.
flavour.UrukLineageSupport:
The volcano roared, but there was no thunder, only the boom
of Uruk's hammer. Wraeclast had forgotten the old alliance,
but by the Molten One's will, the fires would rage again.
flavour.VaalLimbReplacements:
"Behold! A marvel of innovation! Pay no mind the cost of flesh..."
- Guatelitzi, Architect of Flesh
flavour.VaultsResearch:
The world will seek to crush you and yours.
A Sekhema must have relentless will.
flavour.VilentaLineageSupport:
Day and night, she hammered away, obsessed with proving it
could be done; a vast ring of artifice under the earth, pushing
energy to speeds never before seen - all to prove Qotra wrong.
flavour.ViniasToken: You can change your name, but you cannot change your history.
flavour.VisceraCauldronFlavourText: Flesh can be as clay to the properly motivated artist.
flavour.VolatilePower: Unlimited power is apt to corrupt the minds of those who possess it.
flavour.VoranasCrestFlavourText:
The Black Scythe Mercenary Company was an
extension of Vorana. No storied history, no
centuries of service... and yet, legendary.
flavour.VoranasSiegeSupport:
"Your laws of war are asinine. I shall prevail!
I'll crush every pawn you put before me.
Face me, coward! Play by my rules."
flavour.VruunHeadFlavourText:
"Where Its dread gaze fell,
ruination followed..."
flavour.VruunsInevitabilitySupport:
"If you think you've won, it's only because you don't
understand their strategy. Each Vruun you kill only
teaches the next one how to endure against you."
flavour.VruunsWarhornSupport:
Vruun tore through Tul's preserved, shattering their
bodies with reckless malice. "The will of the Lords!"
he roared over his decimation. "All broods must serve."
flavour.WarpingBerserkerRuneFlavourText_:
Vorana the Irrepressible never once recruited. The Black
Scythe Mercenaries were entirely composed of men and
women who had seen her relentless will to fight - and
thought to themselves, "I would follow her anywhere."
flavour.WarpingDecayRuneFlavourText:
For generations, the people had feared the power of
the Witch of the Dark Lake. Aldur set out to invite her
to the Royal Court... He ended up marrying her instead.
flavour.WarpingDestructionRuneFlavourTex:
Thrud cared for neither diplomacy nor treaty. To end
the ravaging of distant corners of Middengard, Aldur
challenged him to a duel. With runes, Aldur fought him
to a stalemate. Now power... that, Thrud could respect.
flavour.WarpingMarksmanRuneFlavourText:
To win over the Wildking, Aldur spent a winter on the
hunt with Kolr and his men. He did not land a single
arrow on any stag, yet Kolr agreed to unify. It was not
an arrow that mattered. It was the determined attempt.
flavour.WarpingSoulRuneFlavourText:
Before they joined the expedition, the Druids of the
Circle offered sanctuary to all. Criminals, dissidents,
and the unwanted could walk a path to redemption.
flavour.Watchstone:
The memories and emotions of countless victims of the Elder,
locked in stone for eternity.
flavour.WatchstoneMaven: Only the souls trapped within can bear witness to the Maven's dark proclivities, and they dare not speak up.
flavour.WealthAndPower: The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.
flavour.Whakano1:
"When you stop viewing someone as a fellow human being,
there's little you won't do to forward your agenda.
That is what we're dealing with."
flavour.Whakano2:
"Selfishness and hate fuel these kidnappings. 
It's time we find who is leading them."
flavour.WildshardsLineageSupport:
She holds in her hand a shattered crystal, a vision of her desire: to
see her sister's silver palace obliterated, to see it cast across the
heavens. One cross word, and the sky will rain down her fury.
flavour.XibaquaLineageSupport:
Born of the gods, his treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh, until all that
remained was a droplet of pure light: the first Vaal.
flavour.ZarokhRefrainLineageSupport:
Reliving the same day for all time, Zarokh raged against
the moments that made up his prison. There would be
no redemption, for he had broken his only barya.
flavour.ZarokhRevoltLineageSupport:
Zarokh's ire built over the centuries as he planned his escape.
The Afarud would find what he sought, and then... the
Weeping Black would break the chains of his prison.
flavour.ZerphiLineageSupport_:
"It was the quality of his heinous acts that set him apart, not
the quantity... all of the physical trauma inflicted occurred
while the victim was still alive. Perhaps this was the key."
keyword_definitions.AbandonedCityMap:
Abandoned Cities have very few living inhabitants. 

Monsters in the area are replaced by Undead. These undead have 50% chance to drop non-equipment items instead of equipment.

Abandoned Cities have 25% increased Chests in the area.
keyword_definitions.AbyssalDepths:
Abyssal Depths are an underground dungeon sometimes found when completing the final Abyss in the area.

The Abyssal Depths contains many Abyssal monsters and all Rare monsters will have an Abyssal Modifier.
At the end of the Abyssal Depths is a more powerful Rare with both a Lichborn Modifier and an Abyssal Modifier. Defeating this Rare will unlock valuable chests nearby.

The chests at the end of the Abyssal Depths can also drop pieces of Preserved Bone, but also can rarely drop additional exclusive Omens and Lineage Supports.

At higher levels the Abyssal Depths can lead to powerful Boss Fights.
keyword_definitions.AbyssalEye: Abyssal Eyes are artifacts recovered from Abyssals which function as a type of Augment.
keyword_definitions.AbyssalModifiers:
Abyssal Monsters spawned from Abysses steal modifiers from monsters killed near their pit, these modifiers can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.

Abyssal Modifiers rarely have a chance to become a more powerful Lichborn Modifier.
keyword_definitions.AbyssalWasting: Abyssal Wasting reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds
keyword_definitions.Abyssalify:
Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls.

Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.
keyword_definitions.AccountBound: Account Bound items cannot be traded to other players, but can be shared between other characters on your account.
keyword_definitions.Accuracy:
Accuracy is used to hit a target with an Attack, and is checked against the targets Evasion to determine that chance. 

Player Attacks incur an Accuracy penalty based on distance from the origin of the damage to the target, with no penalty for targets within 2 metres and up to 90% less Accuracy for targets further than 9 metres away.
keyword_definitions.Acrobatics:
Can Evade all Hits
75% less Evasion Rating
keyword_definitions.Adaptation:
Adaptations are gained by taking Elemental Damage from Hits and cause you to take less damage of that Type from subsequent Hits.

Unless otherwise specified, you can have 3 Adaptations at a time, and Adaptations do not have a duration.
keyword_definitions.AddedAttackCastTime: This additional use time is fixed and will not be modified by skill use speed stats.
keyword_definitions.AdditionalRareMonste:
Additional Rare Monsters can spawn in Rare Monster Packs with larger pack sizes.

Each Rare Monster in the Pack provides one modifier to the Pack's Minions.

Additional Rare Monsters in Essence Packs also carry Essences.
keyword_definitions.Affinity:
Affinity is a buff granted by the Trinity skill. There are three types of Affinity: Fire, Cold and Lightning. You can have a maximum of 100 of each type of Affinity.

You lose 10 Affinity per second of specific types if you haven't gained Affinity of that type in the past 8 seconds.
keyword_definitions.Afflictions:
Afflictions are negative effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them harder to run.
Afflictions will be applied for entering certain rooms in the Trial or from encountering certain Maraketh Shrines.
Afflictions can be either Minor or Major, providing varying negative effects to your Trial.
keyword_definitions.Aftershock: Aftershocks are bursts of area damage that occur after the initial impact of the skill causing them. If not otherwise specified, the Aftershock will deal the same damage as the initial impact, in the same area. Only Attack damage can cause Aftershocks.
keyword_definitions.Aggravate:
Bleeding that has been Aggravated always treats the target as moving, which causes it to deal 100% extra damage.

Once a Bleeding Debuff has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Each Bleeding Debuff can be Aggravated, or not, independently — one Bleeding Debuff being Aggravated does not mean other Bleeding Debuffs on the target are also Aggravated, and Aggravating some or all of them will have no effect on new Bleeding Debuffs applied afterwards. However, effects which Aggravate Bleeding on a target do so to all Bleeding Debuffs currently on that target unless otherwise specified.
keyword_definitions.AggravateIgnite:
Ignite that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage.

Once an Ignite has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Just like Bleeding, each Ignite Debuff can be Aggravated, or not, independently of others on the target.
keyword_definitions.AilmentApplication:
Modifiers to Ailment Application apply to:
Bleeding, Poison and Shock chance
Flammability, Freeze and Electrocution Buildup.
keyword_definitions.AilmentSpread:
Spreading an ailment inflicts a new, matching ailment on another target, from the same source. The new ailment can potentially spread further, but never back to the same target twice.

Ailments can never spread to, or from, the entity that originally inflicted them.
keyword_definitions.AilmentThreshold: A higher Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it less likely that being Hit by Elemental Damage will apply the relevant Ailment, as well as lowering the amount of Freeze and Electrocute buildup recieved. A lower Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it more likely, and increases buildup of Freeze and Electrocute recieved. By default a player's Ailment Threshold is equal to half their Life.
keyword_definitions.Ailments: Ailments are a family of common Debuffs associated with specific damage types. The list of Ailments is: Bleeding, Ignite, Chill, Freeze, Shock, Electrocute, and Poison.
keyword_definitions.AldursLegacy: Aldur's Legacies are Augments which have taken the power of a Unique Ezomyte or Kalguuran Unique. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.
keyword_definitions.Allies:
Your allies include other players, Minions, and any other entity that fights alongside you and has its own stats. 

You do not count as your own Ally.
keyword_definitions.AlternateStrengthBon:
Gain no inherent bonus from Strength
1% increased Energy Shield per 2 Strength
keyword_definitions.Ammunition: Using a Crossbow Ammunition Skill replaces your Crossbow's basic Attack with the skill indicated. The Ammunition Skill itself does not fire the Ammunition, only load it into your Crossbow. Most Crossbow Ammunition Skills that directly Hit enemies have Knockback.
keyword_definitions.Anaemia: Anaemia is a Debuff that allows more than 10 Corrupted Blood debuffs to be applied to a target. The Magnitude of Anaemia determines how many additional Corrupted Blood stacks to be applied.
keyword_definitions.AncestralBond:
Your Totem Limit is doubled
No cost or Charge requirement for placing Totems
Totems reserve 75 Spirit each
keyword_definitions.AncestralBoost: An Ancestrally Boosted Slam has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect, and an Ancestrally Boosted Strike will target 2 additional Enemies. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted. Ancestrally Boosted Attacks count as being Empowered.
keyword_definitions.AncestralBoostSpell: An Ancestrally Boosted Spell has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
keyword_definitions.Ancient: These are Augments which have powerful singular effects, but are more limited. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.
keyword_definitions.AncientBlooms:
Ancient Blooms are Remnants that grant the following bonuses when collected:
Vivid Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Charms
Primal Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Mana Flasks
Wild Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Life Flasks
keyword_definitions.AoESkill:
This Skill has an effect that applies to every target in its area, rather than picking specific targets.

Areas of Effect that originate from a target hit by a Skill will add that target's size to their radius.
keyword_definitions.ArcaneRune:
<<ExpedRuneArcane>><rgb(219,217,206)>{Arcane Rune}
<font:'fontin'>{<rgb(110,87,66)>{Monsters gain:}}}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Extra Energy Shield}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Trigger a Stunning nova when Energy Shield is depleted}
keyword_definitions.ArcaneSurge: Arcane Surge grants 15% increased Cast Speed and 20% more Mana Regeneration Rate.
keyword_definitions.ArcaneSurgeDuration:
Arcane Surge grants 15% increased Cast Speed and 20% more Mana Regeneration Rate.
It lasts for 4 seconds by default.
keyword_definitions.Archon:
Archons are a type of Buff that significantly augment your prowess with a certain type of Skills, such as Elemental Spells or Plant Skills.

By default, each Archon Buff lasts 10 seconds.

You cannot gain any Archon Buff while you already have one, or during a recovery period after you lose one, which lasts 20 seconds by default.
keyword_definitions.Armour:
Armour reduces Damage taken from Hits. By default, Armour only applies to Physical Damage.

Damage reduction from Armour is proportional to the amount of Damage, and is more effective at reducing smaller hits.
keyword_definitions.ArmourBreak:
Some Skills, Items, Support Gems and other effects can Break Armour, which lowers a target's Armour by a specified amount. If this brings the target's Armour value to 0, their Armour is Fully Broken for 12 seconds, or 4 seconds for players. On top of not benefitting from Armour, non-player targets with Fully Broken Armour take 20% increased Physical damage from Hits.

Players Break 3 times Armour against Normal Monsters and 2 times Armour against Magic Monsters.
keyword_definitions.ArmourOverbreak: Enemies with Armour Broken below 0 have negative Armour. This means they take more Physical damage from Hits. Armour broken below 0 is capped by the enemy's base Armour.
keyword_definitions.ArmourPenalties:
Depending on the type of Armour equipped, Players will have a less Movement Speed penalty applied depending on what Attribute the Armour requires. These penalties only apply to equipped Body Armours and Shields.
For Body Armour, pure Strength has a 5% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 4% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has a 3% penalty.
For Shields, pure Strength has a 3% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 1.5% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has no penalty.
keyword_definitions.ArmouredShield: Armoured Shields are any Shields that grant the player Armour — that is, any type of Shield other than Bucklers.
keyword_definitions.ArtificersOrb: Adds an Augment Socket to a Martial Weapon or Armour
keyword_definitions.AscendancyPoints:
Ascendancy Passive Skill Points can be allocated in your Ascendancy Skill Tree once you have chosen your Ascendancy. Your Ascendancy class is unlocked by completing any Ascension Trial. In order to change your Ascendancy, you must complete an Ascension Trial to the furthest extent you have successfully already done so, and then interact with the Ascendancy Altar while you have no Ascendancy Passive Skill Points currently assigned. Trialmaster and Balbala will offer the ability to refund passive points while in rooms with Ascendancy Altars to facilitate this.

You can obtain 4 sets of 2 Ascendancy Points for a total of 8 in the following ways:
Set 1 - Completing floor 1 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 7 Trials
Set 2 - Completing floor 2 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos
Set 3 - Completing floor 3 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 10 Trials
Set 4 - Completing floor 4 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the secret challenge behind the locked door in the Trials of Chaos
keyword_definitions.AtlasDifficulty:
Difficulty causes monsters to have increased damage and life, as well as improving the items they drop.

Certain Bosses with increased difficulty will gain new abilities and begin to drop exclusive items, and have a reduced number of Respawn Attempts.

Difficulty above 4 has no additional effect.
keyword_definitions.Attack:
Attacks are skills that directly damage enemies, usually using your equipped Martial Weapon. Spells are not Attacks.

The base damage, attack speed and critical hit chance of an attack are determined using your Martial Weapon's stats unless the skill says otherwise.

Attacks do not necessarily deal Physical damage — they can deal any damage type.
keyword_definitions.Attributes:
Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence are the 3 primary attributes. The most important use of Attributes is to meet requirements to use Equipment and Gems.

Each Attribute provides a different inherent bonus.
keyword_definitions.AudienceWithTheKing: An Audience with the King is an item that is an exclusive drop from the Ritual mechanic. This item allows you to access the Crux of Nothingness via the Realmgate.
keyword_definitions.Augment:
Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means. 

The types of Equipment which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.
keyword_definitions.Aura: Auras apply Buffs to Allies within a radius, or Debuffs to enemies within a radius of the source of the Aura.
keyword_definitions.AvatarOfFire:
75% of Damage Converted to Fire Damage
Deal no Non-Fire Damage
keyword_definitions.Axe:
Axes are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed. Axes require Strength and Dexterity to equip. 

Axe Attacks commonly involve throwing your axe and/or inflicting Bleeding.
keyword_definitions.AzmeriSpirit:
Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians. 
Azmeri Spirits appear as wisps that flee as you approach them. Normal or Magic Monsters the Spirit comes into contact with become Spirit-Influenced, making them more powerful. 
Sometimes the Spirit will reach and Possess a Rare or Unique monster, making them substantially stronger and rewarding while occasionally summoning spiritual animals depending on the type of Animal Spirit they represent.
Possessed monsters are more rewarding depending on how many Spirit-Influenced monsters were defeated leading up to possession.
keyword_definitions.AzmeriSpiritPrimal:
Primal Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Primal Spirits deal increased damage, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Primal Spirits drop Intelligence items.
keyword_definitions.AzmeriSpiritVivid:
Vivid Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Vivid Spirits gain increased Skill Speed, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Vivid Spirits drop Dexterity items.
keyword_definitions.AzmeriSpiritWild:
Wild Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Wild Spirits gain increased Toughness, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Wild Spirits drop Strength items.
keyword_definitions.Ballista: Ballistas are a type of Totem that use Projectile Attacks.
keyword_definitions.Banner:
Banner Skills generate Glory when you attack a Monster while it is activated. Glory generated corresponds to the Power of the Monster hit. Once at full Glory, the Banner can be placed to create powerful Buffing Areas.
Normally you have a limit of a single Banner placed at one time.
keyword_definitions.BaseSkillAttackTime: This refers to the base amount of time to perform an Attack Skill, accounting only for the Attacks per Second value of the relevant Weapon and the percentage of Base Attack Speed listed on the Attack gem.
keyword_definitions.BaseType:
An item's Base Type refers to the specific variety of item it is, and grants it inherent properties such as damage on Martial Weapons, defensive bonuses on Armour, or Life recovery on Life Flasks. It is also often responsible for the Level and/or Attribute Requirements to equip an item.

For example:
• Wrapped Quarterstaff and Long Quarterstaff are both Quarterstaff Base Types
• Stocky Mitts and Linen Wraps are both Gloves Base Types
• Lesser Mana Flask and Greater Mana Flask are both Mana Flask Base Types
keyword_definitions.BasicJewel:
Basic Jewels do not affect nodes in a radius.
Basic Jewels are Rubies, Emeralds, Sapphires and Diamonds.
keyword_definitions.BasicMap:
Basic Maps are any maps with no special interaction with areas or access requirements.

Notably, not Unique Maps, Deadly Map Boss Maps, Precursor Towers, Expedition Areas or Quest Areas.
keyword_definitions.BasicStrongbox: Basic Strongboxes are specifically named "Strongbox" and drop random items.
keyword_definitions.Bear:
Shapeshifting into a Bear grants access to devastating Slams and Fire Attacks fuelled by smouldering Rage.

While in Bear form, you gain:
• +10 to Armour per level
• 30% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage
• an Endurance Charge for every 15 Rage you spend
keyword_definitions.BetterCurrencyMinimu: Added random Modifiers are at least this level or higher, except if a specific Modifier type would be excluded entirely from being able to roll. Currency with a Minimum Modifier Level cannot be used on items with an item level below the Minimum Modifier Level.
keyword_definitions.BindingChains: Binding Chains is a stacking Debuff that Slows character movement speed by 8% for each stack applied.
keyword_definitions.Biome:
Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps.

Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water Biomes are all commonly found.

Cities and special biomes are less likely to be encountered.
keyword_definitions.Bleeding:
Bleeding is an Ailment that deals Physical damage over time, and lasts 5 seconds by default. Damage from Bleeding bypasses Energy Shield

Bleeding deals an extra 100% damage while the target is moving, or if the Bleeding is Aggravated.

Physical damage from Hits Contributes to Bleeding Magnitude.

Damage does not Contribute to Bleeding chance, so it cannot be inflicted without an explicit source of Bleeding chance.

The base Magnitude of Bleeding is Physical damage per second equal to 15% of the Pre-mitigation Physical damage of the Hit that inflicted it. This magnitude is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal. 

Modifiers and Debuffs that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as Shock) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Bleeding, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to Hit damage (such as Armour Break) do not affect Bleeding damage.
keyword_definitions.Blind: Being Blinded causes 20% less Accuracy Rating and Evasion Rating, and lasts for 4 seconds unless otherwise specified.
keyword_definitions.Block:
Blocking completely prevents the damage of an incoming Hit.

You will still take any Stun from the Blocked hit. You can't Block while Stunned or Frozen. 

Some Skills used by Bosses cannot be blocked. These are indicated by a red glow and audio cue during the windup of the Skill.
keyword_definitions.BloodLoss: All Physical damage over time taken by a target (including Bleeding) is accumulated as Blood Loss.
keyword_definitions.BloodMagic:
You have no Mana
Skill Mana Costs Converted to Life Costs

keyword_definitions.Bloodstained:
While Bleeding enemies build up Bloodstained, gaining the Bloodstained Debuff after Bleeding for a total of 6 seconds. Bloodstained builds up 100% faster if the Bleeding enemy is moving or the Bleeding is Aggravated.

Certain skills allow you to view the Bloodstained Debuff on enemies and can consume the Debuff for powerful effects.
keyword_definitions.BlueFlamesOfChayula: Blue Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Mana to you when collected.

keyword_definitions.BonusMapEvent: Ancient Modifiers are fragments of Precursor power, adding many varied bonus effects to areas throughout the Precursor Fortress and beyond.
keyword_definitions.BooleanDamageRoll:
Hits from a weapon or skill with this property will not roll a random value between the minimum or maximum damage value, but instead will always roll either the minimum value or the maximum value, with a 50% chance for each.

Each Damage Type has its damage value rolled separately, so if the hit deals multiple types of damage, some types may roll the maximum while others roll minimum.

If the damage rolls are Lucky, that will still apply, make this roll twice and picking the maximum if either roll had that result, only picking minimum damage if both rolls selected minimum. Unlucky damage rolls will prefer minimum damage in the same way.
keyword_definitions.Boons:
Boons are positive effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them easier to run.
Boons can be gained from certain Maraketh Shrines or from buying them from the Trial Merchant using Sacred Water.
Boons can be either Minor or Major, providing varying benefits to your Trial.
keyword_definitions.Bow:
Bows are Two-Handed ranged weapons that require Dexterity to equip. Equipping a Bow allows you to also equip a Quiver in the off hand slot. 

Bows can Attack from long range and with high mobility using a variety of skills, but generally deal less damage than other two-handed weapon types.
keyword_definitions.BreachHiveAddModifie:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which adds a Modifier to Rare Breach Monsters which enter it.

A Rare Monster can only have one Modifier added.
keyword_definitions.BreachHiveAdditional: A skill created by Ailith that adds an additional Pack with a Rare Monster to each wave.
keyword_definitions.BreachHiveMonsterPot: A skill created by Ailith that increases the Effectiveness of Monsters in Breach Hive encounters.
keyword_definitions.BreachHiveMonsterUpg:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which upgrades the Rarity of Breach Monsters which enter it.

Monsters can only have their Rarity upgraded once, and can not be upgraded beyond Rare.
keyword_definitions.BreachHiveSacrificeF: A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 1000% more Damage and immunity to Damage for 10 seconds.
A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 100% increased Item Rarity in Breach Hives.
keyword_definitions.BreachWombgift:
Wombgifts are found within Breaches and are grown on The Genesis Tree.

The 4 types of Wombgifts are:
* Lavish Wombgift
* Ornate Wombgift
* Banded Wombgift
* Signet Wombgift
keyword_definitions.Brittle: Hits have up to +6% Critical Hit Chance against Brittle enemies, based on the Cold damage of the Hit which inflicted Brittle, for 4 seconds.
keyword_definitions.BrokenFace:
Each "Boss Encounter" icon on the World Screen is a face which can be broken by beating the encounter.

"Rare Monster Encounter" icons do not provide any bonus when broken.
keyword_definitions.BrokenStance:
Broken Stance is a Debuff inflicted by Hits, which stores 10% of the Pre-mitigation Physical Hit damage of the Hit that inflicts it as its Magnitude.

The inflicter's subsequent Hits against the target will gain additional unscaleable added Physical Damage equal to that magnitude.

Enemies with Broken Stance cannot be Dazed again.
keyword_definitions.Buckler: Bucklers are a special type of Shield that do not grant any Armour and can Parry enemy skills instead of being raised to Block.
keyword_definitions.Buff:
Buffs are effects that boost a player or monster's stats for a duration or while a condition is met.

Unless otherwise stated, Buffs of the same type do not stack — only the copy with the strongest effect applies.
keyword_definitions.BuffEffect: Modifiers to the Effect of Buffs or Debuffs usually come from the target it affects and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Magnitudes of the Buff or Debuff, which come from its creator.
keyword_definitions.BuffMagnitude:
The Magnitudes of a Buff or Debuff are the values of the stats it applies to the target. A Buff or Debuff with higher magnitudes is more powerful.

Modifiers to the Magnitude of Buffs or Debuffs come from whoever applies it and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Effect the Buff or Debuff has on the target.
keyword_definitions.Bulwark:
Dodge Roll cannot Avoid Damage
Take 30% less Damage from Hits while Dodge Rolling
keyword_definitions.Burning: Enemies taking Fire damage over time are Burning. Usually this occurs because the enemy is Ignited.
keyword_definitions.Cascadable:
Warcries, and Non-Channelling Spells that affect an area around you or a targeted location, are Cascadable.

Certain effects can cause Cascadable Skills to Cascade, making them also affect other locations, or to Echo, affecting the same targeted location again after a delay.

A Cascadable Spell that Repeats will not Cascade or Echo while Repeating.
keyword_definitions.CasterWeapon: Caster Weapons are Sceptres, Staves and Wands.
keyword_definitions.Catalyst: Catalysts are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the Breach mechanic. Catalysts add Quality that affect certain modifiers on items. There are two categories of Catalyst, one that affects Jewellery and one that affects Jewels.
